store.about:
God Save Birmingham is a physics-driven zombie survival simulator set in medieval Birmingham, England. As the town’s only survivor, you must scramble to fulfill your everyday needs, while avoiding the grasping hands and rotten teeth of your former friends and neighbors. 
 A HISTORICAL TOWN WITH A HELLISH TWIST  

 Explore a painstakingly rendered and reimagined medieval market town, now teeming with undead. But don’t let that stop you from seeing the sights! Drop by the historic Bull Ring, grab a bite to eat at the markets, or take a moment to rest at Saint Martin’s Church. Just remember to bar the doors first. 
 PHYSICS THAT MATTER  

 Almost every object in the game can be moved or manipulated to aid your chances of survival. Barricade a door with a dining table, grab a barrel and go bowling for zombies, or set a rushlight on the ground to light the room while you sleep. 

 But the laws of nature also apply to you. Trip over a ledge, and you may lose your weapon. Fall from too high, and you might break your leg. 
 HARDCORE SURVIVAL GAMEPLAY  

 With the town in chaos, simply staying alive is a struggle. You’ll have to scavenge food, secure clean drinking water, keep warm, seek shelter at night, and try not to fall ill, all while dealing with a constant undead siege. 

 But man does not live by bread alone. You’ll also have to manage your mental state to avoid lapsing into despair or madness. You can also level up various survival-related skills by continuously practicing them, including mastery over certain weapon types. 
 HOME IS WHERE THE HEART IS  

 With no one left...

store.name: MIGHTREYA
store.short: Join schoolgirl superhero Reya and her manager Nio as they embark on their journey as Hero Content Creators, fighting monstrous beings that emerge daily from a dimension beyond. Anime-inspired, heart-pounding hero action is waiting for you!
store.about:
Join schoolgirl superhero Reya and her manager Nio as they embark on their journey as Hero Content Creators, fighting monstrous beings that emerge daily from another dimension. 

 Prepare for electrifying aerial superhero battles , boasting intuitive controls that anyone can master. Use the camera to lock onto targets effortlessly, then unleash a torrent of attacks with the push of a button. Dive into combat at exhilarating speeds, delivering lightning-fast strikes and chaining combos effortlessly. 

 Experience sensational combat against unexpected otherworldly threats , from small creatures to gigantic monsters. Unleash your power and send them crashing into floors and walls in anime-style showdowns! 

 Follow an engaging cast through the fun and cheerful hero streamer's story ! Featuring a stylish female protagonist, colorful side characters and creatively designed enemies. 

 Take advantage of 3 iconic weapons and over 30 unique actions and attacks to execute unique combos and jaw-dropping finishers to obliterate your foes. 

 Explore 3 8 stages and face 24 enemy types including powerful bosses.

 Anime-inspired, heart-pounding hero action is waiting for you!

store.name: Hawthorn
store.short: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you the sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. This early Proof-of-Concept Demo is an intentional look back at where Hawthorn's development journey began and an invitation to shape the future of Hawthorn!
store.about:
Once upon a time, woodland creatures built a trading post in forgotten Windermere Valley, but now it is the haunt of varmints, fairy lights, and mysterious rumors about why this village was abandoned.
 To you, however, this is a hope for a new life. Recruit villagers and grow a community. Defend against the elements and forest tricksters. Thrive and celebrate the seasons’ traditions. Rebuilding won’t be easy, but you and your newfound friends are up to the challenge.
 Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. Play this Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

 Proof of Concept Demo Playable Now! 
 Download Hawthorn's Proof-of-Concept Demo now! (See the link above on this page.) This demo is a prototype made at the start of our development journey. We built it to share our vision with publishers and the world, and as a foundational starting point for the full game. It focuses on the village-building aspect of Hawthorn, offering a glimpse of the potential of this world, the intended atmosphere, and the player-driven experience at the core of the game. Much more gameplay and content have already been added since this version, and the visuals in this demo do not represent the final game.
 Now we're making this demo available to the public to gather feedback that will help shape what comes next. Our ability to continue developing Hawthorn depends on the support and...

store.name: PACS - Post Apocalypse Courier Service
store.short: 1-4 players in the postiepocalypse! Drive across treacherous environments, customize your delivery vehicles, and secure 5 star reviews for corporate by supplying the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time.
store.about:
Courier, corporate calls! Civilization has collapsed and the world is uninhabitable and dangerous. You won’t let a little thing like the post-apocalypse get between you and a five star review, will you?
 Drive through extreme weather and apocalyptically treacherous terrain

 Scavenge to survive and repair your equipment

 Customize your vehicles with engines, wheels, batteries, drivetrain, bodywork, and more!

 Package parcels, manage your inventory, and be strategic with transport space and materials

 Deliver parcels with up to 4 players for exciting online co-op gameplay, and survive together in the post-apocalypse

 Wear a company issued respirator at all times

 (fulfil the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time) 

 Cracked roads and overgrown trails dot a treacherous landscape between you and a happy customer. Navigate apocalyptic terrain and weather while keeping packages safe and secure. 
 Accept delivery orders from the last holdouts of humanity but package carefully! Cargo can be awkwardly sized, explosive, or even radioactive. We wouldn't want any incidents!
 Drive in a convoy with friends, or barrel through the unknown alone—do whatever it takes to deliver and score a good review. Surviving is a nice bonus, too.

 (build your ideal loadout with Postie progression) 

 Creatively customize your vehicle to ensure you and your crew will traverse the apocalyptic landscape efficiently and mostly unirradiated. 
 Expand your delivery reach by building your PACS reputation, and unlock new parts that give you increased utility—giving the ability to (try and)...

store.name: Gods, Death & Reapers
store.short: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.
store.about:
In a post-apocalyptic dark fantasy world, mythologies lie in ruins. This blend of Extraction and Action RPG challenges you to restore balance to the shattered realms.
 Recruited by Death, you’ll enter dangerous maps, complete objectives, fight enemies or other players, and secure your loot.

 Journey through mythological realms, beginning with Norse mythology. Face tough enemies, take on quests, and gather powerful gear and artifacts. Master different playstyles in a fair game environment with strict anti-cheat tools. 

 Start from your hidden fortress, where you upgrade your base, customize loadouts, and prepare for battle. Each map offers unique objectives and treasures, but the stakes are high: die and lose everything, or extract and keep your rewards. Future updates will add new maps, player-to-player trading, and more ways to play!

 Alongside the high-stakes Reaper-vs-Reaper-vs-Environment extraction, you’ll get more ways to match your playstyle. PvE maps let you uncover the mystery of the dead gods at your own pace, without risking your gear. Or choose to play in a party, which will allow you to team up to fight factions and uncover more of the story after taking the first steps into the afterlife. The party system will be added in an upcoming update.

 With the Respawn mechanic, Death grants you a second chance. After dying for the first time, you can reclaim your own corpse or possess another fallen Reaper’s body to attend to your unfinished business in the afterlife.

 Built with players in mind, we’re committed to community-driven development and real feedback....

store.name: Fate Trigger
store.short: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by UE5, available across multiple platforms. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!
store.about:
Finger on the Trigger – Anime Heroes are Storming the Arena!
You are the chosen warrior, the Awakener, and your mission is to uncover the deep-seated secrets of this new world by shooting your way to ultimate victory.
Ready to flex your tactics? Scavenge, craft epic gear, and unleash special skills to outgun and outsmart your rivals!

 Choose from a diverse roster of anime heroes, each with unique abilities and stunning 3D visuals like no other. Become a Light Whisperer, unleashing devastating strikes via vital beams, or a Seafarer, moving swiftly and turning invisible with the power of water. Whether you are a timid bunny who builds pixel fortresses or an elegant scout dazzling your foes with deadly mist and charm, there is always a hero to suit your playstyle.

 Welcome to a dynamic arena featuring multiple game modes — from all-out Battle Royale, to intense team-based point defense, and high-stakes trials set in ever-shrinking toxic zones. Each mode is crafted to fuel your competitive fire! 
Showcase your sharpshooting skills and tactical instincts in Battle Royale. Prefer tight coordination? Engage in fast-paced point defense, where flawless teamwork is the key to dominating vital zones. And when the zones start to shrink, prepare for heart-racing encounters where every move could be your last.

 Dive into a fast-paced shooter where heroes can be matched to different combat styles. Form your ultimate squad, master the flow of engagement, and seize every game-changing moment! Make strategic use of convenient respawn and transfer options for accessibility, customize your...

store.name: C-Beams
store.short: Pilot your ship through a perilous black hole system in this Space Action RPG. Engage in advanced ship combat, haul rare elements, and upgrade your vessel to survive. Stunning visuals, a deep narrative, and a rewarding progression system await as you uncover the abyss's dark secrets.
store.about:
C-Beams is a top-down space action RPG where you pilot your ship through a perilous black hole system. Navigate treacherous anomalies, engage in intense ship-to-ship combat, and upgrade your vessel to face ever-greater challenges.
 In the future, humanity has begun reaching out into the stars. The discovery of a new black hole system has sparked a gold rush, drawing corporations and daring pilots eager to claim its riches. Those brave enough to face hazardous anomalies and hostile competitors can amass great fortunes by extracting rare, never-before-seen elements.
 As a new pilot with nothing to lose, you'll decide how to carve your legacy in this unforgiving frontier.

 Pilot a variety of ships, each featuring highly realistic handling characteristics. Engage retro burns to decelerate rapidly, cut your engines to drift silently through space, and master maneuvering thrusters to evade enemy fire.
 Docking at space stations or derelict ships is a skillful art. The better you become at piloting, the faster you'll complete missions and earn rewards.
 However, overloading your cargo hold will increase your ship's mass, making it sluggish and harder to maneuver. Keep an eye on your fuel reserves—running out of boost fuel at the wrong moment could be the difference between victory and defeat.

 Tear enemy ships apart in chaotic close-range firefights using rapid-fire gatling turrets and recoilless cannons, or pick them off from a distance with guided missiles, railguns, and powerful C-Beams. Sub-system targeting allows you to disable engines, weapons, or radar for a tactical...

store.name: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
store.short: Run your very own cat cafe! Lead your cats on adventures into a magical city, gather ingredients to cook scrumptious dishes, customize your dream cafe, and bring bliss to your loyal customers in this cozy management lifesim. 🐱
store.about:
Build your cat cafe into the beating heart of the city, changing lives with cats, coffee, and community! 
 Return to the world of Cat Cafe Manager in this sequel to the hit cozy management sim. 
 After a faerie cat possesses your smartphone (it's a whole thing), you discover a mysterious force is leaving people lonely and disconnected. Rescue stray cats, grow your cafe, explore a folkloric city, and bring your community back together… one paw at a time. ✨

 FEATURES
 💗  Build your dream cat cafe 
 Create the coziest hotspot in town! Decorate to your taste, craft a menu with delicious treats, and match guests with cats to fill their cup—literally!

 🐈 Rescue stray kittens 
 No two cats are the same. Get to know a cat's personality, earn their trust, and welcome them into your growing family.

 😽  Care for your furry friends 
 Your kitties need food, grooming, playtime, and lots of cuddles to stay happy. Teach them unique companion skills to help you gather resources and uncover the secrets of the city.

 🗺️  Explore a folkloric city 
 Become a local of Covestadt, a welcoming yet mysterious city with a touch of magic. Get to know colorful characters, uncover secrets and rare ingredients, and meet stray cats around every corner.

 👋 Grow a thriving community 
 Meet a memorable cast of local shopkeepers, forge meaningful connections, and bring the bustling energy back to a once forgotten shopping street.

 🧙‍♀️  Uncover an ancient mystery 
 Something ancient is stirring… Join forces with tiny cat faeries, uncover the witches' forgotten history, and save the city from a...

store.name: Ship Miner
store.short: Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?
store.about:
An unknown menace identified as The Anomaly is threatening the galaxy. Travel through the galaxy, explore asteroids and find and collect valuable minerals and lost technology. But hurry up before The Anomaly manifest in your asteroid, engage or escape, your choice. Use your minerals and technologies to prepare to face and defeat The Anomaly once you are ready.
 EXPLORE ASTEROIDS
 Travel to procedurally generated asteroids providing a unique experience on each asteroid jump or each run.

 COLLECT MINERALS
 Dig the asteroid with your mining devices to find and collect minerals and advanced blueprints to unlock new technologies and space stations.

 IMPROVE
 Use your minerals to improve your ship stats or install new technologies that change the gameplay.

 BUILD
 Build different space stations and drones to assist in your task, from improving your defenses to speed up the asteroid exploration, the choice is yours.

 SURVIVE
 The asteroids are not safe, The Anomaly wants it and the minerals for itself and will appear and attack your ship and your base. Use your improvements, defend, attack or escape. You can try again in the next asteroid.

 Gameplay Description:

 Ship Miner is a an action miner game, you control a mining ship with your twin stick controller or with keyboard and have to explore and mine asteroids. You collect minerals and upgrade your ship, build a small base and select new destinations, and repeat. Enemies might appear in the asteroid to complicate things, engage them or flee, your choice. If destroyed you either restart from last save or start again from...

store.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
store.short: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!
store.about:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to boomer shooter Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. 

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grim, and dark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter. 

Lock in as one of two playable characters, each offering their own unique abilities, weapons, and play style. 

Dominate combat as the unrelenting force that is Malum Caedo, a formidable Sternguard Veteran with a reputation for purging heretics. Or quickly take control of the battlefield as the swift and nimble Sister of Battle Celestian, Nyra Veyrath, torching enemies and leaving only ashes in her wake.

Take the fight to never-before-seen worlds and vanquish the foes that lurk there. From the colossal heights of a hive city to the impenetrable mangrove swamps of a jungle, and even to the heart of the Ark of Omen… You’ll need to overcome the challenges of each location to complete your mission.

Built on the explosive combat of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, charge headfirst into glorious battle armed with an arsenal of deadly weapons. Shred enemies with your lethal chainsword, blast them into an explosion of pixels and blood with your Shotgun or set them aflame with a torrent of liquid fire from your Flamer!

As your arsenal improves, so do the enemies! Eviscerate enemies from the four Chaos god factions (Nurgle, Tzeentch, Khorne, and Slaanesh) in glorious, visceral fashion. The ferocious Bloodletters and their...

store.name: Expedition: Into Darkness
store.short: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.
store.about:
Begin your journey on foreboding grounds above ancient, mysterious ruins. Driven by an insatiable thirst for glory, power, and untold riches, you will battle innumerable deadly creatures and uncover dark secrets as you pursue your damned ambitions.Stand against the horrifying enemies in this PvE extraction game. 

 Form a party with up to four other friends, or, if you're brave enough, enter the darkness alone.

 Assemble weapons from individual components: swords, maces, axes, polearms, spears, bows, or crossbows—the choice is yours. Customise all gear with materials, tints, and liveries to perfectly suit your playstyle and sense of fashion.

 Death means losing your character and everything they carry, permanently. If you want to return out alive with your hard-earned loot—be careful and deliberate. Anything stored in your base camp is safe.

 Return with resources from the depths to repair and upgrade your base of operations—exploit upgrades to assist with your next venture for more riches and antediluvian knowledge.

 Nightmarish creatures, deadly traps, unstable structures, hidden drops, and toxic gasses—you have been warned.

 Cast aside piety and reach beyond the Empyrean to make deals with dark gods in exchange for forbidden power, but remember—everything comes at a price.

store.name: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
store.short: Murmurs of Fear is a psychological horror about those left alone with the unexplainable. It is a self-contained story about fear, isolation, and the struggle to stay sane as reality itself begins to fracture.
store.about:
Murmurs of Fear is a psychological horror game about people who come face to face with something unexplainable. 
 This is not a story about saving the world. It is about those who tried to hold on to their sanity. 

 A Whisper of Loneliness 
 You are Alex, a 22-year-old electrician sent to a remote island with a lighthouse. A group of geologists had been working there, preparing to reopen the old, sealed mines.
 Then, suddenly - all communication stopped.
 You arrive alone. Greeted by fog, a storm, the distant lighthouse... and silence. No people. Empty homes. Scattered notes.
And something watching you through the mist.
 All you have are your tools, a kerosene lamp, and the growing sense that you're not alone here.

 Key Features:
 Lovecraftian silence — ancient symbols, forgotten obelisks, and whispers from the dark. 
Retro aesthetic — subtle VHS-style visuals without overkill. 
Non-linear storytelling - discover clues, decide who or what to believe. 
Immersive atmosphere - foggy forests, creaking wood, and rare but powerful sounds.

 In this episode, you will:
 Explore a desolate island and its eerie locations: docks, lighthouse, mines, and sawmill.

 Solve environmental puzzles tied into the story.

 Find and use items to restore power and communication.

 Use a minecart to travel across the island.

 Make choices that lead to different endings.

 Will you survive the night and uncover the truth that drove others mad? 
 Or will you become just another whisper in the mist?

store.name: Hking's Block Arena
store.short: Up to twelve cube robots, one grid, one shot then reload. A couch-first party shooter: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Juggernaut and Gun Game - up to 8 players on one screen, online with friends over Steam, or against bots.
store.about:
Grab a controller. Pick a robot. One shot, then reload - make it count.
 Hking's Block Arena is a fast, readable party shooter for 2 to 12 players. Everyone is a chunky cube robot on one grid of crates, cases and lanes: dodge, line up a shot, duck behind cover while you reload, and laugh when your friend walks straight into a laser gate.
 Six modes
 Free-for-All  - every robot for itself. First to the target wins.

 Team Deathmatch  - two teams, one scoreboard. Pick your team's colour from 18.

 Capture the Flag - grab their flag, run it home while yours is safe. Carriers can't shoot, so guard them.

 King of the Hill - hold the glowing square to score. Every 30 seconds it moves.

 Juggernaut - the first KO makes you a horned giant: four hits to stop, it heals, it fires twice as fast. Only the Juggernaut scores. Take it down and it's you.

 Gun Game - climb eight weapons, from the minigun through the railgun, flamethrower and grenade launcher to the last one: the wrench.

 Couch first
 Up to 8 players on one screen : any mix of gamepads and keyboards - two players can share one keyboard. Plug a pad in mid-game and it just works. Bots (Easy, Normal or Hard) fill the empty seats and play every mode properly: they take the flag, hold the hill, hunt the Juggernaut. 

 Online with friends
 Host a Steam lobby - public, friends only or invite only, with an optional password - or play over your local network. Mix couch and online: four on your sofa against three at a friend's place, with bots for the rest. Dropped out? Rejoin into the same seat. Windows and Mac players play...

store.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
store.short: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.
store.about:
When the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune.  
 For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, the world is beginning to fall out of harmony—and the witch who has always protected it is growing ill.
 Her smallest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety.
 Playing as a brave little mouse, you’ll journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time.
 Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Explore alone or share the journey with friends in local split-screen and online co-op.

 Carry Her Kindness Into the Wild 
 The witch has spent her life caring for the world around her. Now, it is your turn to care for her and to continue the work she can no longer carry alone.
 Gather ingredients, brew magical potions, solve environmental puzzles, and lend a helping paw to animals and communities throughout the land. Each small act brings you closer to restoring its harmony and helping the witch who has long cared for you and all the forest’s inhabitants.

 See the World Through Tiny Eyes 
 Travel through a lovingly crafted playground inspired by the landscapes of Northern Sweden, from rugged mountain...

store.name: Infinity Nikki
store.short: Embark on a cozy open-world adventure filled with vast landscape, mystical puzzles and unexpected platforming challenges. Dress up not just for style, but to unravel hidden mysteries, interact with a vibrant environment, and experience the freedom to explore at your own pace.
store.about:
Infinity Nikki, developed by Infold Games, is the fifth installment in the Nikki series—a multi-platform open-world game built on the UE5 engine. It's an enchanting experience dedicated to creating and collecting beauty. Nikki, together with Momo, harnesses the power of Whim and ability outfits, discovering miracles along the way.

 New Main Story: Of Yesterday and Tomorrow 
 The Cicia main chapter is now open, along with two new regions to explore: Cicia and Ceremius. Accepting a special invitation from far away, Nikki enters a city woven from light and shadow as a new student at the Cicia Art Academy. Morning light falls through stained glass while shadow holds the long night... Follow the faint glow, and a story of art and belief is waiting to be told.

 Open World: Roam the City, Where Freedom Meets Art 
 Drive through a city of art, work out the riddles hidden in its scenery, and follow the strange clues scattered along its streets. Wander the shore, hit the fashion spots, or try your hand at running a business... Bring curiosity and imagination, and every trip out and every stop along the way will hold a surprise.

 Ability Outfits: A Power for Every Side of the Adventure 
 Leap across the rooftops as a mysterious Rogue, dig into your research and practice Alchemy, take on formidable foes, and feel the beauty of a fight all its own... Switch abilities whenever you like and explore the side of this world no one has shown you yet.

 Fashion Photography: Snap the Streets, Spark Your Style 
 Wear the colors you love and frame the views that move you. Youthful campus,...

store.name: Schedule I
store.short: From small-time dope pusher to kingpin - manufacture and distribute a range of drugs throughout the grungy city of Hyland Point. Expand your empire with properties, businesses, employees and more.
store.about:
Schedule I drugs, substances, or chemicals are defined as drugs with no currently accepted medical use and a high potential for abuse.
 - The Drug Enforcement Administration

You're a small-time drug dealer rolling into a fresh town with no cash, no product and no connections. Build your drug empire from the ground up in the grungy west-coast city of Hyland Point. Contend against intensifying law enforcement and deadly cartel competitors to expand your empire and reach the peak of the underworld.

Produce a range of drugs to satisfy your customers, each one with it's own unique production process. Discover special recipes to create new drug variants with special properties.

Walk, skate or drive throughout Hyland Point to get product into the hands of customers. Hire dealers to handle distribution for you.

Purchase new properties and hire employees to expand the scope and scale of your operations. Work with suppliers to build a fully automated production and distribution chain.

This is a dangerous line of work - you'll have to contend with increasing law enforcement , as well as deadly cartel competitors. Fight with fists, melee weapons or firearms .

A growing empire needs skilled management. Reach new heights in co-op multiplayer .

store.name: The Defiant
store.short: Heroic stories from the Chinese battlefields of World War II will be brought to life in the form of a FPS game.
store.about:
In those dark years, we had long grown accustomed to separation and death.
 The aggressors trampled our nation underfoot, leaving every inch of land engulfed in flames of war.
 We are the indomitable Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, operating in the snowy forests of Northeast China.
 We are the unyielding underground radio operators during the desperate Isolated Island period in Shanghai.
 We are the formidable Canal Detachment, a spearhead seeking swift justice.
 We are the Great Wall built with flesh and blood, standing majestically atop the Taihang Mountains of North China.
 Take up arms! We are The Defiant!
 Scene: Back to Moments of Crisis in History 
 The land we set foot upon is soaked with the blood of heroes.
 From the bleak, snowy forests of Northeast China, to the heavily fortified streets and alleys of occupied towns, and to the treacherous villages behind enemy lines... Here, you will be immersed in the somber, tragic and volatile atmosphere of China's War of Resistance.

 Level: An Immersive Experience 
 Here, every tree, every blade of grass, every brick and stone bears silent witness to that turbulent and heroic era.

 Firearm: Every weapon is an echo of history. 
 What you hold is not merely a weapon, but a historical relic carrying the memories of battles fought nearly a century ago.
 The game features dozens of firearms, including a wide range of rifles, submachine guns, pistols and machine guns. There are the classic Hanyang 88 rifle, the legendary Mauser C96 and SIG Bergmann Model 1920, along with many other weapons that emerged throughout modern...

store.name: My Time at Evershine
store.short: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!
store.about:
The third game of the My Time series. Evershine is a 3D open world Simulation RPG that takes place in a wholesome post-apocalyptic world 330 years after the Day of Calamity destroyed civilization. After surviving the nuclear winter for hundreds of years underground, people are finally picking up the piece again…

 The story takes place 3 years after the events of My Time at Sandrock and My Time at Portia. The Duvos Empire has taken over the Orzu Ruins which the Principality of Ethea also claims as their own, leading to a tense situation just north of the Alliance of Free Cities border in the Northern Eufaula region. The Alliance initiated the North Development Plan to move more settlers into the region in an effort to establish a new City State for a better defensive posture. It is calling on anyone interested in new opportunities to move to the region... 

 Develop romantic relationships with ten core, charming NPCs, including four chosen by backers' votes, and experience heart-pounding moments in every interaction. Beyond romance, you’ll meet over twenty unique NPCs, each with their own personality, ready to be part of your settlement. As you invite them in, you’ll forge deep, lasting bonds that grow stronger over time. 

 You’ll be playing as the Governor of the Evershine Settlement, recruited into the North Development Plan by the project’s Director, Mr. Gaudi. Your job will be to build up the infrastructure (either by prefabs or DIY), recruit the right settlers, tame the wilds, and build up your settlement into a strong presence next to the border. Along the way, you...

store.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
store.short: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.
store.about:
Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. 

 If you loved the first game, buckle up, you’re in for a hole lot more. New courses, new chaos, and enough ridiculous moments to make you question your friendship choices (in the best possible way).

 And if you’ve never played Golf With Your Friends before? Friend. Where have you been? Hiding in a bunker? It’s fine — you can jump straight in with everyone else soon. Very soon.

 Twelve. Players. Twelve. 
 More late nights. More arguments. More moments where someone sinks a hole-in-one by pure accident and won’t stop talking about it for the rest of the round. Whether you’re playing locally or cross platform, everyone’s invited.

 Introducing Chaos Mode, where the courses fight back! 
 Putt your way through remixed courses, where players who can adapt on the fly and embrace the chaos, come out on top. No two playthroughs are the same in this brand-new experience.

 Build the course of your (or someone else’s) nightmares 
 The revamped level editor (course creator) is now available on all platforms! Giving you more tools, more options, and more power to create courses that your friends will either applaud or never forgive you for. Build it, share it and take zero responsibility for what happens next.

 Golf With Your Friends 2. More modes, more mayhem, more reasons to question your life choices.
 Wishlist now.

store.name: Erosion
store.short: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?
store.about:
Your daughter's been kidnapped by a warlord and dragged into the mysterious living Pillar that warps time itself. You're gonna get her back. The catch? When you die, the world jumps forward a decade, aging your daughter and changing the world around you.

 Die in a dungeon? Wake up ten years later. That peaceful farm is now a cultist compound worshipping the Great Ol' Rooster. That store owner you helped? They've built an empire. Your choices permeate across decades, transforming factions, townsfolk, and entire regions. Once you’ve mastered full timeline control, you can rewrite every possible future.

 Explore a massive wasteland overworld where you can join a cult, steal a slick new ride, and gamble your hard-earned Cheddar away at the Al Cashino. Go sand fishing for buried creatures, hunt bounties, try your luck in duels, or just race trucks through the salt flats. Complete quests to unlock permanent upgrades and reshape the future.

 Collect dozens of weapons from ritual bows that draw their strength from your blood, to homing smart guns, to the legendary Ebony Rooster that shoots bouncy eggs. Experiment with 100+ skills and modifiers to create absurd synergies. Command an army of cats. Deploy orbital turrets. Clone yourself. The build possibilities are endless.

 Destructible voxel environments mean cover is temporary and collateral damage is guaranteed. Blow up walls, turn locations into rubble, and flip the poker table! Physics-driven destruction meets bullet-hell combat for that sweet, sweet emergent mayhem.

store.name: Sandcastle
store.short: On a sun-warmed tropical shore, quietly craft a mighty sandcastle. Carve moats, raise towers and walls, then embellish with driftwood, pebbles, shells and seaweed. Gentle tides, soft surf and a calming color palette turn every build into a peaceful, relaxing moment.
store.about:
Sandcastle is the ultimate sandbox game. Unlock a variety of tools to gather wet sand, shape towering walls, carve intricate battlements, and engineer elaborate moats designed to withstand or divert the encroaching waves.

 No rush, just relax 
 There are no ticking clocks. Only the slow rhythm of the tide and the warm glow of the sun. Discover secret treasures washed ashore or buried deep into the sand, each adding a touch of personality to your sandy masterpiece.

 Physics simulation 
 Beneath the whimsy lies a unique water and sand physics simulation that brings your creations to life. Sand compacts, crumbles, and holds its shape depending on moisture and pressure, while waves flow, pool, and gently erode your walls just as they would in reality. Carve too thin and a tower may slump; reinforce with damp sand and it will stand proud against the tide. The result is a tactile, authentic sand castle crafting experience that feels just like building one on a real beach: sun-warmed, hands-on, and wonderfully satisfying.

 Beach customization 
 Collect starfishes to unlock customization options: Sand type, beach layout, size... Give your beach its own character and charm. Peaceful atolls ringed by turquoise waters, quiet lagoons with gentle shallows, sweeping sand barriers shaped by the breeze, and winding deltas where little streams meet the sea. Every shoreline offers a fresh canvas, inviting you to build, decorate, and relax in a new seaside setting.

 Features 
 Beaches with unique water and sand physic simulation

 Many tools to craft your castle with precision

 10...

store.name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
store.short: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.
store.about:
As the KINGDOM HEARTS series approaches its 25th anniversary, a new adventure begins.

 Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return from this modern metropolis to his own world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld in hopes of finding a clue to his whereabouts.

 The dynamic, fast-paced battle system allows you to effortlessly combine attacks and magic, as well as build combos with a brand-new battle feature.

 Change the Keyblade Sora wields to unleash unique attacks, matching the flow of battle to your own strategies and play style.

store.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure
store.short: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.
store.about:
Embark on a brand new adventure in Melvor Idle 2! 
 Melvor Idle 2  expands upon the beloved foundations of its predecessor and the wider world, to bring a deeper, richer, and more refined idle gaming experience. This  single-player  adventure lets you explore an ever-growing world of skills, combat, and strategy at your own pace.
 Whether you're a veteran of idle games, a fan of the original Melvor or a maxxed out RuneScape completionist,  Melvor Idle 2  offers a fresh adventure that balances depth with accessibility. It's the ultimate idle RPG for both busy adventurers and those ready to immerse themselves in a constantly evolving world

 Master Melvor’s many unique skills with just a click or a tap. Melvor Idle 2 is a feature-rich, idle/incremental game combining a distinctly RuneScape feel with a fresh gameplay experience. Maxing your skills has never been more zen! If you are looking for a deep but accessible adventure that easily fits around a busy lifestyle, then Melvor Idle 2 is an idle experience unlike any other.
 Every skill in this game serves a purpose, interacting with the others in interesting ways. This means all the hard work you put into one skill will in turn benefit others. What strategy will you conjure to achieve maximum skillage?
 It doesn’t just end with Woodcutting, Smithing, Cooking and Farming either – take your finely honed tapping abilities into battle and face off against monsters using your Melee, Ranged and Magic skills. Conquering brutal dungeons and toppling boisterous bosses has never been quite like this before…
 In addition to the skills...

store.name: Planet Zoo 2
store.short: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.
store.about:
Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2 – the sequel to the beloved zoo simulation game. Let your creativity soar by constructing and managing distinctive zoos around the world, full of awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species for the first time. Plus, take the next step in animal conservation and release your species into customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves. 

 Discover a diverse roster of animal species, each with their own needs & behaviours. New faces join familiar favourites like the Lion and Western Chimpanzee to create iconic zoo rosters in jaw-dropping detail. 

 Construct beautiful habitats for your animals to thrive in as they interact with the world around them in authentic ways. From authentic herding behaviours to grazing on the vegetation you provide for them. Experience a generational leap of animal detail and immersion with incredible natural movements and expressive emotions that bring each animal to life like never before. 

 Prepare your diving suit! Fully aquatic species make a splash in their stunning debut! Build custom spectacular freshwater or saltwater aquariums to home an exciting line-up of delightful swimming animals. A new world beneath the water awaits, filled with colourful shoals of fish, Blacktip Reef Sharks, Hawksbill Turtles and so many more! 

 Soar to great heights with a diverse mix of bright & brilliant fully flying birds including the vibrant Toco Toucan and majestic Secretarybird. House your birds in fully customisable aviaries built from barriers, support poles and dynamic mesh covers, allowing them to...

store.name: Lucky Scoop
store.short: Run a cozy gift shop where every scoop counts! Collect colorful gems, fulfill customer orders, solve satisfying 3D packing puzzles, upgrade your shop, and turn your little business into something special.
store.about:
Welcome to LUCKY SCOOP!
 A cozy little shop. A spoonful of gems. The perfect gift!
 LUCKY SCOOP is a cozy shop simulator where you scoop colorful gems, prepare gifts for your customers, and carefully pack every order. Manage your own gift shop, discover what your customers want, upgrade your workspace, and grow your business one order at a time.
 🎁 Scoop, Match & Create

 Every order begins with a letter from a customer. Read their request, grab your spoon, and scoop up colorful gems to find the right gifts.
 Pay attention to the details! Your customers may have specific preferences, including their favorite colors. Make the right choices to earn extra tips and keep your customers happy.
 📦 Pack Every Gift Your Way

 Packing is a puzzle of its own!
 Arrange gifts inside a box using a 3D grid. Rotate items, find the right positions, and make the most of the available space. Some orders require multiple layers, so plan carefully to fit everything inside.
 Pack efficiently to earn stars and extra rewards. Every box is a new spatial puzzle waiting to be solved!
 💌 Get to Know Your Customers
 Meet a cast of regular customers, each with their own orders and preferences.
 Complete their requests, pay attention to what they want, and earn money by preparing the right gifts. As you gain experience, orders become more demanding, giving you new challenges to master.
 🛠️ Upgrade Your Shop
 Use your earnings to improve your workspace and make your daily routine more efficient.
 Upgrade your hands to carry multiple items of the same type at once.

 Expand your shelves to store more...

store.name: Am I Nima
store.short: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.
store.about:
You don't remember who you are. Act like her. Talk like her. 
 Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you play as Nima, a girl who has lost all her memories and is being trapped in the basement by her mother. To escape, all you have to do is pass your mom’s tests and convince her that you really are her daughter.
 As you explore, you uncover words tied to the objects around you: a worn-out plushie, a locked drawer, an old note scribbled in hurried handwriting. These words represent Nima's thoughts and emotions, giving you a peek into how Nima thinks and feels.

 However, to really find the truth, you must actively combine words in Nima's mind, experimenting with different pairings to unlock deeper meanings and access buried memories. 
 When it comes to the tests, you’ll use your new found words to direct the conversation. Choose your words carefully, as they will change how Nima responds to her mom. Will you tell her what she wants to hear? Or will you probe her for the truth? 

 The more you uncover, the more questions arise: Why has your mother locked you in the basement? What do these tests mean? And are you really Nima?

store.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
store.short: Umamusume: Pretty Derby, winner of Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025, is ready to race! Scout featured trainees and supporters as you navigate the immersive sports life simulation through the game's in-depth training system and top-of-the-line 3D graphics!
store.about:
-- Umamusume. They are born to run. They inherit otherworldly names, and are inspirited by dreams most dramatic and wonderful. Now, they run ever forward. That, is their destiny. No one knows how the races that lie in their futures will end. Even so, they continue to run, aiming only toward the goal in front of them.
 -- Each and every one of the runners sports a unique charm. It's up to you, the trainer, to lead them down the path of victory! You have but one goal—raise your Umamusume to her fullest potential and help turn her greatest dreams into reality. In order to reach these newfound heights, it's your job to participate in—and win—as many races as possible! Triumph awaits those who train hard and work to communicate. Only by cooperating will you take the crown!
 -- Experience the thrilling stories of historic racers, such as:
 Special Week (Voice: Azumi Waki)
 Silence Suzuka (Voice: Marika Kono)
 Tokai Teio (Voice: Machico)
 Oguri Cap (Voice: Tomoyo Takayanagi)
 Gold Ship (Voice: Hitomi Ueda)
 Vodka (Voice: Ayaka Ohashi)
 Daiwa Scarlet (Voice: Chisa Kimura)
 Mejiro McQueen (Voice: Saori Onishi)
 Symboli Rudolf (Voice: Azusa Tadokoro)
 Rice Shower (Voice: Manaka Iwami)
 Haru Urara (Voice: Yukina Shuto)
 Nice Nature (Voice: Kaori Maeda)
 ...and so many more—over 20 Umamusume are searching for a trainer to help them achieve their goals!
 -- Cheer for your favorite Umamusume and immerse yourself in exhilarating races and stunning performances in breathtaking 3D graphics. Up to 18 Umamusume compete in races against each other for first place—watch them go as you tune in...

store.name: Atomic Heart: The CUBE
store.short: The CUBE is a shared-world RPG shooter set in the Atomic Heart universe. Explore the vast, rotating Cube, where each turn changes its world, threats, and conditions you face. Make a home on the Vine, go on scientific expeditions, fight paradoxical bosses. Adapt and unite to solve the Cube's mystery.
store.about: The CUBE is a multiplayer RPG-shooter that blends unique world-building, an intriguing narrative, and exciting quests into one game. A living world full of memorable characters, diverse biomes, and tons of enemies, including powerful bosses, awaits you.

store.name: EXODUS
store.short: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

store.name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
store.short: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.
store.about:
Ten years ago, a mysterious giant labyrinth suddenly appeared on the surface of the world. It stretched endlessly into the depths, filled with ancient ruins and terrifying monsters. Adventurers from every land flocked to explore it, chasing fame and fortune in this new age of glory.
 But for you, the labyrinth known as the “Abyss” is not just an adventure. It is your only hope.
 Your beloved sister, Mio, suffers from a rare illness that no doctor can cure. The only clue to saving her lies somewhere deep within the Abyss. Every day, you descend alone into its dark dungeons, risking your life for her sake while she waits patiently at home.
 As the days pass, the Abyss only grows more dangerous.
 Will you find the cure before it is too late, or will the depths claim you first?

 This is primarily a sister life-sim. Spend time with Mio at home: chatting, watching anime, cooking, and sharing the small joys of daily life, with fully animated and voiced scenes. Your care choices shape her mood and unlock new absolutely wholesome events!
 When it is time to pursue the cure, head into the Abyss for focused roguelite runs. Battle monsters, learn skills, gather loot, and push a little deeper before returning home. Each outing supports your simple life together, and each evening brings you closer to the cure Mio needs.

 Life with your Sister 
 After adventuring, return home to enjoy simple life downtime. Whip up meals with gathered ingredients, share adventure tales, play games, or snooze side by side! As you get closer, unlock more interactions!
 Animations 
 Enjoy a wide range of...

store.name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
store.short: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.
store.about:
Welcome to Los Santos
 When a young street hustler, a retired bank robber, and a terrifying psychopath find themselves entangled with some of the most frightening and deranged elements of the criminal underworld, the U.S. government, and the entertainment industry, they must pull off a series of dangerous heists to survive in a ruthless city in which they can trust nobody — least of all each other.
 Current PC players can transfer both GTAV Story Mode progress and GTA Online characters and progression with a one-time migration from the legacy version of GTAV to GTAV Enhanced. 
 Stunning Visuals
 Enhanced levels of fidelity and performance with new graphics modes including ray tracing features such as ambient occlusion and global illumination, ray traced shadows and reflections, support for AMD FSR and NVIDIA DLSS, and more.*
 Faster Loading
 Quicker access to the action as the world of Los Santos and Blaine County load in faster than ever before by using SSD and DirectStorage on supported devices.
 Immersive Controls
 Feel new levels of responsiveness with dynamic resistance via the Adaptive Triggers on the DualSense™ wireless controller, from directional damage to weather effects, rough road surfaces to explosions, and much more.*
 3D Audio
 Enhanced audio with support for Dolby Atmos and improved fidelity of speech, cinematics, and music.* Hear the sounds of the world with pinpoint precision: the throttle of a stolen supercar, the rattle of neighboring gunfire, the roar of a helicopter overhead, and more.
 Grand Theft Auto Online
 Experience GTA Online, a dynamic and...

store.name: R.E.P.O.
store.short: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.
store.about:
R.E.P.O. is an online co-op horror game featuring physics, proximity voice chat and scary monsters. You and up to 5 friends can venture into terrifying environments to extract valuable objects using your physics-based grabbing tool.

 Even the monsters are affected by Newton's law of gravity! 
Under the employ of a mysterious computer intelligence. It is your job to locate, transport and extract valuable items from the haunted remains of a long lost humanity.

 ...but know when to stay quiet. 
Transport anything from heavy pianos to fragile ceramics and use teamwork to make sure that the precious cargo will safely reach its destination.

 Robotic enhancements increase your chances! 
Use your hard earned cash [SURPLUS] to purchase upgrades and weapons from your heartless [GENEROUS] creator.

store.name: Sort It Together
store.short: PLAY FOR FREE WITH FRIENDS! Clean, sort, and restore messy places together. Enjoy a relaxing tidy-up experience or turn up the chaos! Take on jobs, earn money, and build your own cleaning business. Just leave every place cleaner than you found it. How hard could that be?
store.about:
Sort It Together is a free-to-play, first-person tidy-up game you can play solo or with friends. Take on jobs, clean up messy spaces, and put everything back where it belongs. If you find a wind-up car along the way, give it a twist and see if it drives. The shelf can wait.
 Pick It Up and See What It Does
 Remember those old point-and-click adventures where you'd click on everything just to see what happened? We wanted to bring a bit of that curiosity to the things you handle on a job. Plenty of items already have little interactions to discover, and each has its own distinct sound. We'll keep adding more of those little surprises throughout Early Access. Help us make the game better! :)
 Pick Your Job and Set the Pace
 Take on four jobs at launch , two of which offer both Relaxation and After Hours .
 Relaxation is the laid-back shift. Your shipment is already waiting, random events are switched off, and you can clean and sort at your own pace. There are few things more satisfying than finding that last missing item behind the counter and sliding it into place.

 After Hours adds a few surprises. Each job has its own random events, items can break, and stock arrives in smaller batches. You'll load the truck yourself and decide which batches to call in and when. Keep an eye on your shelves. And maybe on whatever just moved outside.

 Unique Tools, Hazards & Level Dynamics 
 Every map and location comes with its own distinct atmosphere, custom tools, and specific play loops:
 Location-Specific Tools: Use map-tailored equipment to clear jobs faster - like pushing a shopping...

store.name: Hello Sunshine
store.short: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.
store.about:
"They sold us a brighter future. They delivered the end of the world." 
 Hello Sunshine is a mystery survival RPG set in the sun-scorched ruins of a corporate empire. You play the final employee . Your mission: reach the tower at the end of the road, and help decide the fate of what remains of this world.
 To survive the blistering heat and deadly sun, you'll walk in the shadow of a towering war machine, scavenging for supplies and searching for pieces to the puzzle.
 When the sun sets and the robot stops to charge, you'll  make camp, craft new gear, and repair your mechanical guardian. But the wasteland is freezing cold at night. Stay close to the robot to keep warm.
 The journey to the tower is long. You won't make it on your own. As the sun rises, the robot starts walking. Follow — and stay alive until the end of the road. 

 "Walk in the shadow of a giant robot" 
 The sun is your enemy. The robot’s shadow provides protection from the heat and radiation. Stay in the shade or risk exposure — but the further into the wasteland you venture, the greater the rewards.
 "Survive the freezing nights" 
 The wasteland turns bitterly cold after sundown. After the robot stops to recharge at a Sunshine Service Station, you must stay close to keep warm. Make camp, cook food, craft new gear, upgrade your equipment — and keep an eye out for visiting strangers, for appearances can deceive.

 "Repair, customise, upgrade your mobile base" 
 The wandering robot is more than a companion — it’s your lifeline. Enhance it with improved sensors, defensive systems, and mechanical upgrades. Add...

store.name: Bergfried
store.short: Build realistic medieval castles and defend them against rival knights. Bergfried is a strategy game featuring organic castle building and tactical siege battles. Manage your lands, plan your defenses and lead your troops to victory!
store.about:
Bergfried is a strategy game set in a colorful, believable medieval world, where you build and defend unique, organic castles.
Prepare layered defenses and command your troops to withstand enemy attacks. Expand strategically and manage your resources carefully to survive prolonged sieges.

 Bergfried offers an organic castle-building experience on a unique grid that captures the irregular shapes of European castles from the high and late middle ages.

 Build castles that follow the contours of the landscape, taking full advantage of natural defenses or impose strict geometric layouts to fortify your domain.
 Plan your defenses carefully to withstand attacking armies and long sieges.
 Strategically place towers and gatehouses, and position troops on the ramparts.

 Gather resources and manage your economy to construct castles, villages and towns.
 Expand your territory to gain control of key resources and strengthen your position.
 Adapt to dynamic events like the market day, tournaments or the king visiting your castle.

 Command your troops in tactical field battles and intense castle sieges.
 Recruit archers, crossbowmen, spearmen, men-at-arms, and knights.
 Use the tactical pause feature to issue commands without time pressure.

store.name: Grave Seasons
store.short: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.
store.about:
Grave Seasons is an isometric pixel murder mystery farming/life sim, where you play the role of an escaped convict attempting to live peacefully in the small mountainside town of Ashenridge. Unfortunately, things take a turn for the worse when a supernatural serial killer begins attacking your fellow neighbors. 

 Grave Seasons is a narrative-driven supernatural horror wrapped lovingly in a farming/life sim. You will have one year to protect victims from a supernatural serial killer that lurks in town. Using farming , foraging , crafting and investigation , you are tasked with discovering methods that ward off monsters. Unravel the truth behind the supernatural murders, discover the secrets the residents of Ashenridge keep hidden away, and save those that you can…

 Or let chaos reign. The choice is yours.  

 Just know that each decision has its consequences, both positive and negative. Unlock new stories upon the death of characters, discover storylines with their survival. Decisions are checked (and autosaved) to weave a story of your time in Ashenridge. With only a year, how will you leave your mark?

 Inspired by farming sims of old, your farm in Ashenridge sits at the very top of the mountain. There you can: 
 Farm and grow seasonal crops using different types of farm plots

 Craft recipes in your kitchen or your shed, as well as mysterious occult items that could save potential victims of the killer

 Upgrade your tools and the buildings on your farm and select potential aesthetic customization options

 Unearth pieces of history in Ashenridge as you farm, harvest...

store.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
store.short: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.
store.about:
Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. ◆ Cinematic pixel art
What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive. ◆ A return to the familiar
A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more. ◆ Strategic turn-based battles
Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices. ◆ FINAL FANTASY legends
Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization. ◆ Hours of side content to discover
The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.

store.name: Stage Fright
store.short: From the makers of OVERCOOKED! comes an all new co-operative experience. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery.
store.about:
From the creators of the worldwide sensation OVERCOOKED! comes “Stage Fright”, an all new co-operative experience for 2 players. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery. 

 A Co-Op Adventure ...
 Stage Fright is built from the ground up as a co-operative experience, bursting with Overcooked-style chaotic moments and escape room-esque co-operation. Play online or better still, side-by-side.

 ... with Pick-up-and-play Accessibility ...
 Designed with communication and team work in mind and instantly accessible to a wide array of players. The challenge is in the mind, not the finger-tips!

 ... in an Intriguing and Mysterious Town
 Guide Drew, Blake and Charlie through a charming coming-of-age story with real heart and memorable characters. Switch between pairs of kids as the story unravels from two unique perspectives.

store.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
store.short: Sam – with companions by his side – sets out on a new journey to save humanity from extinction. Join them as they traverse a world beset by otherworldly enemies, obstacles and a haunting question: should we have connected?
store.about:
From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes an emotionally charged evolution of this genre-defying experience. In bringing this title to PC, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS worked with Nixxes Software to deliver the definitive version of the critically acclaimed console release.
 Unique and realistic world 
 In the expansive open world of DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH, countless areas with vastly different terrains and environments are seamlessly connected, and the changing time, weather and nature itself provide a variety of landscapes and challenges.

 Evolved and more flexible action 
 There are various obstacles that will prevent Sam from completing his mission. Face them head-on, sneak around, or completely avoid dangerous areas. Choose your approach to any situation.

 A deep and captivating story 
 Eleven months after the events of the original DEATH STRANDING, rejoin Sam and his companions on a new journey to save humanity from extinction and discover the answer to this haunting question: Should we have connected?

 Go beyond the UCA 
 Join Sam for the next chapter of his journey as he attempts to connect Australia to the Chiral Network. Navigate a living environment through day and night cycles, natural disasters – including earthquakes, sandstorms and forest fires – and Timefall, a rain that instantly ages everything it touches.
 To traverse this dangerous landscape, you’ll need to build new types of infrastructure, master specialized equipment and confront (or evade) the otherworldly creatures that roam the fractured world.

 Fight for the future 
 Face enigmatic Mech...

store.name: Mimic Alert
store.short: A co-op horror game where anything can be a mimic. Memorize the building by day, hunt by night with a friend — or play PvP: one Mimic Queen against up to four humans.
store.about:
Mimic Alert is a first-person co-op horror game in the spirit of the PS1 era. You are the new hire of an agency that clears mimics out of a quarantined research zone — things that can take the shape of anything: a chair, a crate, a cat, a person.

 DAY AND NIGHT
 Every shift starts in daylight. Walk the site and learn it: what stands where, how many chairs sit at the table, which crates are stacked by the wall. Talk to the staff. Buy what you need at the supply stand.
 Then the gate closes and the power goes out. You have a torch, a revolver and six rounds in the cylinder. Somewhere in the dark the mimics have taken the shape of ordinary things — some new, some in place of what was there. Find what changed and shoot it. Shoot the wrong thing and you pay for it.

 PLAY TOGETHER
 Bring a friend through Steam and play the whole campaign as a pair, with its own progress and smarter mimics. Or take on the Challenge: a random site, a bigger building, more mimics and 200 credits to spend. Cover each other's back — the mimics can catch either of you. And wear a TV, a bucket or a cat on your head while you do it.
 PVP: THE MIMIC QUEEN
 One player is the Queen, up to four are humans, one night in a big building. She becomes any object, cat or person, lunges from her disguise, sets traps, infects the staff and turns humans into her mimics. The humans have to finish their tasks, open a gate and get out — or kill her. Public lobbies, proximity voice chat.
 TRUST NO ONE
 Scientists, technicians and nurses sit out the night with you. Ask them about themselves by day and remember the...

store.name: Paradise
store.short: PARADISE is a free-to-play life simulation game with limitless possibilities, realistic graphics, and advanced AI. Endless World, Endless Play.
store.about:
Limitless possibilities 
 PARADISE® is a life simulation game with limitless possibilities. 
Play with your friends, engage in shootouts, race cars, complete daily missions, and reach the apex of life. Earn money and buy what you want, from real estate to fancy clothes. 
Endless World, Endless Play.
 AI-Powered NPCs 

 Every NPC in the open world is more than just a background character. You can communicate with them using chat or voice. They have real voices, emotions, and reactions to your actions, making them behave like true living people. Each NPC has their own backstory, job, and daily routine.
 Real-World Simulation 
 In PARADISE, we have recreated an entire island nation with every attribute of the real world, ranging from cityscapes with skyscrapers and bustling urban areas to serene oceans, beaches, and lush tropical forests. The game features different districts and natural zones, each meticulously detailed to enhance realism. 
 Our world is populated with diverse races and body types, bustling with cars that adhere to traffic laws, and vibrant with shops, nightclubs, and industrial properties.
 Players can engage in a realistic economy with the in-game currency, PAR, face consequences of crimes, and pursue relationships, mirroring the complexities of real life.

store.name: THE LIFT: Supernatural Handyman Simulator
store.short: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.
store.about:
The Institute was humanity's most advanced research facility – until a catastrophic incident left it drifting through the void, plagued by cosmic decay and slowly fading into oblivion along with its dark secrets. 
 Awakened from stasis, you must restore the Institute and uncover what went wrong. 
 The Lift is a first-person simulator where satisfying handyman gameplay meets a mysterious sci-fi story . 

 Every floor is a massive renovation project with unique challenges. Work at your own pace, tackling everything from basic furniture repairs to complex electrical engineering projects. Use a variety of gadgets, craft what you need, and bring the Institute back to its former glory.

 Use the Lift as your mobile base while travelling across the Institute. Explore multiple biomes, unlock hidden areas, meet unforgettable characters, and complete their quests. Piece together the mind-bending truth behind the incident that changed everything.

 Breathe life back into dozens of intricate devices from vending machines and generators to satellite dishes and supercomputers. Build circuits with multiple components, identify fault currents, route cables, manage power supply, and generate torque to repair each system.
 KEY FEATURES 
 - Satisfying handyman simulator + immersive narrative-driven adventure
 - Massive research complex to explore and renovate
 - Complex electrical engineering projects
 - Your own toolbox full of weird but useful gadgets 
 - Recycling-based crafting system
 - Highly interactive world inspired by Soviet retrofuturism
 - Memorable, fully voiced characters with...

store.name: Tides of Annihilation
store.short: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.
store.about:
The world has been left fractured by a sudden invasion from The Otherworld. As Gwendolyn, a survivor of the calamity, you will venture through a broken London where reality and fantasy bleed into one another, confront foes from beyond, and unveil the secrets of both worlds.
 Save a Shattered London on the Brink of Annihilation 
 The Otherworld, of unknown origin, has descended upon London without warning. Streets and landmarks twist and crumble without end. The whole city is being torn asunder, slowly merging into The Otherworld.
 As the one who endured it all, you will face the invasion head-on, delve through richly layered levels, unearth the truth of the catastrophe, and find a way to save your family, the city, and perhaps the entire world.

 Claim the Power of Knights, Forge Your Own Knight Set 
 You will encounter over a dozen legendary Knights of the Round Table drawn from Arthurian legend on your journey. Each wields distinct combat roles and abilities — ranging from vanguard charges and steadfast defense to explosive burst damage.
 You can assemble your knight set according to tactical needs or personal preference, crafting diverse combat builds. This not only yields fluid, ever-shifting combo chains but also gives rise to profound tactical depth.
 You will reshape battlefield dynamics, and never fight alone again.

 Encounter the Spectacular Colossal Knights Roaming the World 
 Towering like mountains, the Colossal Knights wander between worlds. They are far more than majestic sights to be admired from afar — they are vast, silent arenas waiting to be stepped...

store.name: ReVamp
store.short: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.
store.about:
You are Dracula. Not a monster in the shadows, but the sovereign of a castle under siege. Cursed by Achlys, goddess of the night, you are condemned to defend your throne without end. Mortals return night after night, and every siege becomes another chapter in an eternal war of blood and sacrifice. But you do not merely watch from afar. You move through your halls, strike down invaders with devastating abilities, and tip the balance of battle when your forces begin to falter. All for the love that was taken from you.

 The castle is yours to shape. Expand it room by room, reconfigure its structure between attacks, and transform open halls into calculated gauntlets. Each room alters the flow of battle, forcing invaders into choke points, layered defenses, and brutal confrontations. Invest the blood of fallen mortals to strengthen your fortress, empowering chambers, enhancing effects, and acquiring new units. With every placement and every upgrade, the labyrinth deepens, becoming less a structure… and more a weapon.

 Mortals march in waves, blinded by a foolish sense of justice. Armored knights, unyielding barbarians, or zealous priests, each deserving a punishment tailored to their arrogance. Your answer? An army of the night. Skeletal swordsmen and archers form disciplined ranks, while swarming rats flood narrow corridors and winged harpies strike from above.

 When your legion wavers, step into the fray yourself. Move through the castle as Dracula and unleash devastating special abilities, and turn certain defeat into victory. The better you build, the more lethal you...

store.name: Fearwoods
store.short: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.
store.about:
FEARWOODS 
 A co-op survival horror where the forest becomes your enemy.
 Step into the cursed woods. Silence lives here. And the shadow watches.
 Will you save Aveline… or condemn her forever?

 Explore. 
 The forest breathes. The fog thickens.
 Every step echoes, as if something listens.
 Sometimes you hear whispers. Sometimes it’s just the wind... or maybe not.
 The light flickers. The ground creaks.
 You are not alone among these trees.
 Find your path between fear and silence. 
 Every trail could be your last.

 Find. 
 Everything matters – a torn notebook, a glint of metal, a voice on the radio. 
 Search for GPS fragments, Aveline’s journal, and the clues that lead deep into the cursed forest. 
 The more you discover, the less you want to know.
 Each piece of the story brings you closer to the truth.
 Or closer to something that cannot be stopped.

 Face it. 
 Silence shatters.
 Something steps out from the dark.
 It doesn’t breathe. It doesn’t blink.
 It just watches.
 Light is your life.
 But even that won’t always save you.
 Not every fight is meant to be won – sometimes survival means running.
 Hide. Turn off your flashlight. Don’t move.
 The demon senses fear. And it feeds on it.

 See what remains. 
 The door opens slowly. The smell of blood, smoke, and ash.
 Signs of struggle. Bodies.
 A mark on the wall – the same one you’ve seen before.
 You know it’s the demon’s work.
 But why? Who was it looking for?
 You keep moving forward, because there’s no other choice.
 Only answers might lead to escape.
 Survive together. 
 Three players. One night.
 Each of you...

store.name: Till the End
store.short: Earth has fallen. Recruit survivors in the ruins, activate their unique Power Suits, and fight back against endless alien hordes in this solo-developed sci-fi roguelite wave shooter. Master Bushido blades, Centurion tanks, or Magi blasts — become unstoppable.
store.about:
One-time purchase • DRM-free • No microtransactions

FAST PACED AND PUNISHING! SURVIVE TILL THE END. 
 Solo-developed by one person.
 Gameplay Features 
 Brutal Combat & Power Suits 
 Use 3 unique Power Suits: Bushido the deadly sword master, Centurion the ballistics expert, and Magi the ki-blast caster. Combine them with a wide variety of weapons to survive intense enemy waves, mini-bosses, and massive boss fights. Recruit & Unlock Playable Characters 
 Complete missions for shopkeepers to recruit survivors as playable characters. Each one brings their own personality, backstory, and unique Power Suit.

 Open Sandbox City 
 Explore a large ruined city. Shops are scattered throughout. Visit them anytime to spend resources and accept new missions.  
 Meta Progression 
 Level up each character individually with XP Data Banks and permanent upgrades.

 "If you're out there…we need you. Let's take back our home."

store.name: One More Plate!
store.short: Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu! Catch, balance, roll or fling food using anything from swords to croissants and tuna fish. Play solo or with a friend locally or via Steam Remote Play Together.
store.about:
Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to a bizarre cast of Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu, in this chaotic physics-based party game. Solo or with a friend, catch, balance, and fling food with a collection of absurd, anything-but-proper plates. Everything obeys physics; nothing obeys you.

 Serve the monsters using an increasingly absurd collection of plates and makeshift serving tools, from humble ladles and buttery croissants to enormous legendary swords. Every plate has its own shape, friction, weight, and bounce, turning even a familiar level into a fresh disaster. 

 Play through the campaign solo, or play with a friend in local co-op or versus modes, with support for Steam Remote Play Together.
 Customer satisfaction is mandatory. Employee survival is considered a bonus! 

 Catch. Balance. Feed. 
 Read each monster’s order, catch the correct food, and keep it stable long enough to make the throw. Serve too many wrong orders, and your shift—and possibly your life—is over.
 Every Plate Is a New Physics Problem 
 Bowls, platters, ladles, croissants, swords, and other objects that probably should not qualify as dinnerware all behave differently. Learn their weight, friction, and bounce—or watch dinner roll straight off the edge.

 A Whole Planet of Hungry Customers
