 Serve increasingly strange Glutton Monsters across colourful kitchens, ancient jungles, travelling circuses, and other suspiciously cheerful locations. Each level introduces new hazards, movement patterns, and ways for your carefully prepared meal to escape.

 Serve Alone or Make a Mess Together 
...

store.name: Chronocracy
store.short: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?
store.about:
Chronocracy is an exciting real-time strategy game where you'll lead a small civilization, developing its society and surviving on a whimsical flat earth disk.

 Lead your tribe, wisely allocate forces and resources to fend off neighboring attacks, uncover secrets hidden in time, and save your civilization from destruction. 

 Explore both the surface and underground depths, build mines, and gather rare resources.

 Develop your cities and master the planet.

 Harness technologies ranging from agriculture to advanced scientific achievements.

 Discover new tools for efficient management of resources and settlements.

 Assemble a powerful army, from squads of archers and spearmen to modern helicopters and megatitans! 

 Form diplomatic alliances with other peoples.

 Travel through time to rewrite the destiny of your tribe.

 Lead one of three tribes and bring it to greatness by building a network of prosperous cities and exploring the entire planet! Start with a town hall and a handful of loyal followers, and create a highly developed civilization ready to face not only fluffy plump birds but also fearsome invaders.

 Hire scholars and research the sciences to unlock new technologies and buildings. More than 15 unique buildings await you, each bringing your civilization closer to planetary greatness. Develop basic infrastructure: build housing, ensure food and resource production. Create economic buildings for trade, extraction of rare materials, and production of unique resources. Build powerful military structures to defend your lands and arm your people, from bows and...

store.name: Trash Day
store.short: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure for up to 6 players. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen wagon, and haul it to Raccoon Paradise. Live your best raccoon life.
store.about:
Every raccoon dreams of Raccoon Paradise. Unfortunately, you and your friends are currently locked up in Animal Control. 
 Break out, steal a wagon, load it with the finest trash you can find, and haul it across six areas to get there. Played the demo? That was only one area! The full game adds five more, new obstacles, and a full soundtrack. Online co-op for up to 6 players. You technically can play solo… but the wagon is a lot for one raccoon.

 The path ahead is tricky and full of challenges! Push and steer the wagon with up to five friends and clear the path ahead. Lose a wheel? Put it back on. Flip it? Flip it back. Distract animals on their own turf!

 Use bungee cords, planks, and more to propel your wagon over, under, and through traffic, bear traps, rockslides, and a river. Good plan. Terrible execution.

 Knock over trash cans, search dumpsters, and scour everything from Animal Control, through the wilderness, on the way to the junkyard for helpful items as well as valuable trash.

 Climb, scurry, and scamper your way through the world. Wear a hat. Stack your friends. Launch one off a seesaw. Play pattycake with a friend. Eat some junk.

 Made by Off By One Games, a small team with over a decade of experience working together on Rocket League.

copies.name: Survive Freddy Fazbear Trash Can The Killer!🧸

store.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
store.short: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.
store.about:
Discover an enhanced Crimson Desert, featuring new cutscenes and story moments, plus expanded voice-over and language support. ​Begin the adventure loved by millions, refined since launch with a wealth of updates, including new content, mounts, pets, customization options, various quality-of-life improvements, and more. ​

 On the continent of Pywel, the rival factions of Pailune maintained a tense balance. At Kliff's side stood his steadfast Greymane comrades, but a devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent.
 Kliff—having lost his family in all but name—is determined to reunite with the survivors and rebuild the faction.
 But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff will meet those who seek to upend the very order of the continent and face a mission unlike any he has ever known.

 Welcome to Pywel. 
 Here you'll find stretches of natural beauty and wilderness—from green plains and woods to arid deserts and rugged mountains—alongside bustling cities and quiet hamlets inhabited by residents from all walks of life. Between destinations, you will come across landmarks, ancient ruins, hidden treasures, and other points of interest that will draw your curisoity to wander. Your journey will also inevitably take you skyward to the mysterious realm known as the Abyss, where a mystical imbalance endangering the world must be restored.

 The world is yours to explore as you will and there are many paths for you to...

store.name: Carcass Clad
store.short: A visceral co-op tank horror game from the creators of MOUTHWASHING. Featuring weighty physical controls, crew the Yksiö with a team of 3. Fuel is limited and ammo is scarce. The city's saint, long since laid to rest, walks again – gilded and defiled.
store.about:
Carcass Clad is a three person co-op game from the creators of MOUTHWASHING. Master tactile mechanics, communicate under intense pressure, and make your escape. Operating the Yksiö is fully diegetic, requiring each lever, action, and mechanism to be handled manually. Each member of your crew serves a unique role inside the tank. Every action matters. Every mistake spreads.

 Against all orders, the crew of the Yksiö have no choice but to cut through the city of Vhorgorod. With no allies left, the only way to survive is to scavenge the dregs of the Ostravyan defenses. What the few who still remain, the most obsessed of them, have accomplished left the streets sick with chimeric growths of gold and body. Masses of divine livestock are adorned onto the husks of their machines, to war again.

 Kanerva wanted above all an easy and glamorous life until the encroaching war forced her to enlist. Now the promise of a return to normalcy pushes her to become a ruthless commander. 
 Visibility in the Yksiö is extremely limited. As Kanerva, you are the eyes and ears of the tank. Use your periscope to identify and range targets. Listen to your radio and chart safe routes through the city, locate useful items and potential threats. Keep a cool head, especially during combat. The tank and your crew survive by your orders.

 A lackadaisical man more accustomed to survival within dodgy gambling dens than the battlefield, gunner Erkki’s aim is as sharp as his wit. 
 Make every shot count. As Erkki, you’re responsible for the Yksiö’s lumbering 158mm cannon. Use the inventory carousel to...

store.name: Blaze Of Empires
store.short: Real-time strategy with armies and arcane magic. Choose Legionaries, Skelestians, or Antarions, gather food, wood and gold, build a base, and command a hero. An 11-mission campaign and Gods Challenge 9 stages and bosses with special attacks.
store.about:
Blaze of Empires is a real-time strategy game with arcane magic. You gather food, wood and gold, raise a base, and recruit an army. You pick one of three empires — Legionaries, a medieval human army; Skelestians, a graveyard host with high damage; and Antarions, a hive that expands through extra town centers and tunnels. You command a hero with an active ability, and you choose a captain as your stand-in on the field.
 Features 
 Real-time strategy with food, wood, and gold gathering, and base building

 Three empires: Legionaries, Skelestians, and Antarions

 Gods Challenge: 9 stages, 8 bosses, a favor after each wave

 11-mission campaign with objectives and dialogue

 Recruit core units with counters, then command a hero

 Choose a captain and equip items earned by leveling up

 Research on the empire tech tree unlocks units and buildings for later battles; during a match you still spend the three resources to construct, produce, and push.

 Empires 
 Legionaries are the human medieval army and the most straightforward empire. Their hero's ability heals units.

 Skelestians deal high damage. A graveyard building returns a unit to the field for every three that die in battle. Their war beast deals area damage. Their siege unit, the Skelbomber, explodes on impact. Their hero raises the skulls that appear on the ground when units fall.

 Antarions play as a hive. They raise extra town centers cheaply, move troops through tunnels, and run a faster economy so units come out sooner. Their houses damage enemies that get close. Their hero leaps into a group, deals damage, and...

store.name: Arkheron
store.short: Arkheron is a fast-paced, team-based PvP game where items grant powerful abilities to master. Combine them to outplay rival teams with skill and creativity as you fight your way up the Tower. Every run challenges you to adapt, survive, and master new combinations.
store.about:
"Find me next cycle. I will remember you." 
 — Karriv, the Forge
 Craft your hero. Outplay your rivals. Take the Tower. 
 Arkheron is a fast-paced, team-based PvP game where the items you find give you powerful abilities to master. Combine them to outplay opponents with your skill and creativity, turning impossible fights into unforgettable wins. No two runs will ever be the same. Thousands of item and ability combinations make every fight different and every victory well-earned.
 If you've played a shooter or a MOBA, your aim and instincts already work here. The builds, the counters, and the ways a fight can turn all come down to your adaptability, skill, and teamwork.

 The Climb 
 The Tower is caught in an endless cycle of destruction and renewal; your only way out is to keep climbing.

Ascension is the main event. Teams of three enter the Tower to fight monsters, loot powerful items, and battle rival teams for control of Beacons. Fight your way through the Tower as rival teams are eliminated floor by floor, until only two remain for the final showdown at the summit.

Spires is pure 3v3 arena combat. Your team against another, one fight after the next. Choose your build, take down your opponents, and keep climbing. How high can you go?
 Creative, High-Skill Combat  
 Arkheron's isometric free-aim combat keeps you in control throughout the fight: take advantage of cover and line of sight to set up the perfect shot, dodge and dash to get in close, and pay attention to sound and enemy positioning to predict the danger before it's on top of you.

Combine powerful abilities...

store.name: KYORA
store.short: Delve into KYORA, a mystical multiplayer sandbox adventure, where every pixel is yours to shape, mine, build or explode.
store.about:
‎ ‎ 
From the creators of the multi-award-winning mining sandbox, Core Keeper , comes an all-new mystical multiplayer adventure… 
‎
Cross into a realm of ruins, where every pixel is a tool to create something new. Mine precious resources, craft physics-altering wands, take on powerful bosses, and build your base by terraforming the world around you.

 Journey into the unexpected, in a procedurally-generated open world. Carve into the earth or sculpt toward the sky in search of magical materials. Craft matter-manipulating wands, upgrade your gear, and take on the powerful bosses in control of each biome: the Heralds.
‎ ‎ 

 Let loose your sandbox creativity with pixel-by-pixel terraforming. Build bridges to new areas, sculpt and customise your dream base with pixel materials, or even use your terraforming powers mid-battle to construct platforms and cover. 
‎ ‎ 

 The world of KYORA is filled with secrets. The further you venture, the more dangers await. To survive KYORA’S forest-cloaked ruins and cross its blistering desert sands, you’ll need to use each biome’s resources to your advantage. Gather materials, forge powerful weapons and armour, plant seeds and cook up recipes to help you traverse the wilds...
‎ ‎ 

 It’s dangerous to go alone! Bring your buddies with you to combine skills, creating fun synergies between wand abilities, in up to 8-player online co-op gameplay.

store.name: The Hidden Ones
store.short: The Hidden Ones is a 3D cinematic action-fighting game that's an adaptation of the martial arts franchise The Outcast.
store.about:
The Hidden Ones is a 3D action fighting game featuring a myth-inspired martial arts aesthetic.

 Game Features
 Captivating Outcast stories and fast-paced combat 
 Unveil the ancient myths of the Outcast world and engage in electrifying combat across diverse game modes.

 Myth and martial arts combined in cinematic design 
 Experience unique Eastern martial arts combat, featuring enticing cinematic scenes inspired by an urban myth with ancient elements.

 Completely fair PvP experience 
 The core values of The Hidden Ones focus on ensuring fair competitive play and upholding a strict zero-tolerance policy against cheating.

 Game Modes
 Game Mode: Story 
 Various boss mechanics and designs reflect the different chapters of the mythical martial arts story. 
 Experience cinematic-style cutscenes and beautifully-designed levels that immerse players in the action. 
 Venture into the world of The Outcast through action-packed battles and explore the story from multiple perspectives.

 Game Mode: Duel 
 Engage in high-intensity battles and adapt in the blink of an eye. 
 By integrating other characters' skills into the action roulette, players can gain a game-changing advantage.
 Use unique skills and strategies in a fair and competitive environment.

 Game Mode: Trial Mode 
 Conquer all the epic bosses that emerge throughout the story mode.
 Battle bosses that grow stronger with each fight, mastering different characters and battle styles to prevail.

store.name: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM
store.short: Continuing the legacy of the Girls' Frontline world, this all-new adventure casts you as the Commander, challenging you to lead your squad of Tactical Dolls deep into perilous contamination zones and overcome enemies with tactical prowess.
store.about:
The end of an era, the dawn of another; the fall of a faction, the rise of another... The torchbearers shall shine upon the brave new world.
 After severing ties with G&K, the Commander bid farewell to the past and chose to venture into the contamination zones. During their journey, the Commander encountered more and more individuals and Tactical Dolls. Each with their own unique stories, they became indispensable members of the Commander's team. The Commander, who only sought to complete bounty missions smoothly and earn a stable income, was unexpectedly ambushed during what appeared to be a routine transport mission. Far from the bustling vortex, it became clear that the Commander had been drawn into an even larger maelstrom...
 Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium is a 3D strategy RPG for both PC and Mobile. In this game, you will fully experience:
 [Covenant Ring: Forge Unbreakable Bonds with Your Dolls] 
 Inscribe your Covenant and unlock exclusive archives, memories, and voice lines for your Dolls. Affinity can be deepened through gift-giving. A Covenant with your Dolls can be formed at a certain Affinity level, which unlocks an exclusive Covenant Projection.

 [Realistic Weapon System, Free-Form Weapon Customization] 
 Handguns, machine guns, shotguns—every type of weapon is available with a 360° preview. Freely attach weapon accessories to create a unique appearance for your weapons. Equip your team with the finest weapons to face the toughest enemies.

 [Immersive Animations, 360° Character Interaction] 
 Featuring high-quality character models with rich interactive...

store.name: 4:LOOP
store.short: It’s just you and your crew versus an alien invasion. Odds are you’re going to die. A lot. Thankfully, that’s all part of The Plan.
store.about:
It’s just you and your crew versus an alien invasion. Odds are you’re going to die. A lot. Thankfully, it’ll take more than death to stop you.
 You’re one of four seemingly ordinary people who mysteriously survived an alien invasion that turned most of humanity to glass. With a moon-sized mothership looming overhead, killer robots hunting you down, and mutated flora and fauna spreading across the planet, you’re led to a crashed alien ship by an eccentric scientist. He claims the same tech he used to predict the invasion led him to find you - because you’re the only ones who can stop what comes next.
 Armed with an arsenal of mind-bending weapons and machines—including the ability to “reprint” your fallen teammates—it’s up to you to destroy the mothership before the invaders’ global mining operation grinds the planet to dust.
 When you fail, death isn’t the end. It’s a chance to regroup, adapt, and finally save the world. Drop into dynamic missions packed with ever-changing environments, emerging objectives, and escalating threats. 
 Experiment. Improvise. Beat the odds. 
 With every attempt, you’ll unlock new gear, uncover the invasion’s secrets, and push ever deeper into the unknown.

store.name: Zeverland
store.short: Welcome to Zeverland, survive & craft together with your friends in a deceptively cute apocalypse, with no limits! Everything is interactive like the real world—dismantle toilets, strap zombie heads to bats, or weld a bed to your RV. Then, try to repair bridges, make vaccines, and relight the world!
store.about:
Welcome to Zeverland! Yep, another zombie game. But here, common sense is your best weapon. Just like in real life, you can interact with and modify anything you find. Dismantle a gas station toilet, attach a Zed head to a baseball bet to make a deadly weapon, or weld a bed into an RV so you can drive your house wherever you want.
 Worried about getting bitten? Don't worry, undead doesn't mean no life! Don't want to get your hands dirty? Gather NPCs from across the world to help you build your post-apocalypse shelter from the ground up.
 Once you've solved the problem of survival, you can choose to wander alone, or team up with others to think big: rebuild bridges, create a vaccine, build a skyscraper, and light up the world once more!

 Someone hit the pause button on civilization... 
 Everything is gone. Or is it?
 This isn't the aftermath of the apocalypse. This is the first minute of it.
 Sure, the water's still running... if you fancy a night of gut-wrenching agony.
 Your neighbor's lights are on, but they've got a bit of a zombie problem.
 And it's a commuter's dream right now because traffic laws are dead!
 Don’t think of this as the end of the world. Think of it as the first, chaotic day of a new one.

 Common sense. It's the new superpower. 
 To survive, don't overthink it.
 Thirsty? Bust open a vending machine.
 Hungry? Raid someone's pantry.

 Bitten? Welcome to the undead club.
 No complex rules. No punishing mechanics. Just do what makes sense to you.

 Common Sense + Imagination = Survival. 
 Get creative! Any junk you have is ready to be fused into a...

store.name: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow
store.short: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.
store.about:
How far would you go to save the ones you love? 
 One day in college, your friend Noah invites you to a seminar about time travel. There, you witness the inventor, Leon, take his own life with a gun. As the gunshot rings out, buried memories start to flood back…you realize you’re trapped in some kind of recurring dream.
 What happened in the past, and what will happen tomorrow ? Trace back through fourteen years of memories, cross timelines, meet cute boys… and try to save everyone - including yourself.

 ———————— ✦ Game Features ✦ ————————

 The Retrospection of Tomorrow is a mystery/sci-fi visual novel features elements of romantic adventure. 
 Play as Fay (name customizable) and join her on an emotional journey from youth to adulthood. You'll experience tender, heartfelt moments—alongside heartbreak, trials, and heart-pounding suspense.
 As the story unfolds, each use of the time machine to rewrite the past pulls you deeper into the uncanny link between your existence and everything happening around—forcing you to confront the dark truth buried deep within fate...

 ✦ 4 Dateable Characters • A Non-Linear Tale of Romance, Thrills, and Mystery 
 Travel through delusion, and memory as you forge unforgettable adventures with four cute/hot love interests. Along the way, immerse yourself in an intricate, multi-layered mystery where the truth unfolds piece by piece.

 ✦ Collect Clues & Present Them at the Right Time! 
 Pay close attention to everything you encounter while growing up, and record the clues you uncover. Connect seemingly unrelated details and strange events -...

store.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
store.short: A new adventure in Professor Layton, the puzzle-filled fantasy adventure series that has sold over 20 million copies worldwide. Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a mysterious case in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention powered by steam engine technology.
store.about:
Layton and Luke set out on a new adventure in a world of steam. 
 A new story in Professor Layton, the puzzle-filled fantasy adventure series that has sold over 20 million copies worldwide.
 Set in America after the end of the Wild West era, this new adventure takes place in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention transformed by rapid advances in steam technology. But as something mysterious is taking place there, Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a new adventure.
 ■ Features the Most Puzzles in the Series, Designed by QuizKnock 
 QuizKnock, the intellectual entertainment group led by quiz champion Takushi Izawa, is behind the puzzles in this latest adventure. Take on more puzzles than ever before as you progress through the story and uncover the truth.

 ■ An Intuitive, Hands-On Puzzle-Solving Experience 
 Steam Deck™ supports touchscreen controls.

 ■ A Cast of Familiar and New Voices 
 Layton and Luke return alongside a colorful cast of new characters. Both familiar and new voice actors lend their talents to this new adventure.

 ■ A Completely Revamped Exploration System 
 Enjoy a smoother exploration experience with new features unique to this title, including fast travel and Coindar, a robot that can detect hidden hint coins. Of course, you can also take your time exploring the streets of Steam Bison, uncover hidden puzzles, and chat with the townspeople along the way.

 ■ Puzzles Meet Town Development 
 As you progress through the story, you'll encounter puzzles that contribute to Steam Bison's development. Solve them to upgrade the town's...

store.name: AION 2
store.short: AION 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original. PC only, on Unreal Engine 5.
store.about:
AION 2 is now LIVE! 
 As a thank you to all Daevas, we are extending all Pre-Registration and Steam Wishlist reward items to every player who creates an account and logs in before maintenance begins on Dec 1, 11:30 PM PT / Dec 2, 8:30 AM CET. Simply log in and your rewards will be delivered to your in-game mail. Remember to claim them before the mail expires on Dec 8, 11:30 PM PT / Dec 9, 8:30 AM CET.

 The sky is not the limit. It is the battlefield. 
 Built on Unreal Engine 5 across a world 36 times larger than the original AION, this is the only MMORPG built for aerial combat. Verticality is in the DNA of AION 2, and rewards players who can think, and fight, in 3 dimensions.

 Every region, every battlefield, every encounter was designed with verticality as its axis. As a Daeva, flight is not a travel mechanic, it is how you fight, how you explore, and how you impose your will on the world. Gain altitude to gain advantage, and experience a scale of aerial combat unlike any other MMORPG.

 Precision, timing, and positioning shape every battle. Chain skills seamlessly, customize your class to fit your playstyle, and adapt as encounters escalate. Every fight is a decision, not a rotation. 

 From solo instances to large-scale raids, AION 2 PvE is built around scale and variety. Over 200 dungeons span multiple formats: solo challenges, 5-player party content, and 10-player group dungeons. Seasonal challenges, competitive rankings, and open-world events keep the excitement high, and the Abyss ensures that PvE and faction war are never far apart. 

 Bring your vision to life...

store.name: JOIN US
store.short: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?
store.about:
HAVE YOU EVER DREAMED OF STARTING YOUR OWN CULT? 
 Now you can - right from the comfort of your own home! Imagine the respect you’ll receive as an up-and-coming cult leader! Issue weird teachings to your followers! Expand your territory! Build a base of operations! Perform sacrifices! Oversee a growing stockpile of military-grade weapons!
 In this sandbox survival game, your most valuable resource isn’t stones and wood… it’s human beings. 

 Every character in the world, from civilians to enemies, is a potential recruit for your growing cult.
 Turn the game world into your personal follower-farm by spreading propaganda, managing infamy, and making your cult worthy of joining. Once a new follower joins your flock, you can put them to work, play as them, or enlist their support on missions. All of your followers have strengths and weaknesses, and are best used in accordance with their abilities – farmers, smooth-talkers, doctors, etc. 

 Followers are your most important resource, but also your most volatile. If you don’t keep them happy, they’ll quit the cult. And remember… a cult leader without any followers is just a lonely weirdo.  

 It wouldn’t be a cult unless your friends could join. 

 JOIN US supports up to 4-player co-op. Work together to build the cult of your dreams and crush all those that try to oppose you. The end of the world depends on it! 

 Build your cult’s compound from the ground up. Design buildings and defenses, manage resources, put followers to work, and customize your home base! Every great cult starts with a great compound. 

 Craft a unique...

store.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26
store.short: Experience The World's Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. Go for glory in a 48-team international tournament mode, take on themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes.
store.about: This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

store.name: The Regreening
store.short: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug ALL the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.
store.about:
Restore the world with your hands, your heart, and just a touch of magic. Watch seeds turn into trees and the desert turn into a green oasis. Feel the change as it happens: warm breezes ripple through freshly sprouted meadows, frogs return to singing wetlands, and it finally rains.

 Plant & Cultivate: Discover new seeds, choose which animal habitats to restore, learn powerful plant synergies, and create beautiful living biomes according to your vision.

 Recycle & Craft: Clean up old junk to collect crafting materials and upcycle them into beautiful decorations for your home, or powerful watering systems for your plants.

 Befriend Folklore Spirits: Meet mythical nature spirits willing to give you mighty abilities in exchange for your help (and maybe a few shiny objects.)

 Enjoy the Fruits of Your Care:  Harvest flowers and berries to plant in new areas or to give as gifts to your favourite animals and friends.

 Restore at Your Own Pace : No timers, no pressure

 Feel your impact: Help animals return and nature recover.

 Rich atmosphere: with an adaptive soundtrack and soothing nature sounds that changes as you restore the world

 A Soilpunk Fairytale: Discover a world inspired by nature, sustainability, and folklore.

store.name: Bongo Cat
store.short: Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find?
store.about:
Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find?
 Item drop pool chances*:
 Common - 90%

 Uncommon - 9.5%

 Rare - 0.49%

 Epic - 0.01%

 Legendary - 1 in 500000

 *Subject to change
 Features: 
 Your own bongo cat
 Many customization options
 A friend while working hard
 Based on the artwork and meme of @StrayRogue and @DitzyFlama

store.name: Shark Dentist
store.short: Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life.
store.about:
Key Features:

 Intense Gameplay: Treat a shark's teeth without waking it. Every mistake can lead to deadly consequences.

 Roguelike Mechanics: Randomly generated dental issues, tools, and debuffs make each attempt unique.

 Multitasking: Monitor the shark's pulse, maintain oxygen supply, manage anesthesia, and choose the right tools.

 Realistic Tool Interaction: Use syringes, drills, mirrors, and even a circular saw to tackle various tasks.

 Organic Balance: Manage the shark's stress level by finding a balance between the pain of treatment and limited resources.

 Your Main Enemies:
 Shark Stress: Higher stress brings the shark closer to waking.

 Limited Resources: Be cautious with your supply of anesthetic and tools.

 Random Events: Equipment failures, sudden pain spikes, and other surprises.

 The game will appeal to horror fans, streamers, and lovers of films like Jaws , The Meg , and Saw . If you enjoy challenging games with random elements and a tense atmosphere, Shark Dentist will become your new favorite.
 Can you stay calm and survive while doing your job? Find out in Shark Dentist !

store.name: ORMOD: Directive
store.short: Shape your own survival experience in an infinite open-world sandbox. Customize world difficulty, rules, and playstyle. Play solo, co-op, or on 24/7 MMO-style servers across PvP, PvE, Hardcore, or Creative modes as you build, automate, fight, and survive. The choice is yours.
store.about:
BUILD. AUTOMATE. FIGHT. SURVIVE. 
 A fully customizable, harsh open-world survival sandbox set in a world overtaken by the ORMOD. Start in an infinite world that changes every playthrough, then tailor the experience to your liking, from world rules and difficulty to whether you play solo, co-op, or on larger persistent 24/7 servers.
 FEATURE OVERVIEW: 
 Infinite, fully customizable procedural worlds

 Choose your experience: solo, co-op, or large persistent servers

 Multiple modes, including PvP, PvE, Hardcore, Creative, and mini-games

 Player-defined difficulty and world settings

 Physical and persistent item simulation

 Unique tile-based base building

 Full automation and mega-factory construction

 Realistic combat and advanced ballistic simulation

 Deep survival mechanics (health, sickness, temperature, farming, etc.)

 Skills, quests, and a dynamic player-driven economy

 Dynamic world events: crash sites, airdrops, global PvP encounters

 Vehicles with realistic handling and manual gear systems

 Nighttime mechanoid hunts that challenge any playstyle

 INFINITE AND FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE WORLDS 
 No two playthroughs are the same. Every session generates new towns, buildings, roads, and terrain layouts, allowing players to shape their own survival experience from the ground up. 
 PLAY SOLO, WITH FRIENDS, OR ON 24/7 SERVERS 
 Choose exactly how you want to play. Tweak world difficulty, customize rules, and decide whether you explore alone, host private sessions with friends, or join larger 24/7 persistent servers. Play PvP, PvE, Hardcore, Creative, mini-games, or...

store.name: I Have No Change
store.short: “I Have No Change” is a first-person narrative game that immerses players in the atmosphere of a night kiosk filled with stories, melancholia, and the reflections of residents from Russia’s regions.
store.about:
Winter. New Year's Eve. A night kiosk.  

 This is where 27-year-old Matvey works, serving all kinds of customers — from familiar faces to wandering strangers. 
On the other side of the kiosk’s window, their stories unfold: about good and bad, life and death, how Vitya cheated on Masha, and how the building on Stroiteley Street is once again without hot water.

 During these festive nights, alone with his thoughts, Matvey keeps asking himself:
 How did he end up in this kiosk? Did he ever dream of such a life? Is he ready for change? 

 Let’s step into Matvey’s world and see how a vast universe fits within this small kiosk.

 “I Have No Change” — a first-person narrative-driven game that combines: 
 A grounded, slice-of-life dramatic narrative 

 A quiet, personal story that lingers long after it ends, touching on stagnation, lost dreams, and fragile hopes;
 Premium visual presentation 

 Realistic visuals with a strong focus on detail and colour, deepening the sense of place and narrative immersion;
 Expressive characters 

 Brought to life by real actors. Most of them have their own story – warm, melancholic, or quietly reflective;
 Thematic soundtrack 

 Music and songs by local artists enhance the emotional connection to the story and shape the atmosphere of each scene.

store.name: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss
store.short: Dive into a city swallowed by the Abyss. Slay aberrations, grab artifacts, and survive until the Diving Booth arrives. A 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG with up to 3-player co-op. Run the antique shop 'BALUSHA' and uncover the city's secrets.
store.about:
'Void Diver: Escape from the Abyss' is a 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG: dive into a city swallowed by the otherworld, recover artifacts, and make it out alive.
 Alone or with friends, fight through dungeons teeming with aberrations and madness, grab what you can, and call the Diving Booth to get out. All for the sake of completing your requests and returning alive.

 DIVE TOGETHER: Up to 3-Player Co-op 

 Party Play: Team up to take on dungeons and bosses, with everyone's skills colliding on the same screen.

 Diverse Divers: Choose from Divers with unique skills and stories, each offering a different combat style.

 Or Go Solo: Prefer the lone-wolf life? Explore the depths on your own.

 EXPLORE & EXTRACT: Escape the Distorted City 

 Otherworldly City: Police stations, hospitals, bus stops, parks... explore familiar cityscapes fused with another dimension.

 Artifact Recovery: From super-scientific devices to forbidden magic relics, find the valuables hidden throughout the dungeon.

 Extraction: Call the Diving Booth and hold out until the countdown ends. Only then do you make it home with your loot.

 SURVIVAL: Aberrations, Madness, and Curses 

 Bosses That Rule Each District: Urban legends, rampaging machines, and humans driven to madness. Read their patterns and survive.

 Mental Pressure: Dungeons consume not just the body, but the mind. Manage the stress that triggers strange phenomena when it hits its limit.

 The Paradox Curse: Survival includes finding cures for 'Paradoxes', dreadful curses that linger even after an expedition.

 GROWTH: Build Your Own...

store.name: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
store.short: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.
store.about:
Sakura Arms is a highly acclaimed real-time deck-building card battle game , released in 2016 by BakaFire Party.  Since its debut, the board game has captivated players with its strategic depth, artistic style, and replayability. To date, the series has launched over 10 expansion sets, featuring a total of  25+ playable characters. 

 This digital edition was developed as a derivative work, created with the official authorization and supervision of  BakaFire Party , and is now officially available on Steam. It now features interactive tutorials, extensive AI battle training, and a global online battle platform.

 Step into the world of  Sakura Arms — 
 A world where the sacred cherry trees, Kamukura Sakura , and many Megami  (goddesses) dwelling within it coexist alongside humanity. 
 Here, battles called  Sakura Duels  are fought for honor and desire.
 Those gifted with supernatural powers are known as Mikoto. Through the blossoms, they   can channel the power of the Megami  — and you are one of them.
 Each Megami wields a distinct weapon art: Kartana, Ninjutsu, Scroll, Arquebus, Karakuri, Scythe, Flag ... each an unique battle style.

 Channel the power of the Megami, combine your weapons to craft your personal strategy.
 Duel beneath drifting petals of sakura!

 Twin Megami Synergy  - Before each duel, you will choose two Megami to fight alongside. Each Megami possesses 11 unique cards, and the combinations between their decks can create limitless strategic possibilities.

 Real-time Deckbuilding  - Reveal your chosen Megami, then build your deck based on your...

store.name: METAMORPHOSIS
store.short: Trapped in a dead world, a forsaken nun walks the long road to absolution. Branded a sinner, you must traverse megastructures, fight demons, and journey towards the last paradise.
store.about:
Explore the ruins of a dead world as Aria , a forsaken nun seeking absolution for her sins.

 METAMORPHOSIS is set in a future where humanity has manufactured its own rapture .
The surface of the Earth has long since collapsed due to war and decay , leaving nothing but silence below.
 The story begins as Aria descends into the depths; driven by guilt, by faith, and by something she cannot escape . The harsh, decaying world is full of atrocities and violence , and amidst the ruins and brutal encounters - could the answer to salvation really still be here? 

 Face off against a variety of foes , decrepit automatons, and pitiful mockeries of “rebirth” in deliberate, high-risk combat . Solve challenging puzzles, manage dwindling resources, and fight the remnants of an endless war.

 Explore large, interconnected areas filled with vertical spaces, hidden paths, and shortcuts. Wield firearms and powerful miracles to survive what lurks within.

 Interact with divine systems left behind. Confess yours sins but be careful who may be listening. 

 Speak with demons born both natural, and man-made. The follies you entertain, and the answers you take to heart may affect more than you think.

 Find meaning in a broken world. 

 -----
 You held your hands in prayer 
 Hiding inside your own faith . 
 You wished for only one thing: 
 To never see her again.

store.name: The Pogo Witch
store.short: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.
store.about:
You've come a long way.
 A structure rises among the clouds, the tower you've come to find.
 You'll finally get to put the art of pogo magic, which you've been practicing for so long, to the test. 

 Inside the tower, you'll need to master the noble art of pogoing, a mechanic also known by some as “bouncing on spikes.” 
 Make your way up through the levels, learning to use new skills and avoiding different types of traps that get more and more complex.

 Strange creatures inhabit this place. 
 Shimmering medallions float in its corners. 
 What other secrets does the tower hold? What is the Master's purpose?
 Explore its halls and discover what else lies hidden within its walls. 

 A game by VLaDOS, featuring incredible music by Dan Espinosa (DanTraveler_).

store.name: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
store.short: Kena’s journey to cure her affliction leads to the island of Kosmora, plagued by its own mysterious corruption. To protect Kosmora, she must master the elements with the aid of spirit companions and dynamic combat in this action-packed yet heartfelt adventure.
store.about:
Kena’s next adventure from the award-winning studio, Ember Lab

 Kena, now an accomplished Spirit Guide, travels to the mysterious island of Kosmora seeking a cure for her affliction and to reconnect with a friend from her past.

 Her search uncovers a forgotten, dangerous form of Spirit Guiding and introduces Kena to Spirit Companions – whose powers she will harness to solve puzzles and defeat enemies using new elemental skills.

 In Kena: Scars of Kosmora, explore a vibrant island full of buried secrets, wandering spirits, epic bosses, and distinct cultures. Awaken ancient temples bound to Kosmora’s hidden past to cleanse a powerful corruption consuming the land.

 Embark on Kena’s next adventure 
 Play as Kena, a Spirit Guide, who helps corrupted spirits struggling to pass on. Explore a rich world in this story driven action-adventure game featuring fast-paced combat. 

 Evolving Spirit Companions 
 Partner with elemental Spirit Companions that will aid you on your journey. Grow their powers and harness their abilities to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and traverse Kosmora. 

 Face Kosmora’s threats 
 Master new elemental abilities and powerful Spirit Guide techniques to overcome treacherous and diverse combat encounters leading up to epic bosses. 

 Explore a beautiful island full of secrets and danger 
 Travel to the mysterious island of Kosmora. Explore vibrant regions, each with their own distinct communities, and learn about the island’s forgotten past as you uncover secrets buried long ago.

store.name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
store.short: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.
store.about:
You are a condemned Synthetic marked for destruction.
 Combine weapons, chips, and augments to forge your own path through endless resets. 
Slay mechanical creatures — and rip the truth out of this cyber-mythic city. 
 MASTER THE RHYTHM OF COMBAT 
 Combat in ReBlade is built around timing and control. 
Balance offense and defense, read enemy behavior, and strike at the right moment to seize the advantage.

 SHAPE YOUR BUILD, BREAK PAST LIMITS 
 Each run lets you refine how you fight.
Combine weapons, chips, and augments to shape your build, adapt to new challenges, and push further with every cycle.

 ENCOUNTER BEASTS, SURVIVE THE TRIALS 
 Ancient creatures, twisted and reinforced by machinery, stand in your way.
Study their patterns, break their defenses, and carve a bloody path to victory.

 DEFY YOUR FATE 
 Bound to an endless cycle of destruction, you are forced to repeat, learn, and resist.
Meet allies, trade the resources you uncover, and piece together the hidden truth of this world.

store.name: Stellar Blade™
store.short: Save humanity from extinction in post-apocalyptic action-adventure Stellar Blade™. Experience blistering combat and a twisting storyline as you unravel the mysteries of Earth’s downfall.
store.about:
Experience the acclaimed PlayStation®5 hit Stellar Blade™ from Korean developers SHIFT UP, now optimized for PC.

 The future of humanity is balanced on the edge of a blade. Ravaged by strange, powerful creatures, Earth has been abandoned, and what is left of the decimated human race has fled to a Colony in outer space.

 After travelling from the Colony, EVE arrives on the desolate remains of our planet with a clear-cut mission: to save humankind by reclaiming Earth from the Naytiba – the malevolent force that has devastated it.

 But as EVE tackles the Naytiba one-by-one, piecing together the mysteries of the past in the ruins of human civilization, she realizes that her mission is far from straightforward. In fact, almost nothing is as it seems…

 Engage in blisteringly fast combat as you slash a path through the remnants of Earth. Unleash graceful yet brutal attacking combos, unlock new moves and weapon upgrades, and face epic boss encounters that will challenge both brain and brawn in equal measure.

 Become immersed in a highly detailed post-apocalyptic world that blends beauty and horror to spectacular effect. 

 Unravel a gripping human fate story, with mature themes, a thought-provoking narrative and emotionally-charged revelations from beginning to end.

 New content 
 Test your skill and strength against the fearsome warrior Mann, the leader of the Sentinels in Boss Challenge Mode.

 Chinese and Japanese voice over and lip-sync support.

 25 costumes, three pairs of glasses and six pairs of earrings.

 PC features 
 Ultrawide monitor support 
 Journey across...

store.name: Appulse
store.short: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!
store.about:
A brand-new genre blend of action, top-down shooter, and pinball. Master the use of flippers and recoil with precision, craft your own build, and climb the scoreboard in a vibrant intergalactic war. 

 MASTER THE RECOIL 
 You think this is “just pinball”? Well… think again 🚀
 In Appulse, the twist is the added recoil when firing your guns. Each shot will push you in the opposite direction, allowing you to control the ball after using the flippers. There’s no luck involved, only your skills: Learn how to leverage every part of the board, get rewards, and you will be able to go anywhere you want… including the top of the leaderboard, of course.

 ROGUELITE SHOOTER 
 Dive into this intense roguelite shooter that puts a unique twist into classic pinball mechanics. Your mission is to defend the fleet of Vektor Dynamics, but guns are not the only thing giving you the edge. Special perks earned during your adventure will power up your ball. Need more recoil when firing? To ram your enemies with increased close-range strength? Or maybe the ability to slow down time to create a flawless combo move? Try multiple options until you create the perfect build! 

 SPACE ACTION 
 In a classic space-opera style, you will be able to explore and expand your fleet. Charge on enemy ships using your ejection cannon. Challenges and special quests await you in those unknown territories: Conquer new shuttles to win the war against the Iron Accord. On to glory, T1LT-UNIT!

store.name: Forged: Reconquest
store.short: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.
store.about:
Craft unique regional weapons, armor, and shields by an interactive multi-step process with wood and iron based crafting tables. Whether you're shaping swords on the anvil, crafting bows on the carpenter table, or forging ingots on the furnace, each product requires teamwork as well as finesse.

 Embark on a relentless and persistent campaign to reclaim the world from the iron grip of a mysterious and powerful invasion force in medieval period using only medieval equipment. This isn't a mere skirmish; it's a desperate, region-by-region liberation effort that will test your tactical prowess and resolve.
 As you push deeper into occupied territories, you will find that each newly liberated region presents a unique and escalating challenge with diverse enemy types.
 The fate of humanity rests on your ability to outmaneuver and overpower the enemy!

 Arm your troops with unique, region-specific equipment and tailor your strategy to the enemies you face. Your choices at the forge determine the outcome on the battlefield.
 Battle through handcrafted levels filled with unique challenges, magical  events, and shifting objectives. From elite bosses to random modifiers, no session plays the same and chaos is always around the corner.

 Being behind the front lines doesn't mean you're safe! You'll still face obstacles you must overcome to forge your gear.

 Upgrade your weapons and armor with mighty magical enhancements that give your weapons unique characteristics that provide your soldiers with a commanding advantage over the enemy on the battlefield that will swing the momentum of...

store.name: GrimKeep
store.short: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.
store.about:
GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

 Big Damage Isn't Rolled. It's Built. 
 Find items and try out different combinations for maximum damage.

 Roll the dice for powerful combos that fire off your items’ bonuses and multipliers.

 Tune your bag by acquiring dice with special abilities such as poison, healing or gold.

 Further enhance your build at the Crucible. Melt items and their abilities into something new.

 Outsmart the enemies by tactically using your defense, stuns, and heals. Your strategy determines how far you will make it.

 Use what you learned to optimize your next run, or try a totally different build.

 A Rotten Nightmare Fairytale 
 The city is cursed and you must do what you can to set things right.
 Choose your path on the map and assess the risks and rewards at every crossroads.

 You are the hero of this fairytale . Play as The Huntress or The Beast and unlock more characters as you progress. Each with unique strengths to build and tune around.

 Take a chance at encounters with curious strangers in the city. You may or may not regret it.

 What’s In the Game 
 200+ items with endless combinations

 60+ unique monsters

 7 playable heroes

 11 dice types

 16 hero skills to unlock

 Made With Love 
 GrimKeep is made by a small dev team and we’re pouring our hearts into this game! We love to share our (sometimes chaotic) journey with you and always appreciate hearing...

store.name: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated
store.short: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery.
store.about:
In a world ruled by the demons, a world where even the gods themselves turned their side towards darkness... one man stand and take the quest to restore order. A necromancic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next in search to destroy the source of the invasion and bring peace back in earth realm. 

 Highlights 
 Explore 20 huge maps. Travel over many realms, all unique and different from each others

 Seek for secrets, you might find unique and useful items. Gain new ability along the way to help you on your path

 Slay over 40 different enemies, including unique encounters in each map.. Fight and conquer 20 bosses

 Dig your way through creatures & demons with 7 different weapons

store.name: Drownlight
store.short: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.
store.about:
When the world drowned, only the light remained 
 After a cataclysm that swallowed continents and erased civilization, a handful of survivors discover a solitary lighthouse standing above the endless ocean. Around its glow, humanity makes its last stand.
 You are their leader, the one who must rebuild, protect, and guide the final city of humankind.
 The Lighthouse: The Heart of Survival 
 Your lighthouse is more than a beacon. It’s life itself.
  🔹 Keep the Flame Alive – Generate power, gather fuel, and manage what little remains of the old world. If the light dies, people vanish into the darkness.
 🔹 A Beacon for the Lost – The light draws drifters from across the sea. Each new survivor brings labor, stories, and hope, but also new mouths to feed.
 🔹 Guard the Light, Fear the Depths – The ocean hides ancient secrets and unknown dangers waiting beyond the beam’s reach.
 Survive the Unforgiving Ocean 

 ⚫ The Darkness – The lighthouse must never fail, or you risk losing people to an unseen force that lurks beyond the light.
🌊 Unforgiving Weather – Face devastating storms that tear apart your structures and dead calms that starve your city of resources.
🎣 Resource Scarcity – Manage food, energy, and morale as supplies dwindle and the sea grows more hostile.
  ⚖ Choices That Shape Humanity – Decide who to save, who to sacrifice, and what kind of world is worth rebuilding.
 Key Features 
 🏗 Radial City-Building – Expand your city outward from the lighthouse, constructing and optimizing structures in a dynamic, ever-growing settlement.
⚖ Moral Dilemmas – Survivors will...

store.name: Wuthering Waves
store.short: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.
store.about:
Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.

 Welcome aboard, roving voyager.
 Upon the shores lay the silent embers of a world during the Ebb Tide.
 Desolated by the Lament, the erstwhile creations and earthly beings are left static.
 But they strike back, strong enough to penetrate the silence.
 Humanity has risen anew from the ashes of the apocalypse.
 And you, Rover, are poised for an adventure of Awakening.
 Companions to meet, enemies to conquer, new powers to gain, hidden truths to unveil, and unseen spectacles to behold... A vast world of endless possibilities awaits. The choice rests in your hands. Be the answer, be the leader, and follow the sounds to arrive at a new future.
 As Wuthering Waves echo endlessly, mankind set sail on a new journey.
 Rise and embark on your odyssey, Rover.
 Delve into an expansive world / Desolated by the Lament, civilization is born anew
 Embrace high degrees of freedom in immersive overworld explorations. Free yourself from stamina limits, dash and parkour on walls, take Flight, and ride a high-mobility expedition motorbike to enjoy open-world exploration. As the world of Solaris-3 unfolds, your lost memory begins to see its recovery through this ceaseless quest.

 Enjoy extreme battle experience / Engage in smooth & fast-paced combat 
 Avail against enemy attacks in smooth and fast-paced combat. Apply easy controls of Extreme Evasion, Dodge Counter,...

store.name: Tenebyss
store.short: You are a scout of the True Order, an authoritarian regime ruling Teneria. Before you lies a vast realm of ruins, dungeons, and guarded towns, each with their own unique identity. Uncover the secrets of the realm with friends, or venture out alone.

store.name: Frostrail
store.short: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.
store.about:
Once a mighty empire, the land now lies barren, consumed by an unrelenting cold. Twisted by the Emperor’s pact with the Void, its ruins are haunted by relentless revenants and eldritch horrors. Aboard an armored, steam-powered train, the Penitent Gardeners purge the land of the cursed, granting mercy to the lost and striking down the wicked, seeking salvation in the heart of the frozen desolation.

Your train is more than a refuge, it is your only way forward. As you explore the frozen wasteland, it will keep you moving and alive, carrying everything you need to survive. Fuel the Eden Engine, manage its power, and operate your train to explore further, scavenging what little remains of this world.

As your struggle grows heavier, so must your train. Reinforce its walls, craft weapon stations, and upgrade the engine to outpace the horrors that hunt you. Expand with new carriages, crafting stations and storage, forging a moving fortress against the cold and the terrors beyond.

Beyond the tracks lies a world frozen in death, its ruins entombed in ice and time. Explore the wasteland for vital supplies, scavenge the remnants of abandoned settlements, and break into wreckage lost to the frost. Descend into treacherous depths where greater rewards come at a deadly cost.

But the cold is unforgiving, and every step away from your train is a gamble. Risk death for precious supplies or stay safe and go without. The frost creeps into your bones, the blizzard blinds, slows, and suffocates. Heat is survival, ration it wisely. And in the silence of the snow, something else stirs…

Face...

store.name: Demon Bluff
store.short: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?
store.about:
The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

 A ROGUELIKE CARD GAME WHERE YOUR DECK IS FULL OF LIES 
 Demon Bluff combines the tension of social deduction games with the randomized replay value of roguelikes and card games.
 Your goal is to investigate a corrupted village, gather information from each character, and piece together the truth to uncover and slay every demon in hiding.
 Each character is represented by a card - Villager and Outcast cards will help you track them down with information and unique abilities. But be careful -  Demons and Minions have disguised themselves as Villagers and will try to mislead you. Will you be able to see through their lies?

 MANY MODES TO MASTER 
 Take on a series of increasingly challenging corrupted villages, unlocking more cards with each victory. Then, take your unlocked cards into additional modes that promise endless randomized challenges, rule-bending Relic upgrades, and chaotic Ascension difficulty modifiers.

 EXPAND, UNLOCK, AND CUSTOMIZE 
 Keep saving villages and unlock dozens of new character cards to expand your collection or encounter in randomized runs. Plus, unlock alternate illustrations with new styles and guest artists to customize your favorite cards with!

 FEATURES: 
 100+ unique character cards to collect

 Dozens of unlockable alternate card illustrations

 Increasingly complex mechanics and challenges

 Multiple modes and scenarios...

store.name: HAEX
store.short: An anomaly has been detected in the sub-arctic north. The science team sent to investigate has gone missing. Survive an alien-scarred wilderness solo or with up to 3 friends. Push back the mist, reshape the world, craft weapons and gear, and fight to unearth what happened.
store.about:
A co-op survival shooter for 1-4 players 
 In this procedural open-world action-adventure, your character and worlds are saved separately. Unlock new gear, acquire skills and find crafting recipes that you can take anywhere. Start a new world for a fresh adventure, or jump into a friend's game fully geared up. Every world keeps its own story. Every character keeps its own progression.

 An extraterrestrial power journey 
 Discover a sentient cube that allows you to effortlessly gather resources and scan your surroundings. Upgrade it to level up its capabilities. Unlock powerful alien abilities as you progress, opening up new ways to traverse the world with moves like dashing and double-jumping.

 Plant alien seeds to reshape a sub-arctic open world  
 Find or craft alien seeds that let you transform your world, and open new possibilities. Planting them unlocks unique new areas and resources, but beware of the new threats you might unleash on your world.

 Find the science expedition that went silent in the mist 
 Unearth what happened. The further you go the more dangerous the world becomes. Meet a cast of characters across the world, each with their own insights about the events unfolding around you. 

 Survive the cold and build your survival skills  
 Cold kills. Hunger slows you down. Go too deep without the right gear and you won't come back. Enemies, resources, and secrets all evolve with depth, and so do the rewards. Discover and explore alien structures in your search for more skills to unlock and weapons to craft.  

 Tune your loadout for what’s stalking the next...

store.name: PEAK
store.short: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
store.about:
PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?

 WORK TOGETHER 
 Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes every single day. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.

 CLIMB 
 The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb.

 SURVIVE 
 Prepare For the Worst: Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you.

 A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY 
 The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.

 EARN BADGES 
 A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock.

 CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS 
 Multiplayer in PEAK is friends-only - invite up to three other scouts online to climb together, or face the mountain alone if you're really brave!

 FEATURES 
 Online, cross-platform co-op and offline single...

store.name: Örnöga: Idle & Loot
store.short: Embark on a short magical adventure in Örnöga! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and hire mercenaries as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow... even while you're away.
store.about:
Embark on a magical adventure in Örnöga ! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and uncover ancient secrets as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow—even while you're away. 
 Level up and earn Stat Points to distribute across seven unique Stats, customizing your build to suit your playstyle.

 Level up spells from four distinct elements , mastering their power to enhance your abilities in battle.

 Collect epic loot that that manipulates your spells.

 Hire powerful mercenaries to assist you in battle.

 Örnöga is an idle game where your character fights and explores on their own, requiring no manual input. However, if you prefer a more hands-on approach, you can take control by using character-specific skills and controlling your hero. While playing actively isn’t necessary, it can give you an edge in tough battles and speed up your progress.

store.name: Dice Tiny Town
store.short: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.
store.about:
The dice hand you the materials — building the finest town with them is up to you.
 Dice Tiny Town is a solo town-building puzzle where you grow a tiny town on a hand-drawn sketchbook from the three dice values you are given each turn. It starts cozy — and before you know it, you're thinking hard about a higher score. There's a Puzzle Mode with 80+ stages, and a Challenge Mode where you keep breaking records.

 Every turn is a tiny puzzle 
 How you use the three 🎲 dice determines this turn's tetromino shape, building, and nature

 Choose where the shape goes, then place your building and nature on it — one tile makes all the difference

 Complete a row or column to earn stars, and spend them to change the dice

 Placement is everything 
 Abbeys want quiet corners, houses love varied nature, and ranches come in pairs

 Lakes, fields, forests, and mountains score bigger in bigger clusters — and flowers bloom where nature grows dense

 Picky 👥visitors, friendly animals 
 The Astronomer who loves clustered stars, the Painter who wants a wide lake beside a mountain… satisfy fifteen visitors, each with demands of their own

 Eight nature-loving animals each add new points to your town in their own way

 80+ stages & challenge mode 
 Build a different town on every stage and reach the 🏁 target score

 Every stage also has a way to earn a higher score than the goal

 Challenge mode's four tiers give you room to build the town you want — chase the best town score you can

store.name: Blue Archive
store.short: An action anime RPG adventure!
store.about:
This game contains some suggestive images and dialogue that may not be suitable for all ages and access may be restricted for users in certain age groups. 
 =========================================================================
 Embark on an adventure with the girls of this epic anime fantasy RPG, Blue Archive, and dive into its world of strategic combat, brought to life by stunning animations. Your journey through Kivotos will be one filled with victory and loss, love and heartbreak, all alongside an unforgettable, touching story. Build strong, deep relationships and get to know each student's unique story while leading your squad. So let's go, Sensei!

 ■A Fantasy-Filled Anime RPG You'll Never Forget!
 Step into Kivotos and your adventure as a teacher will begin. Experience a story of love and friendship with stunning cinematics, in both 2D and 3D animation. Throughout your journey, you'll meet and befriend the students of this world, learning their unique stories and motivations. Each girl plays a vital role in the story: building strong bonds, forming squads to protect those they love, and creating heartwarming memories with Sensei!

 ■Lead Elite Anime Girls into Battle in this Tactical RPG Experience!
 Form a squad with the girls you meet, each contributing their own unique combat elements. Adapt your strategies throughout the adventure to lead them to victory! With stunning animation and 3D cinematics, Blue Archive's combat is a blend of strategy and rich visuals.

 ■Foster Bonds with the Girls in Relationship Stories!
 Every girl in Blue Archive has her own story...

store.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
store.short: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.
store.about:
Experience the pinnacle of adventure with Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, a stunning reimagining of the 1996 genre-defining game.
 As Lara Croft, harness your wits and athleticism to explore exotic locations lost to time—from the jungles of Peru to the ancient ruins of Greece, the deserts of Egypt, and a mysterious Mediterranean island shrouded in myth. Traverse treacherous landscapes, solve deadly contraptions, and face lethal predators as you hunt for the scattered pieces of the Scion, an artifact of immeasurable power.
 Whether you're a veteran raider or new to Lara's world, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis delivers jaw-dropping visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern game design, and new surprises, while honoring the spirit and atmosphere of Lara Croft's debut adventure.

store.name: Swords & Slippers
store.short: A character action roguelite set in a twisted fairytale. These princesses don't want a rescue - they want the heads of the evil stepmothers who stole their happily ever after. Come for the curves. Stay for the combos.
store.about:
Stepmothers took the thrones. Princesses took up arms. Swords & Slippers is old-school character action with a roguelite kick. Fight as a squad of the fairytale heroines you know: reimagined, weaponized, and yours to lead.
 LOOK GOOD DOING IT
 Your attacks branch into deep combo routes, every hit landing with a satisfying crunch. Defense keeps you dangerous, while the style meter rewards creativity. Swap between your heroines mid-combo, never drop the chain, and look gorgeous while the body count climbs.

 EVERY PRINCESS IS A WEAPON
 Snow White crushes foes with a dwarven pickaxe. Red Hood is the wolf of her own story. Rapunzel's hair has a mind - and a mouth - of its own. No two heroines fight alike, and the roster grows alongside the rebellion.
 STEPMOTHERS DON'T FIGHT FAIR
 Armored knights and twisted creatures are only the beginning. Survive long enough, and you'll come face to face with the storybook legends of your childhood, reimagined as bosses built to break you.
 POWER UP BEFORE MIDNIGHT
 Every run begins at dawn. Arm your heroines with elemental powers and unleash them through skillful combat. Earn new powers and grow stronger as the hours pass. You'll need everything you've got by midnight, when enemies are deadliest and rewards richest.

 CHARMING HAS WORK TO DO
 Between runs, the heroines come home to the castle - and to you, Prince Charming. Win their trust, uncover their secrets, and let your choices shape each heroine's story. Romance them if you like - but mind your cursed charm, or affection curdles into dangerous obsession.

 RETELL THE FAIRYTALES
 The...

store.name: Hell Express
store.short: Hell Express is a PVE Co-op isometric shooter for 1-4 players. As a member of an armed delivery company operating between the living world and Limbo, you'll craft, loot, and fight to complete high-stakes deliveries—while uncovering the stories between life and death.
store.about:
Hell Express is a PvE isometric extraction shooter for 1-4 players, blending heart-pounding combat, high-risk treasure hunts, and strategic resource management in a world teetering between life and death.
 As a member of Hell Express—an armed delivery company that sends delivery to Limbo—you'll choose from a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities and personal motives. Dive into the perilous depths of Limbo, complete dangerous deliveries, and scavenge for treasures to upgrade your gear and vehicles. But beware: every decision could mean the difference between survival and ruin.

 Key Features 
 A high-stakes isometric extraction shooter: Intense combat, balanced tactical raids, resource gambles, and precision extraction timing under survival pressure.

 Gun customization system: Scavenge components to forge gear that defines your playstyle.

 A road trip adventure: Freely explore limbo with an armed and custom Hell Trekker.

 Unique art style & dark humor: Tell stories that grip your heart, explore life, death, and what lies between.

store.name: Where Winds Meet
store.short: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.
store.about:
Jianghu knows no bounds. Play free across XBOX, PS5, PC, and mobile with full cross-play and cross-progression. No pay-to-win. 
 Gameplay content is entirely free, with monetization limited to cosmetic items. 
 In Where Winds Meet, Chinese martial arts meet a seamless open world. Roam vast landscapes, uncover hidden ruins, and descend into layered underground catacombs. Steal techniques from martial sects, wield an arsenal of classic wuxia weaponry, and master over 30 mystic arts – from the flowing balance of Tai Chi to the force of Lion's Roar.
 Craft, architecture, astronomy, folk games and performance, medicine and healing – 16 systems come together to form an immersive ancient society.

 A Living Open-World History 
 Jianghu knows no bounds.
 Ancient landscapes, traditional crafts, stories drawn from history and realistic graphics come together to build a world true to the spirit of wuxia.
 Immerse yourself in the captivating Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period of China, where epic battles and legendary tales shape the course of history. From the bustling imperial capital to the hidden wilderness, every path is filled with secrets and adventures.
 Traverse vast landscapes in wuxia style: scale rooftops with fluid parkour, ride the windstride across miles in moments, or use fast travel points to leap between regions.

 Adventure Alone or Forge Your Community 
 Embark on a narrative-driven adventure filled with rich solo gameplay, or team up with up to four friends for seamless co-op experiences.
 Join or create a Guild to access group activities: intense guild wars,...

store.name: Goobies 2
store.short: Blow up blobs and battle bosses in co-op! Find your favorite goobie and master its abilities and evolutions. Combine mutations into unique builds and collect powerful evolving omens in this roguelite shooter.
store.about:
The goobies are working together with the blobs! Gaia has assembled the most powerful goobies in order to stop Haibel's mind controlling tyranny and bring back a forgotten peace...

 Goobies come in all shapes and forms, each with unique abilities and evolution trees. Choose from the original 5 goobies or discover the 5 new ones! 

 Design your goobie by unlocking and combining more than 60 genetic goobie mutations. Each mutation behaves differently and can be added multiple times into the pool as long as there is space. 

 Gather strength while you can by collecting over  40 powerful omens that evolve with new properties as they grow in quantity.

 36 artifacts and 3 difficulties await you to alter the rules of the blobverse...

store.name: Darkhaven
store.short: Darkhaven is a next-generation ARPG brought to you by many of the original creators of Diablo and Diablo II. Explore a procedurally generated and fully destructible open world unlike any other in this solo or multiplayer adventure.
store.about:
Darkhaven is a dark-fantasy isometric ARPG set in the aftermath of a total collapse of civilization. You are a survivor in a world where the wild lands and monsters have reclaimed the ruins of long-dead empires. To survive, you must venture beyond the safety of your meager stronghold to hunt the remnants of evil and become the hero this world awaits. Unearth items of legendary power, learn arcane skill trees, and master a combat system that rewards skill and positioning over simple stat-checks.

 Every Player’s Game is Unique 

 Darkhaven moves away from the disconnected, "hallway-and-room" logic of traditional random layouts. We use ecological rules to stitch together biomes, handcrafted points of interest, and terrain that make sense. Every world is unique, yet feels cohesive with a rich implied history. Exploration isn't just a path to the next set of mobs; it’s the discovery of a vast and living realm.

 Totally Dynamic Worlds 
 The terrain in Darkhaven is fully deformable. You can dig into the earth to harvest resources, discover hidden caves, tunnel through dungeon walls, or rebuild ruined fortresses. Drain lakes to uncover sunken ruins or redirect flows of lava to form an impassable moat. You can also build. Raise the earth to create islands, fortify defensive positions, and construct everything from bridges to entire settlements. The land is your dominion, and its destiny is in your hands. 

 Lurking Horrors  
 Malevolent forces prey on the remains of this dying realm. Tendrils of darkness worm through the veil from other planes, tearing open rifts in reality. Each...

store.name: Cozy Game Restoration
store.short: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.
store.about:
Cozy Game Restoration is about the quiet satisfaction of restoring something that matters. You’ll unwrap carefully sealed packages to discover old, battered video game cartridges. They'll be covered in stickers, markers, dust, and all the accumulation of time. Each one is different, flawed in its own way, and waiting to be brought back to life.

 RESTORE FORGOTTEN RETRO GAMES 
 Every cartridge is procedurally dirtied. Some have clean labels but cracked shells. Others are scuffed, drawn on, or covered in adhesive residue. Grime is layered.
