store.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
store.short: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.
store.about: This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

store.name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
store.short: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.
store.about:
Experience a new twist on a familiar genre 🔥

 Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix is a Roguelite Strategy/Tactical RPG, blending elements of the classics with a modern twist. 

 Embark on a fantastical journey of revenge and conspiracy, written by award-winning fantasy novelist Shami Stovall , writer of series such as Firth Chronicles , Chronos Chronicles , and more.

 Fight through a series of tightly designed strategic battles while building a formidable army though Roguelike-style upgrades and loot. Experiment with party synergies, combining skills, equipment, and classes as you advance across a procedurally generated world map.

 Unlock characters and grow their relationships at camp in-between runs. Customize your expeditions as you make lasting progress on your continent-spanning quest.

 Astral Throne II continues the unique blend of Roguelike, Strategy, and RPG  introduced in its predecessor

 Strategize around Weapon and Magic triangles , stat and experience distribution, and permadeath 

 Build each character throughout runs with loot, level-ups, shops , and other discoveries

 Encounters are handcrafted to retain the tight design of a strategic experience, but have pockets of variation to keep you on your toes

 Strategically navigate a dynamic  ever-changing world map , ensuring no two runs look alike

 Build a varied team of memorable characters , from valiant knights to wily gamblers and everything in between

 Synergize your builds with hundreds of skills, weapons, and items , which differ every run

 Adapt your gameplay to run-altering collectibles that...

store.name: Rayman Legends Retold
store.short: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!
store.about:
Pre-purchase any edition of Rayman Legends Retold and receive the exclusive Hoodlum Havoc Pack, containing 2 costumes for Rayman and Globox inspired by Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc.

Includes: the base game + Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition.

Embark on a bold reimagining of the acclaimed platformer, filled with new content and narrative twists. When a shadowy villain spreads corruption across the Glade of Dreams, journey through its charming worlds solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op in a fast‑paced, side‑scrolling adventure where every stumble and surprise adds to the delightful chaos.

Leap, glide, and punch your way through worlds bursting with charm and delightful surprises. Craving a change of pace? Dive into unforgettable musical stages, where every move must sync with the beat for a rhythm‑powered thrill.

Immerse yourself in a world brimming with life, reimagined with stunning visuals. A rich selection of iconic levels returns alongside a mysterious sixth realm and 4 new musical stages. Saddle up for epic dragon rides and test your skills in the Cave of Trials.

Join Rayman and his friends on their most ambitious adventure yet, facing a new foe stirring trouble from the underworld. Voiced cinematics and an expanded soundtrack by Christophe Héral and Grant Kirkhope bring the journey to life, blending original themes with new compositions.

Play the entire adventure in up to 4-player couch co-op, racing for Lums or knocking each other off to claim every last Teensy. Kung Foot also returns with improved controls, power-ups, and customizable rules for hours of frantic...

store.name: MeowFactory
store.short: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!
store.about:
In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY THEY can revive production!
 Yes, yes, ONLY MEOWORKERS!

 Build magnificent factories to meet the needs of laazy hoomans!
 And don’t forget — when your meoworkers only have paws, hammies are tough to handle. 
 Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour!
 Oh, also keep an eye on your fluffy conveyor belt riders and pull them away before they stick their curious noses into machines! 

 Build a full production cycle to maximize product variety for your customers!
 And make sure your fluffy employees don't gobble up everything along the way! 
 Gather a team of professionals! Look after their mood, cleanliness, and find the right place for each of them!
 Otherwise, these cats will blow up, puke on, or burn down everything you've built, or at the very least turn your nice and tidy factory into a branch of cat hell. 

And break the record for the number of days without accidents! 
 It will be EXTREMELY DIFFICULT. All this awaits you at the MEOWFACTORY!

store.name: Pogo Together
store.short: Bounce, fall, rage, and climb together. Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based precision platformer where ridiculously jacked animals attempt to conquer brutal obstacles on pogo sticks. Help each other, kick each other off, or take on the climb alone.
store.about:
One pogo stick. One ridiculously jacked animal. Absolutely no dignity.
 Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based climbing game where you and your friends take control of absurdly muscular animals and attempt to bounce your way to the top.

 SUFFER TOGETHER 
 Bring your friends along and try to make it to the top together.
 Work together through difficult sections and climb as a group (or kick someone off a platform and send their progress down with them).

 Play nice or make things worse. It’s up to you.
 Prefer to suffer in peace? You can play solo too.

 MASTER THE POGO 
 Learn a physics-driven movement system where balance, timing, momentum, and control determine whether you stick the landing or go flying back down.
 The controls are simple. Getting good at them is another story.

 MEET THE CREW 
 Choose from a cast of bizarre, suspiciously jacked animals, each equally unqualified to operate a pogo stick.
 Unlock new characters as you play and find your favorite way to look ridiculous while falling from extreme heights.

 ONE MISTAKE CAN COST EVERYTHING 
 Climb through increasingly dangerous environments filled with tiny platforms, moving obstacles, traps, shortcuts, and jumps that looked much easier from below.
 There are no stairs. There is only pogo.

store.name: Beastfolk Barber
store.short: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.
store.about:
Beastfolk Barber is a narrative game where every haircut is a conversation. You play as Freddie, a barber running a small shop for beastfolk of all shapes and sizes. With every cut and chat, learn what your customers like, what they need, and who they want to be. 

 One day, a demon appears in your mirror with an offer. Give her the perfect haircut, and she'll undo a past regret. But first, you'll need to keep serving customers, gather resources, and find a way to cut a demon's hair. Along the way, you'll come face to face with what you've been trying to avoid.

 Features 
 The Mysterious Mirror 

 Created by Freddie's late friend, this mirror can show customers their new hairstyle before you make the first cut. But previews are limited, so watch their reactions and make every choice count.
 Haircuts and Conversations 

 Every customer brings a different challenge to the barber's chair. Listen, observe, and find the look they're really after. As you cut their hair, customers open up about everyday worries unique to their species. And every haircut brings you closer to who they really are.
 Life Around the Barbershop 

 When the day ends, review customer feedback and scroll through the city's social feed. Local news, festivals, and the latest from your customers may all come in handy the next time someone sits in your chair. As the story unfolds, a citywide celebration will bring every familiar face back to your little shop.
 Keep Them Coming Back 

 How well you handle each haircut affects your customers' stories and the chances you'll see them again. Get it wrong, and...

store.name: Soulframe
store.short: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.
store.about:
Rise as an Envoy in a living world besieged by conquerors. Live alongside your Ancestors and manifest primal aspects of the natural world in your defense. Combine the strength of your Pacts, Weapons and Virtues solo or with friends to take back Midrath and free the Omen Beasts from the Ode. Rise, Envoy
The Spellsong, that enchanted melody that sounded over Alca on Ode'n Descent, caused all to forget. Forget their rites, their divine Omen Beasts, themselves. Now, the people of Alca can only believe their rulers have always been so: their right to rule as sure as the rising of twin suns Mora and Saphene. The Omen Beasts they worshipped lay defiled, corrupted by Ode'n Ichor. Their pact may have granted strength enough to rebel against Alca's invaders, yet none remain to free them of their bindings. None but you, Envoy. 

Your blood is that of ancient Fey, not so easily swayed by the Ode'n Magicks draped over the land. It falls to you to dam the steady flow of ichorous corruption and heal the worldflesh of Alca. For none are beyond saving, and it is never too late to be redeemed. Feybled Arms 
The bonds you forge with Omen Beasts manifest as Pacts, granting Arcanic abilities in your shared rebellion against the Ode. Whether you favour Courage, Grace, or Spirit, embody your chosen Virtues to match your approach. Courage, a heroic charge into the fray. Grace, the sly stealth of roguish tricksters or the patient aim of marksmen hunters. Spirit, attuned to the flows of magick deep in Alca's roots. Wield blade, bow, and magick to great effect as you craft and master your chosen...

store.name: The Missing Tail
store.short: The Missing Tail is a cozy co-op adventure where you play as two cats exploring a lively medieval courtyard and castle.
store.about:
The Missing Tail is a cozy co-op adventure where you play as two cats exploring a lively medieval courtyard and castle. Explore a bustling medieval courtyard and castle, complete quests, interact with townsfolk, and uncover secrets together. Choose between the royal palace cat or the clever stray and shape your own adventure!

 Once upon a time, a royal cat lived a peaceful, rich life until one disastrous event turned its life upside down. On the other hand, a stray cat tried to save its food from menacing forest creatures. Suddenly, both their lives became intertwined in one epic journey. Join both cats on a fun and emotional adventure trying to find a path home.

 Team up with a friend and explore the world together in split-screen third-person gameplay. Solve co-op puzzles and platform your way through the adventure, help other animals in their troubles, and interact with the surroundings as a true feline duo.

 Play as a noble royal palace cat or a clever stray. Each path offers its own personality and perspective on the world.

 Don’t forget to have fun and make people's lives a bit harder! Be a dual mini-chaos team and enjoy breaking and pushing annoying objects where they disturb your peace.

 Explore a vibrant castle environment filled with lively streets, charming courtyards, and rooftop pathways. Roam freely, leap across buildings, and uncover hidden corners waiting to be discovered.

store.name: Apple Crumble
store.short: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.
store.about:
Apple Crumble is a suspenseful interactive mystery set during your grandma’s 84th birthday party. 
 One of the guests is out to knife your Nan, but the question is – who?  

 It’s down to you to uncover the truth. Explore your childhood home, reconnect with your dysfunctional family, and work out who you can trust before it’s time for tea in this short, twisty thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

 A creepy-cosy walking sim where you must explore every room of the family home and talk to each family member invited to Grandma's birthday in order to piece together the truth.

 Featuring a fully voiced cast:
 Your beloved grandma

 Your stressed-out mum

 Your midlife crisis uncle

 The weird man in your bedroom

 Disclaimer: This is a short game! Playtime is 60-90 minutes.

store.name: Born of the Moon
store.short: Trapped in the von Adelstein mansion, one of you has already made a pact with the beast. Born of the Moon is a social horror for 3-6 players. Asymmetrical roles, sabotage, and insanity mechanics are deadlier than monsters. Will you survive until dawn if you can't even trust your own ears?
store.about:
“In Grey Hills, a friend's voice isn't always friendly.”
 Your minibus is stuck in a storm. The only shelter is the old von Adelstein mansion. You thought the cold outside was the worst part. You were wrong.
 Born of the Moon  is a cooperative horror game with social deduction elements where 3-6 players try to survive the night. One of you is the Werewolf , whose goal is to ensure no one sees the sunrise.
 KEY FEATURES

 Asymmetry & Paranoia  You are not just "survivors." Everyone has a role and their own truth. The Scientist sees hidden signs and the beast's fears. The Quiet One can hide where the monster gets stuck. The Doctor saves lives, but who will save his sanity? Information is scarce—and that breeds distrust.

 Unpredictable Threat  The Werewolf is a player who can pretend to be human and sabotage the group. But the real terror comes from Random Events . Every 7 minutes, the rules change:
 — Will a Clean Moon rise, granting a moment of respite?
 — Or will the Blood Moon  ascend, amplifying the beast’s powers while survival chances drop to zero?

 You never know which scenario will unfold this time.

 Fear & Insanity Mechanics Darkness kills not just the body, but the mind. The higher your anxiety meter, the less you can trust your senses.
 — *Fright Effect:* You stop hearing your friends at the most critical moment.
 — *Hallucinations:* You see enemies where there are none, wasting precious ammo on empty space.

 Tactics vs. Brute Force The mansion is cramped. The Werewolf is strong but huge—he gets stuck in doorways and breaks furniture. Use the environment! The...

store.name: Phantom Blade Zero
store.short: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
store.about:
Framed for murdering his master, Soul suffers a devastating wound to the heart, leaving him just sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted, he roams the Wulin, determined to unravel a conspiracy that has ensnared the martial world.
 Through rain and blood, kindness and vengeance, he embarks on a journey where love and hatred intertwine in search of a heart.

 Explore the mysterious Phantom World, where shifting light and shadow conceal mysteries at every turn.
 Memory Flowers, the Wulin and the Discordance, Transcension, the Lady of the Veil, Inanis' Dreamscape...
 Every secret leads to another, and every corner hides a new story.
 When one path ends, another begins. Hidden passages and intricate mechanisms await those who dare to explore.

 In the Wulin, your weapon is your life.
 Master over 30 primary weapons and more than 20 unique Phantom Edges, wrested from the hands of fallen foes.
 Rooted in traditional martial arts, combat flows through seamless combos that are easy to learn yet rewarding to master. Only true masters will uncover the deadly intricacies within every technique.
 Blades clash in showers of sparks. Dodge, deflect, counter, and strike in one seamless flow, where victory and defeat are decided in an instant.
 Will the next turn leave the sands stained with blood, or lead you back from the brink of death?

 The golden age of wuxia cinema collides with punk fantasy in Phantom Blade Zero.
 Martial arts, cold steel, mechanical prosthetics, crumbling industrial ruins, traditional Chinese aesthetics, and modern rock music. 
 Together, they create the dark,...

store.name: Give Us A Sign
store.short: Give Us A Sign is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror simulation. As an investigator, use specialized equipment to detect entities and gather evidence in haunted locations. Every word you speak shapes the haunting around you. Once you ask for a sign, there is no turning back.
store.about:
Enter haunted locations alone or with up to three friends, gather evidence and name the entity before it comes for you. Every device in your kit is crafted to feel real in your hands: each click, hum and burst of static carries meaning. Some tools measure the room. Others reveal a figure standing where your eyes see nothing at all. 
 ㅤ
 ㅤ

 Each map is built around its own kind of psychological horror, with its own history and its own way of getting under your skin. Nothing here is set dressing. The objects around you notice you, shift when you look away, and slowly turn the place itself against your mind. The entity is not the only thing working on your sanity. 
 ㅤ
 ㅤ

 Four field agents are ready for duty, each with a distinct look. Pick the one who fits you and step into the dark. This is only the first roster: new agents, outfits and deeper customization are on the way. 
 ㅤ
 ㅤ

 Meet Gianna, the heart of the safe house workshop and the one person who cares about your gear more than you do. From high-fidelity detection tools to survival essentials, she makes sure you never step into the dark unprepared. But she is more than your supplier: when Gianna needs something done in the field, you are the one she asks. 
 ㅤ
 ㅤ

 Oscar is your experienced guide and the steady voice of the safe house. He scouts the most haunted locations so you never go in blind, and his firsthand knowledge shapes every investigation you choose. But Oscar does more than point at a map: he has assignments of his own for you, and not all of them are simple.
 ㅤ
 ㅤ

store.name: Aniimo
store.short: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!
store.about:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

 When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

 On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

 The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

 In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.
 Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become...

store.name: Zombie Hamsters
store.short: You're tiny zombie hamsters trapped in a dangerous laboratory. Find a way out, experiment with crazy abilities, and unleash chaos. Every escape is unique. No hints! Just one goal and one challenge — can you escape?
store.about:
Play solo or with friends. Explore a massive procedurally generated research laboratory filled with scientists, security guards, and mutant experiments. You're given a goal and the tools to achieve it — how you use them is entirely up to you! Plan and pull off your own unique escape!

 Infect
 Infect everyone around you and unleash a full-blown zombie apocalypse.

 Destroy
 The entire laboratory is yours to wreak havoc in!

 Challenge
 You have one goal — escape the laboratory. How you achieve it is up to you.

 Fear Your Teammates
 Your greatest enemy is your best friend.

 Mutants
 You're not alone! And not everyone is friendly.
 The only thing that matters is escaping the laboratory. What condition you leave it in is another story.
 Game Features
 4-Player Co-op — Explore the laboratory and overcome challenges together with your friends.

 Zombie Infection — Infect scientists, security guards, and other inhabitants of the laboratory.

 Stealth & Exploration — Sneak through narrow ventilation shafts and discover alternative routes.

 Puzzles & Platforming Challenges — There's no single right solution, only your choices and their consequences.

 Dangerous Laboratory — Avoid deadly traps, face hostile enemies, and expect the unexpected.

store.name: 8AM: The Graveyard
store.short: "8AM: The Graveyard" is a suspense game set in a fog-covered cemetery before dawn. Watch the surveillance cameras as unsettling events unfold and decide if it’s exhaustion, imagination, or something rising from the ground until 8:00 a.m.
store.about:
" 8AM: The Graveyard " confines the player to an old cemetery long past midnight. The air is heavy with mist, the lanterns flicker faintly between crooked tombstones, and the wind carries whispers that could be leaves — or something else. From your caretaker’s shack, dozens of cameras feed grainy footage of graves, statues, and silent paths shrouded in fog.

 You watch the screens, switching between crypts and mausoleums. A shadow stands near an open grave, vanishes when you change the view, then reappears beside another headstone — always closer. Somewhere in the distance, a bell tolls, though no church stands nearby. Your orders are clear: guard the grounds until 8:00 a.m., report disturbances, and never leave the shack.

 But as the night deepens, the cameras distort. Flowers move where no wind blows. Fresh soil sinks as if something beneath stirs. Figures wander among the graves only to disappear behind unmarked stones. Sometimes, in the reflection of the monitor, you glimpse a shape standing right behind you.

 Patterns emerge. A name repeats across different tombs. A cloaked figure appears at the same hour each night. The hum of the equipment begins to sync with your pulse as you question whether fatigue is playing tricks — or if the cemetery itself is waking from its long silence.

 Your task is simple: decide what is real. Each hour tests your composure as the line between the living and the dead fades under the pale light of dawn.

 When morning comes, the fog clears — but one monitor still flickers. It shows your shack, your chair, with someone else already...

store.name: Prison Fury
store.short: One of the most complex and difficult co-op games on Steam, where you and a friend play as ex-convicted cats trapped in a hellish prison. Must work together to escape before time's up.
store.about:
THE HARDEST CO-OP GAME ON STEAM!
 About This Game 
 Prison Fury is one of the most complex and difficult co-op games on Steam , where you and a friend play as ex-convicted cats trapped in a hellish prison.
 You and your friend must work together to escape before time's up.
 There are multiple traps, multiple paths, highly complex puzzles, and A LOT OF DEATHS! If this game doesn't test your friendship, nothing will.
 Why you’ll love it
 Complex puzzle to figure out together

 Pure teamwork, Communication is key to figure all the puzzles.

 Prison Fury is 2-player online co-op — Now Friend Pass available!!

store.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
store.short: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players
store.about:
The last Sprýg Gnomes in Midgård are driven from their home by Oden and his corruption, leaving them one place left to go: Trollheim, a magical realm of mythical beings where trolls, faeries and sirens are real.  Set out into the unknown to reunite with your lost kin, and behold the untold tales of the Väsen who dwell in the Dark Forest alongside you.
 TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a PvE survival adventure where you must reunite your gnome companions to survive and thrive together in the Dark Forest. Explore an ancient Nordic wilderness, uncover its mysteries, encounter the Väsen - the mythical beings of Nordic folk belief, and make the forest your home. Play solo or with up to 7 friends in a procedurally grown forest sandbox.
 The Dark Forest found you. 

 Into the Dark Forest 

 Step into an ancient forest through the eyes of a tiny gnome. Every tall pine, mossy hill and damp rock is a climb, and every climb is a challenge of its own. Stumble across scattered gnome dwellings, delve into mossy caverns and explore carefully curated biomes teeming with life.
 The pressure to survive drives you forward, opening up new possibilities and discoveries as the Dark Forest reveals itself as a living world of mystery, wonder and danger. Cold, hunger and hidden threats push you to adapt. Gather blueberries and twigs, craft everything from arrows to musical instruments. This is a wilderness not just meant to be explored, but a place to understand and ultimately call home.
 Live Among the Väsen 

 The Väsen: Trolls, faeries, sirens and other mythical beings also call the Dark Forest home, each...

store.name: GANG OF DRAGON
store.short: A new action-adventure game from game creator Toshihiro Nagoshi, set in the streets of Shinjuku, Tokyo. Starring Ma Dong-seok as Shin Ji-seong, the story unfolds with heated and intense human drama across Shinjuku, including Kabukicho — one of Japan’s largest entertainment districts.
store.about:
An action-adventure set in Kabukicho, the iconic nightlife district of Shinjuku, Tokyo.

Shin Ji-seong — portrayed by renowned Asian actor Ma Dong-seok — is a high-ranking member of a Korean crime syndicate based in Kabukicho. As he explores the streets of Shinjuku, Shin becomes entangled in underworld conflicts and forges intense, human connections that push him to confront his own sense of purpose.

Combat unfolds from a third-person perspective, centered on Shin’s overwhelming physical power. Engage enemies through brutal hand-to-hand strikes, precise blade attacks, gunplay, and high-impact vehicle action across the city.

Forge your own path through a story where violence and human bonds intertwine.

store.name: Project Exodus
store.short: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players in which you must hunt monsters and convert them into biomass to meet the quota for "The Ark". Collect artifacts, earn money, and buy upgrades to improve your chances of survival.
store.about:
Project Exodus is an online co-op horror game featuring proximity voice chat, a shared team arsenal, and terrifying monsters. You and up to 5 friends can explore dangerous maps to harvest valuable Biomass using your specialized Net-Launchers.

 Earth isn't what it used to be. After the war that forced humanity to flee, the local fauna mutated into horrible beings. Explore unique maps harboring monsters of all kinds. Your job is to hunt them. They're terrifying, ridiculous, and most importantly, a potent source of Biomass.

 Survival in space isn't free. While "The Ark" desperately needs Biomass to survive, your paycheck comes from the strange Artifacts left behind. Your mission: Meet the Biomass quota to save humanity... and sell every Artifact you find to get paid.

 The basic Net-Launcher is courtesy of the Ark, but you won't last long with it. Invest your profits in new Net firmware (Electric, Heavy...). Thanks to the Ark's data network, when one crew member unlocks a net, the entire team gets access. Combine different types to hunt efficiently.

 Your paycheck comes from Artifacts, so spend it wisely at the Cave's shop. Buy vital items like medkits, flashlights or even decoys. This gear is essential to survive long enough to extract with even more artifacts.

 The Ark doesn't waste resources. If your main unit is destroyed, your consciousness chip activates a backup "Mini-bot." You can't hunt, but you can help : light the way, distract threats, or just scream over voice chat while you run. But beware: this second chance is your last. If that little tin can is...

store.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
store.short: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.
store.about:
Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette, and push the demon till she spills it all!

 "No one's ever done this to me before...
 Ahh, you're incredible, darling."

 A shot glass Russian roulette with a demon who loves you enough to kill you.
 Survive the night, and savor seven flavors of ruin.

 ■The drunker you get, the wilder the game!
 Drink until the rules stop mattering, and unleash drunken tricks only a true barfly could master to make it out alive!

 ■A soul-on-the-line drinking survival game where you spill your soul or make her spill!
 A high-stakes roulette where every shot hits a little different!
 Only one rule: get the demon wasted and make her spill her soul to win!

 ■Femme Soule
 "Surrender your life to me, darling. Let's spend eternity together."
 In Hell's bar, Pandemonium, a liquor-soaked demon awaits—one who loves you enough to kill you.

 ♥ Let's sink into Hell side by side!
 Longing for a sip of madness and bliss? Down for a one-night stand with a demon? Hallelujah! Add Drunken Goddess Reflux to your wishlist and wait for the release half-drunk and smiling!

 ■ Staff
 Producer & Director: WHO YOU (Fuyuki Hayashi)

store.name: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life
store.short: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.
store.about:
Rekindled is a co-op tavern management game where you run your own tavern in a fantasy-medieval setting. You'll gather ingredients by foraging, fishing and farming, cook them in a variety of cooking stations, and present them how you'd like on plates for your customers. You can use the money earned to expand your tavern, buy more decorations, adopt pets and much more.
 Rekindled is different to most cooking games -  there's no stress! Customers don't make any demands of you; they simply buy the dishes you craft and arrange yourself.
 Exploration
 The area around your tavern is rich with resources and secrets, and you're free to explore as much or as little as you'd like.

 Decoration
 Expand your tavern and unlock, build and purchase a huge variety of furnishings to decorate it with. There is a silly amount of freedom (you can place items on walls and ceilings if you really want to!) so you can truly make the tavern your own.

 Cooking
 Enjoy total freedom to create the dishes you want to offer! You can make cheese boards, dessert trays, sushi platters and loads more, in any combination your heart desires. Unlock new foods and creation stations to unleash even more creative options. 

 Co-op Multiplayer
 The game can be played perfectly on your own, and you can also invite an un-capped number of your friends to help out. You share the same unlimited inventory for maximum freedom, and can collaborate or chill out as much as you want.

 Seasons and Weather
 Enjoy a variety of weather across the four seasons including fog, rain and snow. There's nothing cosier than hunkering...

store.name: Zenless Zone Zero
store.short: Zenless Zone Zero is HoYoverse’s brand-new urban fantasy ARPG. Players act as "Proxies" who explore Hollows alongside a wide range of unique Agents, fighting enemies, and completing commissions on their journey to unveil the mysteries behind New Eridu.
store.about:
Welcome to New Eridu — Where Humanity Rises Anew! 

 Zenless Zone Zero is a brand-new urban fantasy action RPG lovingly crafted by HoYoverse.
 In the game, a disaster known as "Hollows" brought modern civilization to its knees. Hollows appear out of the blue, spawning anomalous dimensions crawling with terrifying monsters called "Ethereals."
 In the wake of this catastrophic disaster, the last city to survive the apocalypse — New Eridu — used the technology and resources needed to combat the Hollows, overcame countless dangers, and gradually evolved into humanity's final bastion of civilization.
 In New Eridu, you'll step into the role of a Proxy — a professional who provides guidance to those who need to venture into the dangerous Hollows for various reasons. You'll embark on adventures with unique characters, exploring Hollows together, battling powerful enemies, completing commissions, and uncovering the secrets hidden within the city.

 Satisfying Combat, Igniting Your Passion for Action
 Zenless Zone Zero delivers smooth and exhilarating combat. Launch your offense with Basic Attacks and Special Attacks, counter enemy strikes through dodges and blocks, then string together flashy combos with Chain Attacks to finish them off. Different enemies have their own specialties and weaknesses — seizing the right opportunity and responding with precision is key to controlling the battle.

 Cutting-Edge Visuals, Maximum Audiovisual Experience
 Zenless Zone Zero features a striking art style and visual design that stands out. Characters boast incredibly detailed expressions and...

store.name: Gun a Rat
store.short: Don’t like rats? Don’t like your friends? Then this game is made for you! Hunt down the rats before they wreck the place, and methodically place your traps to slow them down as much as possible!
store.about:
Gun a Rat is a fast-paced asymmetrical multiplayer game to play with your friends.
 (Note: Multiplayer game that requires other online players or friends. Several solo modes in the works!) 
 Play as the Rats and wreck the house... or as the Exterminator , and wipe them out down to the last one.
Start matches from 2 to 20 players on a variety of maps, each with its own share of surprises, with 3 game modes to choose from…

 A very special voice chat... 
 Rats can talk to each other through voice chat without fear of being understood.

 The Exterminator only hears squeaks instead of their words!

 Your goal as a Rat: 
 Reach the target score by destroying and stealing objects before time runs out, without getting killed!

 But be careful... every destruction makes a noise that will give you away!

 If the Exterminator is hunting you down,
quickly hide in the furniture to escape their gaze.

 As the Exterminator: 
 Use your camera to track the rats' movements and find out where they're hiding...

 Place your traps carefully to slow them down as much as possible

 Kill them all!

 A wide range of traps is at your disposal,
each one holding its own nasty surprises for the Rats ...

 3 game modes to keep things fresh: 
 Classic : smash and steal as many objects as you can to reach the target score before time runs out!

 Hide and Seek : earn points by looking at the Exterminator ... but stay well hidden so you don't get spotted!

 Bomb Tag : an explosive game of tag! Pass the bomb to another player before it blows up in your snout!

 Play match after match to earn Cheese Coins ,...

store.name: END US
store.short: In this ruined world, nothing good happens at midnight. We fight, we hunt, we build. We tear from the earth whatever is left, just to buy a few more moments of life. You arrived here believing you were the only one. Maybe you were wrong. Would this be the last night?
store.about:
END US is an open-world survival game, set in the ruins of a civilization that once thrived. 
 The bell rang... and kept ringing. Those seconds that drag on too long, the kind you learn to hate. Just enough time to shut a door, push something against it, pray it would hold. Not because there was hope. But because nothing good happens at midnight, and they were coming to prove it once again.
 The lights were the first to go. Then, order. Then, the people. What's left doesn't have a name yet, it only has teeth, hunger, and patience. In END US, you don't play to win. You play to not be the next to disappear. Every resource you carry cost something. Every structure you raise is a promise the world will try to break. And out there, in the dark, there are things that have learned to wait.

 The day is yours. Use it well. Scavenge, build, improvise, turn every fragment you find into something that can keep you alive a few hours longer. Every wire, every rusted blade, every piece of wood has a place in what you're building. Because at midnight, without fail, they come. The possessed don't choose, they are the dark with legs, husks of people the world no longer needed. But the living who show up in the darkness are worse. They choose to be there. Hunger does that to people. The day is yours. The night is theirs.

 The soil is dead, but not completely. Learn to farm, to harvest, to keep your body running in a world that would rather you didn't exist. Hunger, stamina, and health aren't just numbers: they're how much you have left before you stop. Every action has a cost. But every...

store.name: Too Deep To Quit
store.short: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!
store.about:
Too Deep To Quit is a 1-4 player co-op survival exploration game. Gather your team of adventurers, brave the dangers of cursed temples, and claim the ultimate treasure.

 A true adventurer knows how to improvise. These cursed temples hold a lot more than just gold, they’re packed with the leftovers of the poor saps who came before you. Check every dark corner for whatever keeps you breathing.

 Sure, starving to death is bad, but getting squashed by the walls is definitely worse. Every hallway is a literal death trap waiting for the clumsy guy in your squad to mess up.

 If the traps don’t get you, the locals will. These forgotten temples are the perfect breeding ground for anything that slithers, stings, or bites. 

 It belongs in a museum... but it’ll look way better in your bank account. Deep within these ruins lie priceless artifacts and solid gold idols just waiting to be claimed.

store.name: cenker's mod
store.short: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.

store.name: Debauchery & Magic
store.short: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.
store.about:
In Debauchery & Magic , you find yourself in the world of Haven: A fantastical place filled to the brim of your wizard hat with never-ending celebrations and a bustling economy fueled by indulgence. As expected, the newly crowned Prince Baytre’s coronation was a party for the ages!  
 Or it was...until you woke up the next morning. 
 Debauchery has been outlawed. Revelry is banned. Shenanigans of all sorts are no longer tolerated by the royal family, by penalty of death. 
 That is, unless you step up. 

 Solo, or with up to 11 friends, take the fight to Haven’s shadow government and leave a blazing trail of indulgence in your wake. 
 Quest, loot, and fight the powers that be with a variety of magic and weaponry. Drink concoctions that empower your spells but ruin your coordination. Smoke alchemical blends that'll send you into next week. Gamble your life savings in gold against the house, or your friends, in a myriad of games hidden away in secretive casinos. Or just laze the day away fishing for exotic and uncouth aquatic creatures. 
 Along the way, you can even stunt on the townsfolk with your gnarly skateboard skills across the fantasy world of Haven. 

 Dive into a dark-fantasy world where spellcasting, danger, and indulgence collide. Explore cursed kingdoms, tavern hideouts, underground gambling halls, and halls of arcane corruption as you shape your destiny through equal parts mystical energy and reckless decision-making . 
 The royal family won’t know what hit them, until a fireball is headed their way. 

 It’ll take more than moxie and harsh words to free the...

store.name: Fleshborn
store.short: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.
store.about:
A short incremental game where you must purge a derelict research facility overrun by creeping fleshy growths. Armed with your flamethrower , you'll burn through spreading biohazards, uncover secrets and grow ever more powerful as you progress.

 Collect the blood dropped by these organic growths and spend it in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities to change the course of your runs.

 As you clear rooms and progress through floors, uncover the eerie secrets behind the research facility and unravel the mystery of what really happened to you.

 Explore and clear all five levels to contain the growth.

store.name: Bradley the Badger
store.short: Bradley, the beloved platforming icon, finds himself lost in strange new lands... and decides to fight back! Shape unfinished worlds with your game developer powers, explore a genre-bending story, and save your home in this unique action-adventure. Wishlist now and join Bradley’s journey!
store.about:
Bradley the Badger is a love letter to games . It’s an action-adventure that blends exploration, traversal and mind-bending freeform puzzles, all brought to life through a satirical narrative that features moments in live-action. 
 A beloved platforming icon wakes up to a world that no longer makes sense. Longing to return home, Bradley embarks on a journey to save his world and his friends at all costs, even if that means coming face to face with a revelation bigger than anything he ever imagined.  
 Across wildly different playable worlds, “inspired” by famous games but stuck in development hell, you’ll experience a unique narrative told through the enthusiastic, curious, and endlessly playful eyes of a videogame mascot. Will Bradley rescue Dreamwoods?

 Core Gameplay – an action-adventure like no other 
 You will explore, double-jump, solve challenges, fight with your trusted frying pan across unfinished game worlds that are very much in need of a creative spark. Maybe that’s what you’ll contribute to save the day? There will be items to collect, quests to answer, secrets to unravel. And as much as Bradley would hope that this is gaming as usual, things will definitely be unlike anything he has ever experienced.   

 The Kit 
 At the heart of our game is the Kit . It’s a tool that lets Bradley modify every unfinished asset he can find, just as if he was a game developer. It’s systemic, immediate, and completely transforms how you approach exploration, traversal, puzzles, and combat. It might even change the way you think about this game.

 Here are some functions you’ll...

store.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000
store.short: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.
store.about:
WAGE TOTAL WAR IN THE 41st MILLENNIUM 
 Total War’s award-winning fusion of turn-based strategy and colossal real-time battles descends into the grim, science-fantasy universe of Warhammer 40,000.

 In the Era Indomitus, the galaxy is aflame with endless war, and every soul’s survival hangs by a thread. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

 There is no time for peace. No respite. No forgiveness. There is only war.

 COMMAND FOUR ICONIC FACTIONS 
 Lead campaigns across the void with four radically distinct factions, each forged with their own unique array of lore-inspired gameplay features, devastating weaponry, apocalyptic war machines, and methods of warfare.

 ● Space Marines: Genetically enhanced weapons of war, these warriors are few in number but near unmatched in power. Clad in sacred armour and wielding the Imperium’s most deadly weaponry, each strikes with devastating and unyielding precision. 
 ● Orks: Brutish hordes of destruction, they are unrelenting, countless and live for war. Storming the battlefield in endless mobs, they brandish unpredictable weapons and clanking war machines - all driven by the primal power of the WAAAGH! 
 ● Aeldari: An ancient and waning xenos race, who once ruled the stars, but now rail against their certain fate. Swift and elusive, they strike with psychic precision and elegant weaponry, exploiting weakness before vanishing into shadow. 
 ● Astra Militarum: The massed ranks of humanity’s largest fighting force are a bulwark of...

store.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
store.short: Escape the ordinary with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Embark on a party adventure with goofy greetings in We Forgot a Card, wild image warping in Hyperface, absurd arguments in Debate and Switch, team-based fact battles in Idol Factions, and mind-melding friendship in MegaPals.
store.about:
Escape to a world of hilarity with The Jackbox Party Pack 12!
 Our team of Chicago comedians and party wizards set out to create all-new concepts that bring the thrill to holiday gatherings, dinner parties, game nights, and happy hours. Travel between joke-writing, photo alteration, absurd disputes, and fact battles to create a night perfectly suited to your crowd. 
 We’ve tailored this pack to help you shake off your humdrum day and make your game night run like a dream. Only one person needs to own the game in order for all to play! Use your phones or web-enabled devices as controllers to make it easy to join and get started.
 The Jackbox Party Pack 12 arrives just in time for the holiday season and can be enjoyed on any night that deserves a special touch. Is it a Monday? Kick the week off right. The day you went to the dentist? Show off your clean smile. You have a bunch of stuff due tomorrow? Tomorrow can wait!

 Learn more about these five games:

 MegaPals (Speed, Guessing)
 A mind-melding game that celebrates friends both old and new! See how connected you are with your pals through impulsive wordsmithing and explosive match-ups. How well do you know how your fellow players think? (3-8 players)

 Hyperface (Head-to-Head, Photoediting)
 A game where you take selfies or use stock photos and warp them in wild ways in order to respond to bizarre prompts like “your face when you’ve just seen a bear.” Smudge, yank, squash, and draw on photos to create one-of-a-kind masterpieces meant to be shared! (3-8 players)

 We Forgot a Card (Design, Joke-Writing)
 A game where you...

store.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
store.short: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.
store.about:
In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. Thief was the first stealth game to use light and sound as game mechanics to help you hide from and sneak up on characters, rather than simply attacking them. Remastered with Nightdive’s KEX Engine, the release includes Thief: The Dark Project and the additional missions, content and updates from the 1999 Thief Gold re-release. Explore unscripted, maze-like levels with advanced NPCs, who can hear, speak, and sound alarms if you make a wrong move. Each mission includes 3 difficulty settings with different objectives for maximum replayability. 

 Play as Garrett, an orphan rescued from the streets by the Keepers—a secretive, ancient order dedicated to maintaining balance in the world—and trained to become a Master Thief. Using minimal weapons and maximum stealth, you must keep to the shadows and move quietly to complete missions and collect treasure without too many casualties. Use your blackjack to knock enemies unconscious, your sword when you need to battle, and an assortment of unique arrows that aid in your covert quest. Uncover the hidden agendas of your allies and enemies as you play through an unravelling story of deception and revenge.

 Thief: The Dark Project Remastered includes enhancements to graphic textures, models, animations, and more. Also includes...

store.name: ZERO Sievert 2
store.short: ZERO Sievert 2 is a top-down PvE extraction shooter set in the ruined country of Zakov. Hunt alone or with a crew, face anomalies, bandits, and mutants, and make it out alive.
store.about:
ZERO Sievert 2 is a top-down PvE extraction shooter set in the Zakov Exclusion Zone . 
 Play solo or with friends across procedurally generated maps filled with anomalies, bandits, and mutants.
 Extract alive, sell your loot, and gear up for the next Hunt.

 Hunt solo or with up to four players. Move together, cover more ground, and back each other up when things turn south. Every Hunter gains experience in co-op, keeps their own gear and loot, and can pursue their own quests during the same Hunt.

 ZERO Sievert 2 sends Hunters across new and returning maps, each with its own threats, landmarks, and opportunities. Each Hunt changes the layout, but fixed landmarks help you navigate, find loot, and spot danger early.
 Conditions can change a Hunt in an instant. Day turns to night. Fog rolls in. Blizzards cut visibility. Acid rain makes every minute outside riskier , and on some Hunts, special events can block routes, draw factions into open conflict, or pull you into fights you did not start.

 Anomalies are one of Zakov’s defining threats, and Hunters learn quickly to test the path ahead with bolts before moving forward. They can be deadly, but they also leave behind crystals valuable enough to draw Hunters back into the Zone.
 Relics - new in ZERO Sievert 2 - are powerful objects linked to those same anomalies. Hunters can equip them for passive bonuses, and the most powerful relics can even grant active abilities. Every use pushes a relic closer to destabilisation. Push one too far, and it can trigger a Catastrophic Failure .

 Your Hunter develops through four skill...

store.name: Supreme Experiment
store.short: In a world abandoned by humans, machines have evolved into a new species—and found their own gods. Survive, explore, and fight to uncover the truth and realize that... nothing is what it seems. Perhaps, you can still save what remains of humanity.
store.about:
THE WORLD ABOVE 
 It has been a century since humanity retreated into the Spire Cities—towers stretching eight kilometers into the sky, high above the toxic clouds . Down on the surface, fleets of intelligent machines were left to maintain the world and supply the towers with everything we needed.
 Since then, everything ran on its own. No one remembers how it works anymore. The city above the clouds is the only world we know.

 THE SILENCE 
 But one day, the flow of resources simply... stopped . The machines fell silent. No signal. No explanation. Hunger and cold are creeping up the towers.
 Someone has to go down there and find out what happened. No one alive has ever done it before. You are the volunteer.
 But the world waiting below is not what we imagined. Not even close .

 GAMEPLAY FEATURES 
 Descent into the Unknown: Explore the forgotten surface world where machines have evolved into a terrifying new society.

 Atmospheric FPS: Immersive combat and exploration in a setting that blends high-tech ruins with primitive machine-cults.

 Uncover the Truth: Why did the machines stop? Hack terminals, decipher logs, and piece together the conspiracy.

 Fractured Reality System:  Your hacked neural implant becomes a gateway. Discover a sprawling parallel dimension triggered by cryptic QR codes scrawled across the wasteland—a world that evolves from a terrifying visual glitch into a deep, navigable realm with its own society and secrets.

 Nothing is What it Seems : The surface hides a secret that changes everything about the history of humanity .

store.name: 孤狼之春
store.short: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.
store.about:
A fully linear visual novel focused on narrative presentation. Players progress by advancing dialogue and narration, experiencing a sequence of scenes with character visuals and background transitions. There are no branching choices or traditional gameplay systems — the experience is designed as a continuous, story-driven journey centered on atmosphere, pacing, and character relationships.
 On a continent where swords and sorcery intertwine, you play as a lone-wolf mercenary seeking retirement, only to be drawn back into a world of conflict. Along the way, he forms bonds with companions of wildly different personalities, gradually uncovering fragments of his lost memories.

store.name: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
store.short: A fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.
store.about:
Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a chaotic arena brawler where rival mages blast each other with powerful spells as the arena crumbles beneath their feet. Draft new abilities and items each round to create your build, then use it to outplay your opponents across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Land skill shots, evade incoming spells, knock rivals into the void, and survive the chaos.
 FAST, ACTION PACKED BRAWLS
 Blast your friends and foes in explosive multiplayer arena combat.  Battle it out in Free-for-All brawls with up to 6 players or group up for 2v2v2 and 3v3 team modes.  Find matches quickly with bots stepping in to cover any open player slots.

 ZERO CLASSES, TOTAL CHAOS
 Draft your power from 40 unique abilities and 30 build defining items. Combine spells and stats to create a build that fits your playstyle.

 THE ARENA CRUMBLES
 As each round progresses, the arena collapses into the void.  Hold your ground or be claimed by Spellfall. Outplay your opponents to survive the chaos.

 MORE MAGES, MORE MAYHEM
 Bring your friends and battle in Party Free-For-All or group up for Team Modes.  Looking for more mages to play with?  Join the Spellfall Discord Community to find other players, share builds, and get the latest updates right from the developer.

store.name: Plague Doctor: Life in Pestilence
store.short: From an unknown quack to a reputable Plague Doctor, watch the plague unfold before your eyes. Gather ingredients, brew remedies, expand your clinic, and perform surgeries alone or up to 4 player co-op. Will you uphold the Hippocratic Oath... or watch the world rot and darken with every death.
store.about:
Appointed by the royal court to a remote village, you begin your journey as an unknown doctor. Build your reputation from a suspected quack to a reputable Plague Doctor, all while witnessing the spread of the plague day by day.

 Step outside the safety of the village walls into an open world filled with natural resources. Travel to lush fields, navigate deep caves, and traverse dense forests to locate rare medicinal herbs, mushrooms, and minerals.

 Identify and refine your gathered ingredients. Experiment with mixtures to discover potent medicinal properties, creating treatments that range from simple potions and pills to complex ointments and experimental injectable serums.

 Every patient tells a story. Listen to their plight, examine their bodies for symptoms, and establish a diagnosis. Your treatments require steady hands, ranging from basic remedies to invasive surgeries and medieval practices.

 Will you uphold the Hippocratic Oath, or decide who gets to live and who doesn’t? Choose carefully. The world responds dynamically to your success and failure. With every untreated patient and every death, the environment decays: homes fall into disrepair, fires break out, the weather turns turbulent, and nature itself withers.

 Immerse yourself in a village where every NPC has a unique life, schedule, and behavior. Get to know them as you treat them, or watch them succumb to sickness, or perhaps, to your own malpractice.

 Whether you bear the burden of the plague alone or share the task in 4-player co-op, the work never ends. However, when the pressure mounts, you can...

store.name: Internet Cafe 98
store.short: Start with one trash PC and build a packed 1998 internet cafe. Serve customers, upgrade your hardware and network, and research new tech in this retro incremental tycoon.
store.about:
Add new PCs, serve more customers, and see the cafe fill up as you progress.

Compare components, preview their impact, and assemble the machine your cafe needs.

Generate research points, decode data banks, and unlock new hardware and systems.

Buy the licences, install the discs, and play ten retro games yourself.

Clean up every hard drive, dig up lost files, and boost what each desk earns.

Stock the coffee machine and keep your customers playing longer.

Knock through to the room next door and make space for more desks.

Open cafes around the world and lay cables between continents.

 Idle management on a Windows 98 desktop. Run the whole cafe from windows, a taskbar and a humming CRT.

 Build every PC part by part. Better hardware, faster internet, happier customers, more cash.

 10 playable retro games. Stock the hits of '98 for your customers, then play them yourself.

 From one beige box to a worldwide franchise. Research new tech, knock down walls, open cafes across the globe.

store.name: Fourteen Years of Flames
store.short: Fourteen Years of Flames is a story-driven FPS that replays China’s struggle in the Second Sino-Japanese War (1931–1945). Players embody 7 key characters and battle through 16 real historical events, experiencing the hardships and sacrifices over 14 years of struggle. Land weeps in 14 years of war.
store.about:
About Fourteen Years of Flames 

 Fenghuo Fourteen is a story set against the backdrop of the fourteen years of war, offering players a chance to return to the battlefields of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression from a Chinese perspective. Experience once again the smoke of war that engulfed 400 million people in those turbulent years, a time when the entire nation stood united in its struggle for survival.
 Campaigns

 Fourteen Years of Flames presents players with renowned historical battles. Your journey begins in the rugged terrain of Northeast China and leads to the ancient capital, Nanjing, as you participate in the massive national anti-invasion war that spanned across China. Experience the sorrow, sacrifice, and heroism unique to that era.
 Weapons and Equipment

 Fourteen Years of Flames strives to faithfully recreate historical details, offering a 1:1 representation of the weapons, vehicles, and soldier gear used during the war. The game includes most of the weaponry and military equipment that appeared on the battlefields, from cold and hot weapons to various vehicles and gear.
 Campaign Scenarios

 In Fourteen Years of Flames , you will experience diverse and richly detailed campaign scenarios. The game aims to reveal the truth hidden behind the fog of history, bringing to life the solemn landscapes of China during the fourteen years of anti-invasion war. Each campaign offers a unique terrain and atmosphere, immersing players in the full intensity of the conflict.
 Looking Back at History, We Wish Our Motherland Remains Unshaken for All Eternity.
...

store.name: Not In My House
store.short: A 1v4 home-invasion party game. The Thief shrinks the family and sucks them into his gun while he robs the house. The Residents set silly traps, kick him flat and call the police before he banks $5,000. Then the lights go out: flashlights against night vision.
store.about:
One Thief. Four Residents. One very bad night.
Not In My House is an online 1v4 home-invasion party game. The Thief has a shrink gun, a drone and night vision. The family has traps, their feet and a phone hidden somewhere in the house. Every round ends one of three ways: the Thief banks $5,000, the Thief sucks every Resident into his gun, or the police arrive.

 How a round goes
 Scout. For 45 seconds the Thief flies a tiny drone through the house, spots loot and fires tracking darts at Residents. Residents can kick the drone away.

 Lights out. The power dies. Residents get flashlights. The Thief gets night vision.

 Rob or run. The Thief carries loot to his box while the Residents find the phone, call the police and hold out until they arrive.
 Play the Thief

 Shrink gun. Shrink a Resident, then get close and suck them into your gun. Catch the whole family and you win.

 Steal big. Shrink the big loot too, so it fits in your pockets. Three jackpot items are worth a fortune.

 Cut the call. Find the phone and hang up on the police before it's too late.

 Tricks. Lock your loot box, see the Residents' traps, and disarm them by hand.
 Play the Residents

 Traps. Banana peels, mouse traps, Lego, a rope topple, a fart cushion and a rubber duck. Plant them where the Thief will run.

 Kick him. A good kick knocks the Thief flat for a few seconds. When he gets up, back off: he sprays shrink.

 Call the police. The phone is in a different room every round. Find it, call, and survive until they arrive.

 Shrunk? Keep going. Tiny Residents squeeze through pet flaps in the doors,...

store.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
store.short: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.
store.about:
Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
 Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.
 Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

 Satisfying Whip Action
 Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
 Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
 Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

 Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
 Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
 Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions.

 Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
 Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
 Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

 Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
 From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
 Explore maps filled with...

store.name: Point Zero: Victoria
store.short: One cold case, four deathbed flashbacks. Every shift in perspective overturns the "truth" you believed. Story-driven, with exploration, deduction, puzzles, and combat. Ready for a mind-bending thrill ride with twists at every turn?
store.about:
“There are no facts, only interpretations.” — Friedrich Nietzsche 
 You must piece together fragments of memory from the “deathbed flashbacks” of the four main characters, with every shift in perspective overturning what you thought you knew.

 You think you’re on the “ceiling level”? But maybe you’re actually on someone else’s “floor level”!

 This game centers on its story, but also features elements of exploration, deduction, criminal investigation, puzzle-solving, and combat.
 Get ready for a spine-tingling experience filled with layer upon layer of twists! 
 This is a solo indie project. Thank you so much for playing and adding it to your wishlist.

store.name: Sound System
store.short: Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.
store.about:
Grab your guitar, bass, or sticks and chase the perfect run. Sound System is a rock rhythm game where you climb the multiplier, keep the streak alive, and play a setlist from established and emerging artists. Then open the PulseMap editor, load your own music, and chart it yourself. If you can hear it, you can play it. 
 Made by musicians, for musicians.
 PLAY IT RIGHT
 Hit the notes, hold the sustains, bend them with the whammy, and watch your multiplier climb. If you grew up on Guitar Hero, your hands already know what to do. Everything you loved about the classics is here, rebuilt for today.
 Guitar, bass, and drums , playable on all the mainstream guitar and drum controllers, keyboards, and gamepads.

 Four difficulties. Easy starts you on three frets. Legendary uses all five and throws hammer-ons, pull-offs, tapping, and up/down strumming at you.

 Classic Mode: you can't fail, and the timing is forgiving. Just play.

 Pro Mode: miss 11 notes and you're out. The timing is tight, and every note is rated Bronze, Silver, or Gold.

 START A BAND
 Local play for up to three players. Any lineup works. Two bassists? Go for it.

 Co-op: play well together and the show gets bigger, with shared multipliers and stage effects.

 Competitive: each player gets their own stage and multiplier. Highest score wins.

 CHART ANYTHING
 Charting has kept the Clone Hero and YARG scenes alive for years. Bring those charts with you: Sound System imports them directly. Then use the PulseMap editor to chart a song you wrote, or a band that isn't in the library yet. Load the audio and build the...

store.name: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG
store.short: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!
store.about:
Corefall is an idle dungeon RPG. You build a team of heroes, gear them up, set up their skill trees, and send them into dungeons and raids that they fight through on their own. Most of your time goes into picking the right heroes, equipping them, and tuning their builds.

 8 Man Raids! 
 There are 7 raids at the endgame, and they take a full team of 8 heroes instead of the usual party. Each one has its own boss and its own legendary drops. They're tuned to be hard, so you'll need good gear and decent builds to clear them.

 22 Heroes, Manage Your Team! 
 You have a roster of different hero classes to choose from — tanks, healers, and damage dealers. You pick who goes on each run, how they're geared, and how their skill trees are set up. You can swap heroes between runs and check the combat meter to see who's doing the most work.

 Loot That Matters! 
 Loot drops while your team fights, ranging from common gear up to legendaries. It goes into a shared stash, and you equip it onto whichever hero needs it. Weapons are locked to their class, but armor, capes, rings, and amulets can go on any hero. There's also a Collection Log that tracks the signature drops from each dungeon and raid.

 Dungeons and Boss Fights! 
 There are 25 dungeons, each with 3 floors and a boss at the end that drops its signature loot. They range from the Mushroom Den early on to the Geode Sanctum and the Spire Dungeons near the end. You can raise the difficulty as your team gets stronger, and there's an Endless mode that keeps going until your team can't handle it anymore.

 Skill Tree! 
 Each hero has...

store.name: No Blink Allowed
store.short: Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game. Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.
store.about:
No Blink Allowed is a short Incremental game in which you help the old computer of your spaceship recover its corrupted memory. You will have to stop it at the right moment , before it loses its mind, and all its memory shards with it.
 Expect 1.5 to 2.5 hours of thrilling gameplay!

 Features : 
 Bonuses & Hazards like rewinding time, shrinking circle, slow motion, hidden end digits, disturbing artifacts, and more

 Lots of upgrades to help you out. 

 Come and try crazy combinations in this short but challenging game!

store.name: Guinea Pig Runaway Together
store.short: Up to four guinea pigs. One balloon. Endless chaos. Work together or get nowhere in this physics-based co-op parkour challenge!
store.about:
Up to 4 guinea pigs. One balloon. Endless chaos. Work together in this physics-based cooperative parkour challenge, or get nowhere at all! 
 Guinea Pig Runaway is a physics-based parkour game where you steer a balloon full of adorable guinea pigs. Play solo, share the same balloon with your friends, or go head to head against rival balloons in the race modes. When you push together, nothing can stop you. Otherwise... let’s just say the balloon isn’t going anywhere.

 ADDITIVE MOVEMENT 
 Your movements combine! If everyone pushes right, the balloon rolls fast. Pull in different directions and you stay right where you are. Master synchronized movement to conquer increasingly difficult courses.

 TRUE COOPERATION 
 This isn’t just “being in the same game.” Every move demands perfect coordination. Argue, laugh and win together as you make your way through the world. Remember: once your teamwork starts to fall apart, your chance at freedom slips away faster than a startled guinea pig!

 FOUR GAME MODES 
 Classic: The classic runaway adventure with checkpoints. Fall, and you pick up from the last checkpoint.

 Hardcore: No checkpoints, no second chances. One mistake sends you back to the very start. Prove your best time on its own leaderboard.

 Race: Two teams, two balloons, one finish line. Stay in sync with your teammate and bump the rival balloon off course.

 Race FFA: Everyone in their own balloon, everyone for themselves. First to finish wins, and everyone else is ranked by placement.

 TWO HANDCRAFTED MAPS 
 Alongside the first map, which stretches from flooded city...

store.name: FirstPlate
store.short: Run a restaurant under constant pressure. Build and expand your kitchen infinitely to host dozens of tables. Curate your menu and adapt your layout as you grow. Play solo, team up in co-op, or battle for customers in the upcoming competitive Versus mode.
store.about:
Design, build, and manage your own restaurant in a simulation where your layout choices are just as important as your cooking skills.
 Start with a small kitchen and a few basic appliances. Your goal is to grow into a massive establishment capable of serving dozens of tables simultaneously without collapsing under the weight of your own ambition.
 BUILD & CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING 
 There are no preset kitchens here. You have total control over your restaurant's footprint and design.
 Infinite Expansion: Buy grids and expand your floor plan without limits. Whether you want a compact corner bistro or a sprawling banquet hall, the choice is yours.

 Total Control: Design every wall, floor tile, and counter exactly how you want it. Design an efficient assembly line to minimize walking distance, or build a chaotic maze...if you can build it, you can run it.

 CURATE YOUR MENU 
 You decide what goes on the pass.
 Menu Selection: You pick the "Menu Stack." Run a classic burger joint one day, switch to a high-end steakhouse the next, or pivot to pizzas, breakfast, and more!

 Adapt Your Kitchen: Different menus require different tools. You’ll need to buy and arrange the right equipment to handle the specific prep and cooking requirements of your chosen dishes.

 HANDS-ON SERVICE 
 Once the doors open, it’s all about execution.
 High-Volume Management: As you expand to host more tables, the flow of orders becomes a torrent. You’ll need to coordinate cooking, plating, serving, and cleaning in real-time.

 Time-Based Cooking: Chop ingredients, and assemble plates. Mistakes happen, and...

store.name: Backflip Madness
store.short: Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!
store.about:
Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!
 Features:
 Multiple backflips and locations

 Parkour / Free running acrobatics

 Realistic ragdoll physics and simulation

 Achievements and leaderboards 

 Action replay

 Normal and ninja outfits

 Simple and addictive backflip platformer game. Jump from the roof or platform, flip from the cliff, train backflips and become real flip master! Take a break, kill the time, make some backflips or epic fails!

store.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
store.short: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.
store.about:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer. 

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

The visuals throughout the game have been remastered from the ground up to enhance the cinematic experience of the original. Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered also features gameplay updates, as well as an improved unlock system, so you can unlock monsters, locations, and gallery items in any order you choose. FEATURES 
 The original 2002 Godzilla arena fighter, remastered. 

 12 Kaiju to choose from, each with a uniquely vicious moveset.

 8 locations, including recreated real-world cities, Monster Island, and the Alien Mothership.

 Gallery items to unlock. 

 Play with friends in local co-op and...

store.name: Scars of Honor
store.short: Scars of Honor is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where player choice, skill-based combat, and meaningful progression shape your legend.
store.about:
Set on the war-torn continent of Aragon, two alliances - the disciplined Sacred Order and the relentless Domination - battle for survival as an ancient Ice Dragon stirs in the frozen North.
 Choose your faction, race, and class, then build your hero through a modern MMO combat system, evolving talents, personal Scars, meaningful crafting, and endlessly replayable Evershifting Dungeons.
 KEY FEATURES:

 Fast, modern MMO combat that rewards positioning, timing, and decision-making. Master active abilities, react to enemy patterns, and outplay your opponents rather than relying on rotations alone.

 Shape your character with over 240 talents per class and permanent Scars that fundamentally alter your abilities and playstyle. Every choice matters, creating builds that feel personal, powerful, and distinct.

 No two dungeon runs are the same. Dynamic layouts, shifting encounters, and changing modifiers ensure each run offers new challenges, strategies, and rewards.

 Choose from unique races and unconventional classes, each grounded in the world’s lore and identity. Visual design, abilities, and narrative themes reinforce meaningful faction and character choice.
