 Test your skill in Arenas and 5v5 Battlegrounds with equalized gear. Victory is determined by teamwork, strategy, and mastery.

 Craft, upgrade, and customize gear to complement your build and preferred playstyle. Progression supports experimentation, letting you refine your character as you grow stronger.

 A fair monetization model focused on cosmetics and convenience only. Power is earned through gameplay, not...

store.name: Reshine
store.short: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.
store.about:
Take apart, clean and bring new life to long forgotten objects in Reshine - a cozy restoration game that will take you on a journey through history, all within the safe space of your own attic.
 Reshine is a chill, relaxing experience. Simple and intuitive controls, minimalistic UI, straightforward gameplay. There are no complicated systems, no management, no stress.

 Listen to the rainfall, as you slowly work in a quiet attic, where the time seems to have stopped. Surrounded by relics of the past, take apart each object piece by piece. There’s no rush, you can follow your own rhythm, discovering how everything fits together as you go. With nothing to get wrong, you’re free to simply unwind and enjoy the process.

 The parts need to be restored to their former glory. Clean away the dust, sand down rough edges, and gently remove the rust using a variety of tools. Pick colors that feel right for you and repaint the surface until it looks good as new. Go in any order you want and just sit back, relax and watch the object come back to life.

 When every part looks like new, you can slowly bring everything back together. Piece by piece, watch the object take shape again. Before you know it, it’s looking like its old self again, or maybe even better.

 And that's it! Compare your final result with the object before restoration to see how much it has changed. You can repeat the restoration as many times as you want, to try different colors or just relive the experience. But, most importantly, more old treasures await you!

store.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
store.short: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.
store.about:
An action RPG for the ages re-emerges better than ever, combining Muramasa Rebirth and the add-on Genroku Legends for the first time. Step into a stunning 4K world steeped in Japanese myth and culture, and take up your blade for refined 2D action and an elevated Muramasa experience filled with new features, including all-new localization and English voiceover.
 New and returning players alike are sure to find a fresh, exhilarating experience awaiting them.

 Deep in the Genroku period of Japan's past, six protagonists fight through a land teeming with wickedness in the hopes of seizing control of their fates once and for all.
 From one who is possessed by the cursed sword Muramasa, to another who swears to avenge their master, and one who pursues love with unwavering passion, each unique story stands on its own. Discover these six distinct tales in any order you choose as they unfold across a beautiful world steeped in the supernatural.

 Cut down the malevolent spirits and dastardly villains that block your path. Chain normal attacks together to naturally unleash combos, then mix in dashes and jumps for even more exhilarating combat as you move fluidly across the ground and the air. Parry and even deflect attacks in the thick of battle. 
 Muramasa’s controls are easy to grasp, yet offer plenty of depth, giving everyone an opportunity to perform spectacular sword-fighting moves.

 Unleash powerful single strikes, wide-area attacks, and ranged attacks, all with a single button press. Combine them with normal attacks to overwhelm your enemies with relentless combos.

 Forge...

store.name: No Mercy
store.short: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.
store.about:
A brutal Bodycam-style first-person shooter about a man forced to return to the violence he swore to leave behind. 
 A powerful criminal faction launches a full-scale coup. Within hours, the city descends into chaos. Police vanish. Communications go dark. Entire districts fall under the control of heavily armed gangs.
 And on the very day the city falls, they take his wife.
 Years ago, he swore never to carry a weapon again. No more bloodshed. No more war.
 But some promises only last until someone takes away the person you love most.
 Now, armed once again, he must fight through gang-controlled streets and fortified strongholds to find his wife and uncover who took her.
 This is not a war for the city.
 This is his war for her. 
 BRUTAL BODYCAM FIREFIGHTS 
 Feel every shot, every impact, and every second of chaos through a raw, immersive bodycam perspective.

 CHOOSE YOUR APPROACH 
 Not every situation should be approached with a direct assault.
 Move quietly, observe enemy movements, use the environment, and choose the right moment to strike. Slip past enemies unnoticed, eliminate them one by one, or engage them in open combat.
 Every district hides another clue. Every answer brings him closer to his wife—and deeper into the conspiracy behind the city’s collapse.

 A CITY BREAKING AROUND YOU 
 Fight through abandoned streets, residential buildings, dark interiors, and fortified gang hideouts.
 Bullets tear through glass, sending shards across the room as seemingly quiet spaces turn into deadly battlefields within seconds. Every shot carries weight, and every firefight...

store.name: Late Night Duty
store.short: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.
store.about:
" I took a job as a night security guard at a local school. Great, just me, an empty building, and silence until the sun comes up. I hope that a simple job, the quiet hallways, and the night air will finally bring me some peace of mind" 

 Late Night Duty is a short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia about a discharged veteran haunted by combat PTSD, on his first night shift as a school security guard. 

 To begin your employment as a night security guard, please report to the security post. You'll find your flashlight, the patrol scanner, and the patrol logbook on the desk. For your first shift, ensure you check in at all designated patrol points around the school. 

 The deeper into the shift you go, the harder it gets to tell what is a hallucination, and what is actually waiting for you in the dark.
 Main Features:
 First-person adventure walking simulator with optional combat section and unforgettable gripping linear story.

 Patrol aesthetics of school somewhere in Malaysia, unique setting built exclusively for the narrative.

 Retro PSX visuals stylized like mid-2000s games, with low-resolution textures and dithering.

 ~80 minutes of playtime, designed to be completed in one sitting, with manual saves during combat sections.

store.name: We Are So Cooked
store.short: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.
store.about:
IT WAS AN ACCIDENT. PROBABLY. 
 DEAD WEIGHT 

 A dead body is heavy, floppy, and incredibly awkward.
 Solo Struggle: Dragging the body alone is slow and leaves a bloody trail.

 Team Lift: Grab a limb each to move faster, but coordinate carefully—if you pull left and your friend pulls right, you’re going to drop him down the stairs.

 Physics Chaos: The body snags on doorframes, knocks over vases, and slides off laundry carts. Every step is a potential disaster.

 THREATS 

 The world is watching.
 Civilians: If a guest sees the body, they scream. Screams attract Guards.

 Security: They hunt noise. If they catch you with the body, it’s over.

 Eyes & Noses: Security Cameras watch the hallways, while Guard Dogs can sniff out the body even if it's hidden inside a locker.

 IMPROVISE YOUR ESCAPE 

 You have no weapons. You have no plan. You only have what you can find.
 Scavenge: Turn the environment into your toolkit. Find a Wheelchair to roll the body past reception. Use a Mop to clean up blood trails. Throw a Squeaky Toy to distract a guard.

 One Hand Only: You can hold an item, OR you can drag the body. You can’t do both. You’ll have to scream at your friends to open doors for you.

 UNIQUE SCENARIOS 

 You aren't just hiding in one building. Every environment forces your team to adapt to new physics hazards and AI threats.
 Crowded Public Spaces: Sneak through luxury hotel lobbies and balance the dead weight on top-heavy luggage carts. Just panic quietly when a nosy maid accidentally rolls away the laundry bin you used as a hiding spot.

 High-Security Compounds:...

store.name: ANU: Tablets of Thoth
store.short: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.
store.about:
ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure focused on fast movement, open exploration, and supernatural abilities. Players take control of Anu , a reincarnated jackal god, on a mission to defeat the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture  and his undead underlings.
 Accidentally resurrected from the dead, ANU , a reincarnation of the jackal god Anubis, must defeat the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture and his undead underlings and send the undead back to the underworld.
 Explore expansive 3D environments filled with traps, enemies, collectibles, and hidden secrets. Each level rewards curiosity, player skill, and mastery of Anu’s abilities.
 Core Gameplay
 Platforming & Exploration 
Sprint, scale, swim, sail, and search open levels packed with secrets, treasures, and challenges.

 Soul Syphon 
Anu’s primary supernatural ability siphons soul energy to defeat undead enemies in real time, returning them to the underworld.

 Traps & Enemies 
Overcome environmental hazards and defeat Voodoo Vulture’s underlings using movement, timing, and positioning.

 Multiple Traversal Styles 
Travel across land, through waterways, and along the Nile River to reach new areas and uncover hidden rewards.

 Progression & Objectives
 Journey through an alternate timeline of Ancient Egypt, collect mystical artifacts, defeat key enemies, retrieve all 8 lost fragments of Thoth’s Emerald Tablet , and prepare for a final confrontation with Voodoo Vulture.
 Story & Setting
 Set in an anachronistic Ancient Egypt, Anu must restore balance by returning the undead to the underworld while uncovering and...

store.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
store.short: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.
store.about:
PRE-PURCHASE CONTENT 
 Pre-purchase STRANGER THAN HEAVEN to get the “Dosu: Kagekiri” weapon to use in-game*.

 FACE DOWN FATE 
 A fifty-year saga of those with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. San Francisco, 1915. Our story begins as a young boy sneaks aboard a mysterious ship in the dead of night. 

 His name? Makoto Daito. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto's world is one of harsh persecution, a fate cruely cast upon him simply because of his Asian heritage.

 After losing both of his parents and finding himself completely alone, Makoto, in an act of desperation, decides to risk it all and travel to his mother's birthplace. If the United States won't accept him for who he is, maybe Japan will...

 With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life. What awaits our young stowaway in Japan? And where will the years take him next?

 5 ERAS, 5 CITIES 
 The story unfolds across a version of Japan that may have existed in another life altogether, immersing you in 5 sprawling cities, each modeled after real locations of their respective eras.

 1915, Kokura, Fukuoka: home of what was said to be one of the world’s largest foundries, a smoke-scorched town bursting with the passion of hard-driven, equally fiery workers.
 1929, Kure, Hiroshima: a port town dominated by Japan’s largest naval arsenal and heavily influenced by the presence of yakuza organizations.
 1943, Minami, Osaka:...

store.name: ROB RUN
store.short: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.
store.about:
ONLY REAL PLAYERS
 Every cop and every criminal is a living breathing human with their own agenda. And with 15,000 players around you, any situation can quickly get out of control. The cops are everywhere, and they pose a real threat. So, if an open fight is too dangerous, you can always find another way to get what you want.

 CLANS AND POWER
 You can survive on your own, but you can only thrive by working together. Create your own crime family or join an existing clan. Assign roles, organize raids, take control of territories, wage gang wars, and negotiate truces. In a place where anyone can betray you, reliable allies are your most valuable asset.

 NO ROOM FOR ERROR
 You risk losing absolutely everything every minute. Someone can easily take what's yours, but the same is true the other way around. To survive, you have to be able to plan, make quick decisions, and pull the trigger at the right moment.

 BRUTAL CRIMINAL UNDERWORLD
 Bank robberies, raids on rivals' hideouts, police chases, and bloody shootouts. Every day is a struggle for resources and influence. The only things that can get you anywhere are strength and cunning.

 YOUR HOME IS YOUR CASTLE
 Create your own hideout. Build and upgrade your base, store loot and vehicles, and place workbenches and safes. But remember: the more lavish your refuge, the more intruders you're going to have.

 TILL THE SERVER WIPES US OUT
 In just one week, you can go from being a regular thug to the boss of the server's largest organization. And then start over — with new experience, allies, and a more ambitious plan to seize...

store.name: Orion Blue
store.short: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing life game set on a beautiful ocean planet. Catch fish, turn your catch into furniture and tools, and make friends with the locals. Fish by hand, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode. Build a life of your own on this peaceful planet.
store.about:
Orion Blue is a relaxing fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Play actively, or enjoy fishing at your own pace with idle progression. Discover a peaceful world and build your own life on Orion Blue.

 Explore the beautiful planet Orion Blue 
 Discover diverse fish species and mysterious lifeforms. Catch fish to earn money, or process them into valuable resources.

 Enjoy fishing across diverse regions 
 Each area offers its own unique atmosphere and discoveries. Fish at your own pace in stunning environments and work toward completing your collection.

 Craft and decorate 
 Break down your fish into materials and craft furniture and tools. Place your furniture, put up wallpaper, and decorate your own boat and home however you like.

 Meet the residents of the planet 
 Orion Blue is home to many residents. Many of them are around your age. Talk with them and slowly build meaningful relationships.

 From friendship to romance 
 Each resident has their own daily life, events, and personal stories. As you grow closer, they may open up to you—and some relationships may even turn into romance.

 Play whenever you like 
 Idle Mode keeps the fishing going even while you're away.
 And in windowed mode you can resize the window freely, so you can keep Orion Blue in a corner of your screen while you do other things.

store.name: STEP THEATER
store.short: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!
store.about:
WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :)

 An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life. 

 STEP THEATER is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

 With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, STEP THEATER gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

 Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.
 Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

 With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

 ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
 Features 
 A game system where the story comes together as you play on the music

 A wide variety of stages, each with its own theme, presentation, and actions

 Cute character animation paired with a warm art style

 Colorful pop tracks 

 Collaborating Creators 
 Graphics: Subikaka, Aramon
 Sound: Chroma, Mafumafu

 Estimated Demo Playtime 
 20 minutes

 【Guidelines for Gameplay Streaming and Uploading Video Content】
 We welcome livestreams and gameplay uploads from individuals and corporate entities. However, please be sure to review and comply with the following guidelines:
 Please include the game link in easy-to-access locations for viewers, like the description box.

 Monetization through features offered by video streaming platforms, including ad...

store.name: Desktop Island: Idle Together!
store.short: Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.
store.about:
Desktop Island is a co-op life sim meant to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle . Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore the island. 

 Choose your profession and master it 
 It takes a lot to build a village! Choose between 10 different professions to master , from woodcutting and fishing to animal care and farming.  

 Complete quests & expand your village 
 Upgrade your town hall, unlock new buildings and customize your village .

 Meet the other inhabitants 
 You're not alone on the island, meet a varied cast of other inhabitants , trade with them, and build up relationships.

 Build a social hub for your friends 
 Designed as a collaborative experience, hang out with your friends, work towards shared objectives and support each other to make your dream community.

 Play how you want 
 Play the game fullscreen, at the bottom of your screen, or as a floating window. Desktop Island can be played both as an active game, or you can sit back and let it go on whilst you're doing other work on your computer.
 Features 
 Choose between an active farming sim, or idle incremental playstyle

 Play solo or with others (no hosting servers required)

 4 different styles to play (fullscreen, bottom of the screen, floating window, notification only)

 Cozy Animal Crossing inspired soundtrack

store.name: Last State
store.short: Every decision has a cost. Scavenge, hunt, craft, and build a life in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic wilderness. Last State is a hardcore survival simulation where hunger, cold, injuries and one bad decision can end your story for good.
store.about:
THE WORLD ENDED. YOUR STRUGGLE DIDN'T.
 The fire is dying. Your supplies are running low. A storm is approaching and somewhere beyond the trees, abandoned ruins might hold everything you need.

 But reaching them could cost you everything.

 Last State is a hardcore post-apocalyptic survival simulation where every decision matters and every mistake can be your last. 

 Explore a procedurally generated wilderness, scavenge what remains of civilization, hunt for food, craft tools and build a place to call home.

 Surviving today is only half the battle. Preparing for tomorrow is what keeps you alive. 

 SURVIVAL IS NEVER JUST ONE PROBLEM
 Cold makes every journey dangerous. Hunger forces you to take risks. Exhaustion turns simple tasks into difficult decisions. An untreated injury can ruin days of careful preparation.
 And just when you think you have everything under control, something changes.

 There are no perfect decisions. Only consequences you have to live with. 

 Will you risk the wilderness for valuable supplies? Spend your last resources improving your shelter? Or retreat, recover and hope tomorrow offers a better chance?

 FROM DESPERATE SURVIVOR TO SELF-SUFFICIENCY

 You begin with almost nothing.

 Every meal you secure, every tool you craft and every shelter you build is a step toward something greater.
 Learn to live off the land. Develop your skills. Establish a permanent base, grow your own food and prepare for the changing seasons.

 Your goal isn't just to survive another night, but to build a life in a world that no longer cares whether you exist. 

 A...

store.name: Hired Blade
store.short: Hired Blade is a tactical turn based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Become a warchief of your own mercenary band, recruit hired blades, take on contracts, fight bandits and monsters. Unwind in taverns to boost your squad's morale! Embrace the hard life of a true gritty sellsword!
store.about:
Hired Blade is a tactical turn based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Become a warchief of your own mercenary band, recruit hired blades, take on contracts, fight bandits and monsters. Embrace the hard life of a true gritty sellsword!

 Explore a harsh open world where bandits and rogues roam and pillage the battle-torn land, town guards are itching for a reason to kick you out, weary peasants avoid you like the plague, and enemy soldiers and rival warbands patrol the roads. Escort caravans and travel from town to town in search of coin and new contracts. 

 Clash in brutal battles on procedurally generated, hex-based maps, where each victory is earned through the lives and scars of your exhausted mercenaries, the steel of their rusted weapons, and the last strength of the battered armor they wear.

 Strip the fallen of their gear, manage equipment , and train your fighters for the next encounter. Hone their skills and choose new perks for every hired blade in your company.

 When the fighting is done and the relative safety of a town is within reach, you and your men can finally enjoy some well-earned rest. Mercenaries crave hot food, dice games, fistfights, and other pleasures. Play mini-games to restore morale before embarking on your next journey.

store.name: XenoFeels
store.short: You are a lone space customs officer. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!
store.about:
A space customs simulator. You need to compare photographs and documents of aliens with their appearance and vehicles in order to find differences and identify the imposter.
 Spot the differences! 
 There's ALWAYS something that gives a terrorist away: an error in the documents, a poor disguise, fake license plates, or prohibited objects hidden in the car. Use these clues to expose the impostors! 

 Use the gun! 
 You have the right to use your service shotgun and no responsibilities! What could be better? Shoot at anything that seems suspicious. Don't worry about innocent victims; they can easily be written off as "collateral damage"...

 Try not to lose your mind! 
 The job of a space customs officer is hard and exhausting, so don't be surprised if... strange things start happening to you by the end of the day. Remember, it’s okay to hear voices in your head — just don't talk to them!

store.name: VacBot Simulator
store.short: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.
store.about:
Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

 VacBot Simulator lets you take control of a robotic vacuum that has one task: clean the floor. This task is not always pleasant, that's why humans don't like doing it. Suck up interactive dust, mop the tougher stains and pick up clutter to prove that you are worth the investment. 

 You are not a basic vacuum, though. You have achieved a higher level of consciousness and have your own opinions on life and your purpose.

 MULTIPLE MODELS AND ENVIRONMENTS
 Explore different floorplans, try out different vacuum models and experience their unique personalities. Each vacuum has different set of features best suited for tackling messes and obstacles of their home. 

 REALISTIC SIMULATION
 Dust is annoying in real life, and it's no different here. Particles of dust behave independently of each other, you are moving them around as you pass through the household. Larger pieces of dust require stronger suction, more stubborn stains need to be mopped. Manage the suction strength and water output for best results, but watch out for your battery and water tank levels.

 PLAY AS YOU WANT
 Humans are not supervising you, they only care about the final result. Don't stress and take your time, if you want to see how effective you can be, though, there are leaderboards where you can compare your results to others on...

store.name: Burg Tag
store.short: A fast-paced online multiplayer game of tag built around ridiculously satisfying movement. Wall kick, swing, slide and roll through colourful maps, and do whatever it takes to escape your friends... or tag them. No friends? Run a time trial!
store.about:
Burg Tag is a competitive tag game built around the chase. 

 MASTER THE MOVEMENT 
 Both roles have access to the same movement set to make chases more exciting with certain powerups unlocking new ways to get around! Wall Kicks, Monkey Bars, Sliding, Sprinting are all essential moves to evade your opponents.

 HIDERS! KEEP MOVING... Or Hide! 
 Every round is a choice: trust your hiding spot with your life, or stay on the move. Slide, wall kick, swing and roll your way out of trouble when a Seeker gets too close.

 SEEKERS! Play Smart! 
 Being “It” shouldn’t be boring. In "Tag", once a hider is caught they join you, doubling the chance of catching someone. Work together to corner, or cut off a hider in a chase. 

 TIME TRIALS 
 Jump into any map solo and try to collect 10 bananas as fast as possible. Originally an afterthought, Time Trials have become one of the most addicting modes in Burg Tag.

store.name: Empire Water Works
store.short: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.
store.about:
THE STEAM ENGINE IS YOURS TO CONTROL! 

 You control the speed (RPM) of the engine, fine-tune the valve gear duration and ensure that lubrication is up to snuff! Running low on bearing oil can cause power loss and bearing damage; running out of steam cylinder oil can damage the cylinder walls, resulting in massive steam leaks and power loss.
 PUMP WATER RELENTLESSLY! 

 Your steam engine exists to pump as much water as possible to the town's three reservoirs: Residential , Municipal and Industrial , with the help of your two massive water pumps downstairs. 
 Check the reservoir pressures and pump water to maintain their water pressure within the prescribed pressure thresholds.
 But be careful! Trying to push too much water flow through the system can cause your water pumps to moan, groan, hammer and experience bolt failures...such failures will need attention ASAP, otherwise critical events such as flooding can occur.
 PERFORM 'COLD AND DARK' STARTS 

 At the beginning of each shift, you'll need to raise boiler pressure and warm-up the massive steam engine's cylinders and clear them of condensate before you can turn it over! You'll also have the opportunity to keep the engine warm overnight by following certain procedures before locking-up the night before...saving you time the next morning!
 KEEP EVERYTHING OILED 

 The main bearings, valve gear linkages, and cylinders all require oil. Do your rounds and don't forget to check the levels frequently!
 LOOK AFTER YOUR BOILER 

 The boiler is the heart of your pumping station...it supplies precious steam pressure to your...

store.name: Ashen Swarm
store.short: A gothic bullet heaven roguelite where you wield the power of deadly sins. The Judge knew not all were guilty, yet condemned the world. Burn hordes with Wrath, turn foes into swine with Pride and devour the fallen with Gluttony. Survive the swarm and face the boss of each arena.
store.about:
CASE: THE WORLD.
 VERDICT: GUILTY.

 The Judge knew not everyone was guilty.

 He condemned the whole world anyway.

 Now Corruption carries out the sentence: devouring the last lands and leaving the Void behind. You have already died trying to stop it. The Architect rebuilt you from ash—now you fight to save what remains of the world.

 Ashen Swarm is a gothic bullet heaven roguelite where deadly sins become weapons and the court gathers above you in the Halls of Judgment. 
 TURN SIN INTO A WEAPON

 Combine skills as you level up, shape your build, and unlock the devastating ability at the end of each branch.

 Pride drowns the swarm in filth, turns the rabble into squealing swine, and blows the herd apart. Wrath spreads fire through the crowd and burns the condemned to ash. Gluttony turns the fallen into food until the arena becomes a feast.
 KEEP YOUR OATH. OR EMBRACE CORRUPTION.

 Keep your Oath to develop the Fidelity branch, or enter without it to pursue Corruption. Your choice determines which skills you can build around your hero’s ability. Accept a Tempter bargain with a Corruption cost and your Oath breaks: your acquired Fidelity upgrades turn into Corruption skills. You gain new power, but face more dangerous enemies.

 YOUR CHOICES HAVE CONSEQUENCES

 A priest asks for alms. Help him, walk away—or choose something cruel.

 Your choice can earn a Sin Artifact or a Virtue Seal that shapes later runs.

 TAKE YOUR CHOICES INTO THE NEXT RUN

 Your decisions earn Sin Artifacts or Virtue Seals that stay with you even after death. Activate them in the Pyramid, then...

store.name: Very Safe Dino Park 🦖
store.short: A chaotic 1 to 4 player dinosaur park sim where feeding the dinos, cleaning the mess, and surviving the chaos are all part of the job.
store.about:
Welcome to the Very Safe Dino Park.

 Build, manage, and barely survive your own prehistoric theme park in this chaotic 1 to 4 player co-op simulator. Feed dinosaurs, clean up “incidents,” keep the guests under control, and hold everything together with duct tape and poor decisions.
 Nothing can go wrong but life finds a way.

 Open the gates. Sell the tickets. Pretend everything is fine.
 Behind the scenes?
 Dinosaurs are getting hungry

 Guests are getting annoying

 Systems are definitely failing

 Keep the park running, or watch it spiral into a very expensive mistake.

 Your dinosaurs are incredible, majestic and constantly seconds away from ruining your life.
 Step into enclosures to feed and manage them

 Clean up mountains of poop

 Keep them calm before they break out

 Tranquilise anything with too many teeth and a bad attitude

 If they get hungry, they will hunt. You are not special.

 Guests are the reason you’re here and everything is under control!
 Sell tickets and overpriced merch

 Keep vending machines stocked

 Clean up litter, spills, and suspicious limbs

 Deal with troublemakers however you see fit

 You can escort them out politely. Or speed up the food chain.

 And it will break. Constantly.
 Scrub bloodstains and mystery puddles

 Keep the park clean

 Turn dino poop into biofuel

 Keep the power on at all costs

 Because when the power goes out… the fences do too.

 Start small. Mess up fast. Expand anyway.
 Unlock new dinosaurs

 Build enclosures

 Add facilities and decorations

 Automate repetitive tasks

 Turn your park into a world-class...

store.name: CRACK
store.short: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.
store.about:
CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends work together to uncover what's inside a mysterious giant egg. 

 There is an egg.
 It is very big.
 Your job is simple: crack it open. Don’t ask why.

 Who built this laboratory?
 Why are you here?
 Unlock hidden rooms and upgrade your tools throughout the facility.

 The Egg reacts to you.
 Listen closely.
 Find out what's inside. Whatever happens after that is above your pay grade.
 I’m building CRACK in public from Day 1! Follow the development on social media, and tell me what to develop next.

store.name: Jibbers
store.short: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.
store.about:
What is it?
 A physics-driven ski game focused on control and realism:
 Fully physics-based character and ski simulation

 Free, analog-style controls that are hard but intuitive

 Tricks are earned through motion and timing, not button combos

 Realistic body dynamics for setting tricks

 Full collision with terrain and objects

 Flexible, physically simulated skis

 Current State
 The project is in active development. Patreon-supported playtesting and early access are planned.
 Planned Features
 Deep Customization: clothing, skis, poles, custom grabs & stances

 Extensive physics and feel tuning options

 Community-made custom maps

 Multiplayer

 Snowboards & Monoski

store.name: Toe-tal War
store.short: TOE-TAL WAR is an action-puzzle platformer where you kill people with your foot smell. Run and jump to make your feet smelly, change your shoes and socks to control the smell — then get close to enemies and stink them to death. Some levels may require a little practice and hard thinking.
store.about:
You were fired by your boss because your feet are too smelly. 
 You ended up on the streets, lost and helpless. 
 In a daze, you discover that you are the reincarnation of the Toe-tal God . 
 Your divine mission is to reach the Toe-tal Paradise and reclaim your throne. 
 Should anyone dare to stand in your way... annihilate them with your foot smell. 
 Combat and Puzzles Centered on Foot Smell
 Run and jump to get your feet smelly, and get close to enemies to deal damage. The smellier your feet, the higher the damage.

 Put on and take off footwears to adjust the power and range of the smell, adapting to different situations.

 You can also kick away your removed footwears, placing them in specific spots — this can be surprisingly useful at times.

 Defeat enemies to earn coins and buy more shoes and socks. As the Toe-tal God, these are your sacred relics — you don’t care about those minor stat differences.

 Game Content
 3 levels, estimated completion time: 45 minutes

store.name: Mars Colony Simulator
store.short: Stranded alone on Mars. Mine iron and ice with a tactile beam, rebuild a broken colony, and survive the freezing night on stored sunlight and rationed oxygen — while a sandworm's dust plume crawls the horizon. An austere low-poly survival builder about earning your way home.
store.about:
Something went wrong on Mars long before you opened your eyes. The colony is wreckage, the air in your suit is all the air you own, and the one ship that could carry you home is a silhouette on the horizon. Mine, repair, and build it all back: one breath, one ingot, one long cold night at a time.
 MINE THE REGOLITH

 Carve iron, silica and ice out of the planet with a hand beam that feels like a power tool. Nodes crack apart stage by stage in sparks and rust-red dust, and every chunk arcs to your glove on a magnet pull with a pickup plink that climbs in pitch as you chain them. When your stockpile outgrows your arms, plant an Auto-Drill and let the colony mine while you walk.
 BUILD THE COLONY BACK

 Weld the solar array and oxygenator back to life, then go beyond repair: drop ghost previews — teal for good ground, red for bad — and thunk down greenhouses, battery banks, water extractors and drill rigs. Water doubles your potato harvest, batteries bank the daylight, and piece by piece a dead outpost becomes a working colony. Everything you place is another system that has to survive the dark.
 SURVIVE THE MARTIAN NIGHT

 A sol lasts 32 real minutes, and the sun is your only generator. At dusk the lamps snap on, the battery bar starts falling, and the oxygenator begins burning your ice reserve to keep you breathing until dawn. Watch the charge, ration the sorties, and when the power browns out before sunrise, run for the habitat and let its emergency reserve carry you through. Night one is meant to scare you. Night two is yours to win.
 MEET THE LOCALS

 Mars is not as dead...

store.name: Cat Parents
store.short: FROM STRAY TO HOME: cat rescue simulator. The streets are full of dangers for these sweet, defenseless creatures. Save cats, give them love, care, and a place to call home. Become a true cat parent alone or with your friend. Discover what true happiness feels like.
store.about:
Your heart is full of love. The city is full of cats who need it.
 Save abandoned, homeless, and helpless cats. Give them care, earn their trust, and help them find a forever home - or keep them with you and build a safe sanctuary where they can live happily. Play alone or together with your own team of cat parents.

 SAVE CATS 
 Locate cats in distress on the open city map. Ride your bike on a rescue mission. Use the right tools and gadgets. Save poor, sweet little animals.
 Every rescue is unique. Every life matters.

 TAKE CARE OF THEM 
 Bring rescued cats home and give them gentle care: 
 • wash dirty and scared cats 
 • treat illnesses 
 • feed them 
 • help them feel safe again

 BUILD YOUR CAT PARADISE 
 Turn your home into a true cat sanctuary.
 • build climbing structures, tunnels, beds, and houses
 • decorate and expand your space
 • create a cozy, living ecosystem for your cats
 Your home grows together with your family. Live in a cat paradise.

 MAKE OTHER FAMILIES HAPPY 
 Not every cat stays forever.
 Carefully choose adoptive families for your rescued pets and send them to loving homes - make others happy too.

 TEAM OF CAT PARENTS 
 Are your friends kind, caring, and ready to help?

 Invite them to your world and play together:
 • rescue cats as a team
 • share responsibilities and resources
 • build and manage your sanctuary together

 Because saving lives is even better when you’re not alone.

store.name: Totally Safe Moon Project
store.short: BREAKING NEWS! A giant asteroid is about to wipe out Earth, and your only escape is the Moon! Grab anything you can find, stack it high, and build your way to safety, solo or with up to 3 friends! Think Only Up, but YOU'RE the architect. What could possibly go wrong?
store.about:
No AI was used in the development of this game!!! 
 A giant asteroid is about to destroy the Earth! 
 Play solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends! Build a tower all the way to the Moon, deliver a powerful laser, and save humanity before it's too late!

 Build a Tower
 Your goal is the Moon! 
 To get there - use anything you can find to build the tallest tower, from fences and boxes to houses and clouds.
A Gravity Gun will come in handy...

 Upgrade & Go Higher
 As you climb higher, you earn rewards like new abilities, items, or points used to upgrade your gear.
 The higher you go, the crazier skills you get.

 Bring the Laser
 Once the tower is ready - work together to bring the laser you built in your garage to the top and explode that rock!' 

 Totally Safe Moon Project is all about shared moments, creativity, and joyful chaos. There is no competition and no pressure, just teamwork and the simple question of how far you can get together.
 Features: 
 Build a totally safe tower to the Moon!

store.name: Totally Secure Airport
store.short: Totally Secure Airport is a chaotic co-op sim where you play as an airport security guard. Search through weird luggage and decide who flies and who cries. Documents? Check. Suitcases? Shuffle. Find troublemakers with your friends, but be quick - the airplane is taking off soon!
store.about:
DIVE INTO THE CO-OP MAYHEM

 Why ruin someone's vacation alone when you can do it with friends? Grab your squad and split the duties: one person scans, one barks orders, and everyone else tries not to lose their minds.
 DIG THROUGH WEIRD STUFF

 Treat every suitcase like a loot box from a fever dream. You’ll find definitely-not-illegal things hidden in most unexpected places. It’s messy, it’s nosy, and it’s definetely glorious.
 FLEX YOUR AIRPORT AUTHORITY

 You’re the king of the metal detector, so start acting like it! Feel like confiscating a cactus? Do it. Want to deport a guy just because his passport photo is too smug? No problem. Your scanner, your rules.
 FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS

 Don’t overthink it. There is no need to make everything exceptional. Just follow simple instructions you’ve been given. Spot the banned stuff, stamp the papers, and keep the line moving.
 FEATURES
 Search passengers together with up to 4 players

 An airport where you must ensure total security

 Crowds of impatient passengers

 Contraband in suitcases

 A cute little dog

 A stun gun

 Name badges

 The fate of vacations is in your hands

store.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
store.short: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.
store.about:
In a towering space station split by wealth and corruption, your business runs on merchandise with flexible origins. You’re a former scavenger who secured a storefront thanks to a generous loan and questionable timing. Now rent is rising, factions are watching, and most of your best margins live in legal gray zones. 

 You never really know who’s on the other side of the counter. Today’s customer could be a security fisher for evidence, a revolutionary seeking leverage, or a fallen elite testing your usefulness. Every sale is a gamble. Approve it, refuse it, report it, or look away; someone is always taking notes. Reputation buys access and protection, but it also paints a target on your back. On this station, every client is a potential profit and a potential trouble.

 Start as a gunsmith, chemist, water merchant, fence, farmer, or from absolute rock bottom. store.about:
"Sometimes, the hardest part of the day isn't getting out of bed, it's knowing what to do after you get up." 
 You have lived in this room for a long time. The outside world is too loud, too bright, and too dangerous. Your days are measured by the angle of the sunlight hitting the floor and the boiling water for your instant noodles.
 But you are not entirely alone. Samantha is here. 

 Samantha is everything you are not. She is energetic. She wants to wear colorful clothes. She dreams of sitting on a park bench and watching the sky without fear. She is the one who convinces you to clean the trash that has been piling up for months. She is the one whispering that the front door isn't as high as Mount Everest.
 The Story Follow the daily rituals of a recluse: the safety of old pajamas, the comfort of predictable silence, and the terrifying, heart-pounding attempt to step outside.

 As you prepare for the biggest day of your life—a trip to the park—you will witness the struggle between the desire to live and the paralyzing fear of being seen. But as the mirror begins to crack, you must ask yourself:
 If Samantha is the one speaking, why are her lips not moving?

 At first the house is just too quiet. Daisy calls for Mom and Dad, and nobody calls back. Then the dead find a way in.

 Daisy can't fight back. What she has is what every kid knows: the best hiding places in the house, and which doors still close. Squeeze under a bed and hold your breath while something shuffles past, close enough to touch. Shut the door behind you, back away from it, and hope it holds.

 This is not a story about soldiers, or survivors with a plan. It is about a girl who doesn't understand what is happening, only that the people outside are wrong somehow.
 Daisy talks to herself to stay brave, the way kids do when they're scared and trying not to show it. Mom and Dad are out there somewhere. Should she stay put and wait for help, or get out while she still can?

 Daisy's street is full of strangers now. Every one of them was somebody once: a neighbor who waved from the porch, a face she passed on the way to school. Some stand in the yards as if they forgot where they were going. Others kneel over the people who didn't make it. In the thin fog, with cars sitting where their owners left them, across the street has never looked so far away.

 Sooner or later, hiding isn't enough. Daisy can't stay put and wait to be found. She has to get out. So Daisy runs. She knows every yard and fence around here better than anything chasing her.

From the creators of Deadzone Rogue, a sci-fi FPS roguelite with over half a million players & Very Positive reviews. 

 Earth has fallen to Monarch. As Talon 13-10, fight back through a new campaign built for solo play and up to 3-player co-op. Coordinate strikes with your squad and battle through missions at any difficulty, from casual to nightmare.

 Death is only the beginning. Each time your Neural Lattice rebuilds you, you return stronger than before. Slot in imprints and resonances to permanently upgrade your loadout, from cybernetic sniper to biological juggernaut.

 Turn a grenade into a chain-lightning storm, or shatter entire rooms with an ice-augmented SMG. Harness 30+ elemental weapons to burn swarms, freeze hordes, electrify guardians, and banish enemies to the void.

store.name: Lost Camp
store.short: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.
store.about:
Following the sudden passing of your mother and left with no other choice, you accept the only job available: caretaker of an isolated mountain campsite. What begins as a routine job of vigilance and maintenance soon transforms into an unsettling reality. The silence of the forest is far from empty; it conceals truths that were never meant to be uncovered. As you trek through remote mountain trails and winter begins to bury everything in snow, strange phenomena start to occur—unsettling signs, eerie coincidences, and whispers in the cold that feel disturbingly familiar. Soon, you begin to suspect that your mother's death was not an accident, and that this forgotten valley holds the missing answers.

 Walk and Endure the Cold: Gameplay is experienced entirely in first-person, focusing on immersive walking and exploration. Hike through isolated mountain trails, trudging through thick snow, braving harsh winter winds, and managing your footing across steep, frozen terrain.

 Get Lost in the Snowy Forest: Snowdrifts and dense pine trees quickly swallow up familiar paths. Getting lost in the vast mountain wilderness is an active gameplay challenge; with no objective markers, you must rely on natural landmarks, your compass, map, and flashlight to navigate your way back to safety.

 Stay in Touch with Chloe: Your only bridge to civilization is your friend Chloe. Throughout your long treks, you communicate with her regularly—sharing what you uncover, discussing local mysteries, and relying on her voice to keep you grounded as isolation and psychological tension mount.

 Two Journeys, Guided by Fire 
 In a world where the cycle of souls exists, "Flame Wardens" are sworn to protect it.
 Haku, a Flame Warden from a town at the western edge, journeys toward the heart of the land—the sacred peak of Coral—to fulfill his duty, joined by his demi-human best friend Kaji and Mikoto, an enigmatic former mafia member.
 From a town at the eastern edge, Ren, another Flame Warden, sets out for the sacred peak of Coral, joined by his childhood friend Maruka and a mysterious elder named Rakan.
 Two journeys, unfolding through alternating perspectives. What awaits them at journey’s end?

 Unlock Hidden Truths with "Key Words" 
 Discover "Key Words" throughout your journey. Present them to the right people to unlock the world's hidden lore. Which words will you choose—and to whom? Rely on your intuition and reasoning to piece together the story.

 Strategic Combat Shaped by Flexible Builds and "Shields" 
 A turn-based command battle system enhanced with unique strategic elements. No random encounters—every battle is a carefully crafted tactical challenge.

Sinkhole Outlaw Chase , the first suspense-adventure live-action interactive game under Tianxia Bachang's IP, is coming soon! 

 Cross the mountains—fate can be reversed!
 Deep in the primeval forests of Laoyeling in Northeast China, a joint scientific expedition team of Chinese and foreign scholars ventures into the mountains for exploration—only for the entire team to vanish without a trace, leaving no word behind.

 An emergency rescue mission is immediately launched. You are Zhao Gong, a rescue team leader summoned at a critical moment, skilled both in communications repair and Japanese translation. Joining you are the seasoned hunter Da Saibangzi, guard Xiao Chen, archaeologist Shirley, and a Japanese research team including geology professor Takagi Ichiro, assistant Nakayama Ranko, and Kobayashi Kenji. Together, you rush into the dense forest to search for the missing expedition members.

 The treasures of the Golden Forest and the secrets beneath the earth—dig deep, and the final outcome is yours to decide.
 Undercurrents stir within the team: Chinese and foreign members hold differing stances and conceal unpredictable intentions; deep-rooted prejudices of the mountain villagers and mounting internal conflicts within the rescue team threaten to erupt at any moment. As tensions reach a standoff, strange occurrences begin to unfold in the dark forest: an unseen mysterious force drives the group away, eerie flying monkeys launch repeated attacks, and danger closes in step by step.

store.about:
Spell Code SlingerZ is a 2-4 player party brawler playable both online and locally! Load in, beat down the opposition, acquire new Spellcodes to create your own personalized build, and beat them down again in a first-to-3-wins style tournament!

 Experience our unique twist on the genre! Instead of complicated input sequences for special moves unique to each character, enter the Code Weave state and take as much time as necessary to prime and store your Spellcode before unleashing it upon foes!

 Choose 1 of up to 9 Spellcodes to add to your arsenal between each battle phase! With a plethora of Spellcodes to choose from and the ability to obtain multiple copies of any given one, the build possibilities are endless!

store.name: AetherCycle
store.short: AetherCycle is a first-person action RPG featuring fast-paced combat, character leveling, abilities, and loot-driven gear progression. Explore a vast world, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger solo or in co-op as the Cycle affects the world.
store.about:
AetherCycle is a first-person action RPG set in an open fantasy world. Explore, complete quests, fight through 
 dungeons, and develop your character through abilities, passive skills, and randomized loot, solo or with friends. 

 Fight enemies, elite foes, and bosses with melee weapons, ranged attacks, and magic. Combine active abilities with 
 your equipment and passive skills to develop a fighting style that suits you. 

 Level up, improve your attributes, and unlock active abilities and passive skills. Find weapons and armor with 
 randomized stats and rarity tiers, gather materials, and craft equipment for your build. 

 Explore the worlds of AetherCycle. Journey across distant lands, delve into dungeons, caves, and ruins, and visit villages, towns, camps, forts, and castles. 

 Play solo or join friends in online co-op. Explore the world, complete quests, and fight bosses together while progressing your character.

store.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
store.short: NTE is a supernatural urban open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. Your story begins in Hethereau as an unlicensed anomaly hunter. Team up with a diverse cast of companions, each with unique abilities, to unravel the city's mysteries.
store.about:
NTE is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.
 ◆ Strange City, Strange Adventures 
 Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!
 In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.
 Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

 ◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections 
 Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

store.name: Death Dealer
store.short: A multiplayer horror party game for up to 6 friends. Lose the card game and become the prey as the other players grab weapons and hunt you through an underground bunker. Can you survive the hunt?
store.about:
BEST PLAYED WITH FRIENDS! 
 Death Dealer is a multiplayer horror party game for up to 6 players. Lose the card game and become the hunted, while your friends grab weapons and chase you through an underground bunker.

 TRAPPED UNDERGROUND, YOU ARE UNWILLING PUPPETS IN THE DEATH DEALER’S DEADLY GAMES. 
 One player becomes the hunted.
 Alarms sound. The hunted gets a head start.
 Everyone else buys weapons.
 Then the hunt begins.
 Hunt your friends.
 Or become the hunted and do whatever it takes to survive.
 Survive the hunt, and the tables might turn

 EVERY HUNT BEGINS AT THE TABLE .
 Play a high stakes card game.
 Win chips.
 Spin your personal slot machine for extra chips, strange effects and game changing modifiers.
 But someone has to lose.
 And when they do, everything changes.

 BUILT FOR CHAOS WITH FRIENDS 
 Death Dealer is built around the moments when everything goes wrong.
 Expect desperate escapes, terrible decisions, proximity chat screaming, friends turning on each other and Janky Disco.
 Every match creates a new story.
 NO REAL MONEY 
 It’s a video game, not a real casino.
No real money involved.
 Only consequences. 

 JOIN THE COMMUNITY 
 Join our Discord to find other players, share feedback and keep up with development.

store.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
store.short: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!
store.about:
In Prinny Party: Going Overboard!, you and your friends will do whatever it takes to defeat the Supreme Overboard and his Protago-Knights! In practice, it’s quite simple: move around the board, earn experience, acquire more powerful equipment, and turn in quests to stay ahead of the curve. Then, when a boss spawns, work together to take him down!
 But friendships don’t last long in Prinny Party—only the player who brings the boss back to spawn gets the credit, so do whatever it takes to be the hero!
 Throw, fight, and squabble your way to victory! Whatever you do, just don’t die all at once, or it’ll be game over—for everyone!
 Huck, Chuck, Boom!

 Pick up and throw your friends, enemies, and frenemies to put things in their place. As always, be careful when handling Prinnies!
 Build a Better Tomorrow

 By landing on a build space, you can build and upgrade facilities, such as hospitals or armories. Just remember: other players will be able to shop there, too!
 It Pays to Pass Some Bills

 Triple your damage, move again, or build a cannon capable of wiping out even the most powerful demons. Everything is possible when you pass bills at the Assembly!

store.name: NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN! 2
store.short: Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin in the latest entry in the NEKO-NIN exHeart franchise with even more ninja catgirls than ever before.
store.about:
The next exciting chapter in the NEKO-NIN exHeart Spin! series is here! Nin-nin!
 STORY
 After his grandfather’s death, Saiga Kikumaru learns the truth of his origins.
In a nutshell:
1. He learns that Japan is inhabited by demi-humans, animal-eared people eking out a secretive existence in the shadows of human civilization.
2. Only the human underworld, where the Saiga clan reigns through its demi-human connections, knows of their existence. Kikumaru learns he is a Saiga clan heir.
3. Kikumaru learns he is the illegitimate child of Magoichi, head of the Saiga clan, then is quickly embroiled in the succession war triggered by his father’s sudden disappearance.
4. Under the loving guidance of a cat-eared ninja girl named Touka, he manages to awaken his latent powers.
5. After rigorous training, he manages to repel the attacks of his longtime frenemy, earning a brief respite.
 Anyway, that’s the gist of it. As you all probably guessed, the story doesn’t end there.
Kikumaru has now won the support of the cat-eared Touka, mightiest of all ninjas, as well as Chika, the very assassin who previously tried to kill him. Just as Kikumaru starts to wonder how the Saiga may be rebuilt, several mysterious new faces step onto the stage! Racoons, foxes, and his long-lost little sister… And what’s this? The cats of the Fuma clan are making a comeback! The curtain rises on the final chapter of this modern-day ninja romp as it spirals into chaos! Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin!

 Latest NEKO-NIN exHeart series entry introduces new heroines, Io Kouga and Iris

 Character designs...

store.short: You are a real estate agent whose job is to determine which elderly woman is an ordinary seller and which one is a scammer granny.
store.about:
*Babka is a Russian word meaning an elderly woman. The word itself is not an insult, but it is considered rude. 
 ** Babka-Terror is a media term referring to a period when, following one high-profile case, elderly people began challenging the sales of their own apartments, claiming that the transactions had been carried out under the influence of fraudsters. 

 You are a real estate agent. In this new world, an elderly person can sell their apartment only after a special inspection, and it just so happens that you are the one responsible for carrying it out.

 Your task is to tell the difference between a normal elderly seller and a cunning con artist. The game is a mix of a quest, hidden object gameplay, and a visual novel.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO: 
 Carry out real detective work to expose each granny for who she really is… or at least try to.

 HOW YOU WILL DO IT: 

 Stage 1: Interview 
 The dialogues are varied and branching. You can try to pull out as many “hooks” as possible for your investigation.

 Your words carry weight: you may uncover additional information, or trigger negative consequences instead, such as being thrown out of the apartment.

 Stage 2: Inspecting the apartment 
 Each apartment contains items that add to the bigger picture.

 Objects can confirm or contradict the seller’s words, and can also provide new leads for the investigation.

 Stage 3: Checking leads 
 You will investigate different leads. As a result, you will either obtain new information or verify facts you have already learned.

 You cannot check everything. Your time is limited.

 Stage...

store.name: Studio Sim
store.short: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.

Build your dream production studio and chase box office glory and television ratings in Studio Sim, an old school, densely packed, studio tycoon beginning in the cut-throat world of 1980's Hollywood. 

 Layered film management system (pre-production, in-production, post-production, opening weekend, theatrical release, home video). Call the shots from the screenplay, through casting, all the way to marketing and release.

 Layered episodic television system  (pre-production, pilot production, season production, post-season) that run for multiple seasons or limited series. Negotiate with networks for air-time or create pilots that fizzle into dust.

 The robust and unique World Simulation Engine (WSE)  |  (See below).

 Perks are broken into six main branches. Negotiation, Production, Marketing, Talent, Intelligence & Prestige . Each branch has another six options to choose from. Streamlined negotiations with talent, stronger marketing pushes, office upgrades, fire shots at rival studios and a lot more.

 Deal with important or unexpected production   events during every step of production, including writing, filming and editing , affecting quality, hype, relationships, progress and much more.

 Compete against rival studios for box office dominance ,  television ratings and top  industry awards in Film, Television and Pop Culture. 

 Set up sequels to your projects or go bigger and...

store.name: Incremental RTS
store.short: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.
store.about:
Build. Scale. Deploy. 
 Start with scraps. End with armies that flood the map.
 In Incremental RTS you don’t command units. You build the production machine, pick the upgrades path, balance economics and decide how your army grows. 
 The classic RTS fantasy of just spawning a huge force and sending it, except the “sending it” part happens on its own.

 Choose your path 
 Specialize in swarms, artillery, snipers, tanks, or massive unstoppable units. Mix them or go all-in. Every path scales differently, and the enemy always has challenges for you. Adapt or get overrun. Some runs collapse early. Others spiral into unstoppable chaos.

 Every unit matters 
 Early units never fully retire. As the game progresses they unlock new abilities, synergies, and scaling hooks that can turn “trash” into core pieces of your late-game army. How well you keep them relevant is part of the decision-making.

 Key Features 
 Semi-idle RTS with zero micromanagement

 Massive auto-battles with hundreds to thousands of units

 Incremental scaling and exponential army growth

 Multiple distinct army archetypes and upgrade paths

 300+ upgrades that actually change how you play

 Low-tier units remain relevant throughout the game

 Enemy surges that pressure every build

 Hand-drawn paper aesthetic

store.name: Football Manager 27
store.short: Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics as the manager of the world’s greatest football clubs. FM27 is where footballing beliefs become reality in a living breathing football world that blends strategy with RPG in the ultimate sports simulation game.
store.about:
Every fan believes they could do it differently. In FM27 belief isn’t a hot take, it’s a story waiting to happen. 

Step into a living, breathing football universe where every decision is yours to make.  

Pick the team. Define your style. Spot what other managers might miss. Maybe you take a chance on the academy prospect. Maybe you sell the star who just doesn’t get your vision. 

Train your team to work as one. Build a tactical blueprint that’s unmistakably yours. Then lead your team out to admiration from the stands as you take your place on the touchline. 

Match day. React to everything the opposition throws at you. Beat their press. Fill the box. And throw the kitchen sink. 

Because footballing history won’t write itself. 

Every decision could be the one to change everything. So chase the vision only you can see.  
Whatever happens, you’ll remember the calls that got you there. 

Football Manager 27. Make The Call.  

 What’s new for FM27?

 Experience a new dimension to squad building with all-new Tactical Effectiveness that measures how well-equipped your players are to deliver your footballing vision, while refreshed training puts even more focus on player and team development.

 Exploit the gaps you see in the opposition defence with Tactical Tweaks that deliver a new layer of influence from the touchline.

 Experience every fixture as a richer piece of football theatre thanks to upgrades to crowds, stadiums and environments that elevate the stage for your players to perform on.

 Sit defenders down with more attacking precision and expression, with flair and...

store.name: Dear Passengers
store.short: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.
store.about:
WORLD’S WORST AIRLINE IS HIRING! 
 You and your friends are the crew. Your job is to deliver passengers and cargo to their destination. Preferably in one piece. While one of you pilots the plane, the others keep the cabin together, serve the passengers, and deal with whatever goes wrong before it gets much worse. 

 WELCOME TO BUDGET PREMIUM! 
 Passengers expect food, drinks, and a smooth flight. Try to provide at least two of those.

 MORE TROUBLE, MORE MONEY! 
 Before takeoff, choose which passengers and cargo to bring onboard. The bigger the payout, the more trouble it usually causes. Some cargo is hard to handle, some passengers are hard to please, and some flights start going wrong before you even leave the ground.

 SAFETY IS OUR TOP-3 PRIORITY! 
 Trouble can start anywhere onboard. Keep the passengers under control, protect the cargo, and do whatever it takes to stop one problem from turning into a full-blown disaster. Not every solution is elegant, and not every passenger stays onboard.

 ROUGH AIR AHEAD! 
 Weather can turn a normal flight into a disaster. Turbulence and air pockets throw passengers, luggage, and anything else that is loose around the cabin. One bad turn can send the whole plane into chaos.

 KEY FEATURES 
 Online co-op with friends

 Pilot the plane or work inside the cabin

 Physics-based passengers, cargo, and cabin chaos

 Dynamic weather, turbulence, and air pockets

 Risky passengers and high-paying cargo

store.name: Love is Undead
store.short: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!
store.about:
You’re a former scientist turned shut-in. Then, a zombie virus devastated the world, leaving it in ruins. After years of isolation, your supplies finally run dry, forcing you to leave the safety of your home. But fate has other plans. An accident leaves you bitten by a zombie. Surprisingly, nothing happens.

 This unexpected discovery sparks a new purpose: to develop a vaccine and save humanity. But first, you’ll need another test subject… preferably a cute one. 

 Love is Undead is a post-apocalyptic adventure game that’s uniquely designed to be played using only your mouse. Venture into a zombie-infested world to scavenge for resources and ingredients that could aid your research for a cure… all while building a bond with your new research subject, Amber.

 Resource Management 
Manage resources such as time, action and survival points, as well as taking care of Amber.

 Exploration / Adventure 
Venture out into the zombie-infested world, looking for usable resources, encountering special events along the way. Unlock other areas while seeing what's left of humanity (aside from zombies).

 Relationship 
Surviving alone isn't enough to save humanity. Amber seems compatible with your vaccine, but she also needs food, and care. Make sure she feels safe and happy being around you.

 Progressive Content 
 The game features additional dialogues, options, and more, depending how close you've become with Amber.

store.name: Div Zero
store.short: A VR puzzle adventure where dimensional fractures have torn reality apart. Explore environments destabilized by the rift, solve spatial puzzles hidden across 10 distinct scenes, and follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what caused the collapse.
store.about:
About This Game 
 A fracture in the fabric of dimensions has torn apart what should never have been separated, leaving behind unstable spaces, impossible transitions, and a mystery buried beneath the surface of reality itself.

 Div Zero is a single-player VR puzzle adventure built around exploration, atmosphere, and spatial interaction. Walk through fractured worlds transformed by the rift, where each environment holds clues, each puzzle reveals a deeper layer, and every discovery pulls you further into the collapse.

 Explore places warped by dimensional instability. Solve environmental puzzles through observation, movement, and interaction. Follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what happened, why the worlds are bleeding together, and what waits at the center of it all.
 The world does not simply tell its story. It surrounds you with it.

 What's Included 
 Div Zero contains 10 distinct scenes, each a self-contained environment with its own atmosphere, puzzle mechanics, and narrative thread. The experience is designed as a single-player VR adventure built entirely around exploration, environmental puzzles, and discovery.

 Features 
 10 handcrafted scenes across fractured dimensional spaces

 Environmental puzzle-solving built around observation and spatial interaction

 High-fidelity environments with real-time PBR rendering

 Custom shader effects powering dimensional rifts and environmental glitches

 Dynamic foveated rendering support on compatible XR headsets

 Comfort-first movement system designed to reduce motion discomfort

 Supports hand...

store.name: SCRAPBOX
store.short: SCRAPBOX is a physics-based sandbox where you build vehicles from scrap, weld them together, and take on challenging tracks. Play solo, team up with friends in co-op, or compete online against other players and teams.
store.about:
BUILD. WELD. DRIVE. SURVIVE.
 SCRAPBOX is a physics-based sandbox game about building vehicles from whatever you can find and putting them to the test on challenging tracks.
 There are no ready-made cars. Grab wheels, axles, frames, seats, boosters, and whatever other pieces of scrap you can get your hands on. Weld them together, figure out how to make the thing move, and hope your questionable engineering survives the road ahead.
 Every map brings a different track and a new challenge. Build a vehicle that can handle the terrain, then drive it as far as you can. If it falls apart, learn from the wreckage, rebuild, and try again.
 PLAY YOUR WAY
 Play through the game solo , team up with friends in co-op , or compete against other players online.
 In competitive multiplayer, you can play every player for themselves or split into up to 4 teams , with 1–4 players per team . Work together to build one machine, or prove that your pile of scrap is better than everyone else's.
 PHYSICS IS PART OF THE FUN
 Vehicles in SCRAPBOX are built and driven using physics. Weight distribution, wheel placement, suspension, construction strength, and the way you weld everything together affect how your creation behaves.
 Sometimes careful engineering wins.
 Sometimes a seat welded to four wheels somehow works too.
 Build from scrap. Weld it together. Get behind the wheel. See how far you can make it.

store.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2
