Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2 is a fast, competitive, and chaotic local multiplayer party racing game!!!!
 Defeat your friends in split-screen matches with up to 8 players. Choose between 8 different game modes while using multiple weapons such as missiles, shields, explosive barrels, hooks, and more!!!
 A game designed to be played with friends on the couch, fast and frenetic, but you can also practice against bots in some game modes.

 Chaos and Destruction
 Cars react dynamically to damage from other vehicles and from the environment; your car gets damaged as the match progresses.
 Parts of the map are also destroyed during the match, so plan your strategy carefully.

 Weapons of Mass Destruction
 Each weapon is unique and interacts differently with the environment and with other weapons; from simple weapons like missiles to more extravagant ones such as the powerful Battering Ram. The game features a total of 12 weapons, so don’t forget to drive over weapon pickup pads around the track. Build your arsenal!

 Split-Screen
 Challenge your friends (enemies) in split-screen from the same couch or through Remote Play Together as if you were all sitting on the same couch… except now it’s a virtual couch.

 Customization
 Classic Car is not just a random name for the game!!! The game features multiple classic cars, and you can customize them to your liking with colors, extras, and decals. Create your own unique combinations.

 Game Modes
 Multiple game modes = many hours of fun with friends (enemies >:) ). The game features 3 main game categories and multiple variants for...

store.name: Linlang's Ledger
store.short: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
store.about:
Play as Linlang, an ancient merchant, starting from scratch and creating a business miracle. As time passes, gradually explore a vast land, hone your skills, build connections with diverse individuals, strategize, buy low and sell high, steadily accumulating immense wealth to become a legendary tycoon.
 One-click auto-play allows you to check your profits anytime, offering a balance of strategic depth and easy gameplay.

 Explore Regions: 8 regions, 30+ locations, freely travel and explore this vast and resource-rich ancient kingdom with its open-minded culture.
 Trade Goods: Unlock dozens of unique goods and hundreds of trading paths. Utilize your initial capital wisely, plan carefully, buy low and sell high to accumulate wealth.
 Master Skills: 7 professional skills and several item books provide unique growth paths.
 Cultivate Connections: 10 NPCs with diverse backgrounds await your discovery and friendship; listen to their stories.
 Deep Storyline: Multiple triggerable storylines, unexpected encounters, random adventures, and tales of extraordinary people... making your journey full of surprises.
 Strategic Planning: Hundreds of buffs can be freely combined, providing intricate and complex effects. Plan your time and action sequence, and choose the appropriate trade strategy.
 Relaxing Atmosphere: A meticulously designed and unique interface style, paired with original Chinese-style casual tracks, provides you with a relaxed and enjoyable gaming atmosphere.

store.name: Pig King
store.short: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.
store.about:
THIS LITTLE PIGGY WOULDN’T DIE  
 Just because you die doesn't mean you can't commit pig-on-pig violence. Dead players return as zombie pigs, and while they can't use weapons, they can still attack the living... and fly.

 THIS LITTLE PIGGY WANTED A THRONE 
 Armed with weapons, your wits and your snout, it's time to ruin your friendships in the contest for the pig throne! Take on 3 of your closest frenemies and stake your claim.

 THIS LITTLE PIGGY FOUND A TOY 
 Smash crates to find items and weapons or use the arena itself to your advantage. Don't forget to fight dirty!

 THIS LITTLE PIGGY FOUND HIS STYLE 
 Going to commit mud-fueled atrocities against your friends? Might as well look stylish doing it. Customize your hog with the finest, most absurd outfits available.

 THIS LITTLE PIGGY RAN ALL THE WAY HOME 
 Jump into the mud, and wishlist it before your friends beat you to the royal trough.

store.name: Flesh Grinding
store.short: Grind flesh. Gather blood. Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.
store.about:
Grind flesh, collect blood; Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement operation. Buy sinister upgrades, maximize your efficiency, and push your machinery to its limits while avoiding the terrifying entity watching your every move. 

 Process the flesh: Feed the grinder with raw, grotesque meat. Watch it tear everything apart and turn it into your currency.

 Harvest the blood: Collect the blood spilled with every grind. Manage your tanks carefully—every drop is fuel for survival.

 Bleed for efficiency: Reinvest your crimson earnings into sinister upgrades and push your operation even further.

 Expand the operation: Buy more grinders, upgrade their efficiency and turn your basement into a relentless production line.

 Build twisted machinery: Refine energy, compress flesh, produce blood vials and power bizarre machines that push the process even further.

 Keep the factory moving: Unlock carts, switches and new tools to haul more flesh, control your workspace and scale the horror.

 Descend into the unknown: Explore cursed basements, abandoned facilities and places that were never meant to be found.

 Piece together the nightmare: Find letters and scattered clues that reveal what happened here… and what may still be watching.

 Venture deeper at your own risk: From “cozy” homes to twisted industrial zones and abandoned operating rooms, each new area hides something worse than the last.

store.name: Canvas Attack!
store.short: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.
store.about:
You are an unknown yet brilliant painter arriving with empty pockets but a head full of dreams. In Canvas Attack! surviving as a creator requires strategy, endurance, and the perfect deck of skill cards. Forget about slashing monsters - your battlefield is an unfinished canvas. You must use a deck of mosaic-piece cards tailored to your artwork alongside a permanent deck of skill cards to fill the empty cells of your painting. But be prepared, unpainted cells spawn negative effects every round. If you do not paint them quickly, they will drain your spirit!

 Your journey as a creator is never linear. Navigate a branching map and choose events carefully. Gather essential resources, discover new cards, acquire items, and restore your character’s spirit to keep pushing forward. Unfortunately, the life of a creator is tough, and you will probably fail. However, each defeat unlocks new characters, cards, items, and scenarios with new breathtaking art pieces.

 Features:
 Experience genuine art from famous late 19th and early 20th-century European artists. 

 Original puzzle-combat system: a fresh take on the roguelike deckbuilder genre where your cards are your brushstrokes.

 The map is procedurally generated. Carefully balance your creative output with your financial and mental stability.

store.name: Casualties: Unknown
store.short: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.
store.about:
Survive a Harsh World  
 Each layer brings its own challenges, adapt and descend. 

 Simulated Limb and Cardiovascular Systems  
 Injuries are unavoidable. You will have to bandage yourself, fight infected wounds, and stabilize blood loss before losing consciousness. Additionally, your mood can greatly affect your chances of survival, too much doom and gloom will make your life harder. 

 Craft to Survive  
 As a creature capable of reason, using tools will allow you to travel the cavernous layers more efficiently. In case you start bleeding out, the flora will provide great resources to patch yourself up. 

 Explore at Your Own Risk  
 Previous expeditions have left some good loot behind. But even helpful things can prove to be your death.

 Uncover the Truth  
 What actually lies at the end of this journey? And what becomes of you if you are to succeed?

 Features 
 An entirely simulated cardiovascular and limb damage system

 Character traits to increase on your run: Intelligence, Strength, and Resilience

 Robust crafting mechanics to increase your odds of survival

 3 characters with their own distinct playstyles

 11 layers of an alien planet with their own challenges and dangers

 300 items to find on your runs

 Adjustable loot and danger values accessible on the main menu

store.name: Ship or Burn! Coop express
store.short: Someone’s order burned? At least the train made it! Explore a dangerous open world, deliver cargo, and protect it from zombies. Out of fuel? Toss someone’s parcel, a zombie, or your annoying friend into the firebox! Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.
store.about:
The train runs as long as something's burning. Toss everything into the furnace. 

 You and your friends are couriers on a locomotive that only runs while something's burning in the firebox. Coal. Parcels. Zombies. Someone's wedding cake. Decide fast — the station won't wait.
 Delivery, chaos and greed for 1–4 players 

 At every station you pick and deliver parcels: expensive, fragile, too heavy to carry alone, suspiciously wriggling. Load the cars, plot your route. The train devours fuel, zombies claw at your cargo, and the next station is still far away. You decide what matters more: delivering the order intact, or chucking it into the furnace to reach the next stop and cash in on something pricier.
 Special Delivery: Chaos

 Zombies want your cargo? Make them work for it. Shoot, kick and throw anything you can grab to keep them off your train. Your friends are throwable too, so try to agree on who’s fighting and who’s flying. And if a zombie gets too close, there’s always room in the furnace.
 What will end up in your furnace? 
 Grab your friends. Grab the train. Grab more parcels than you can carry. Let's see how much you deliver, and how much burns along the way.
 Add to wishlist so you don't miss the demo launch!

store.name: Going my way?
store.short: You're a train conductor in a world that doesn't sleep anymore. People are losing their minds, and Wanderers hide among them. Your job sounds simple: get the train to the City, watch the passengers, and never forget that the train demands sacrifices.
store.about:
You're new here, so remember these rules. Do as I say if you value your life.

 LISTEN AND REMEMBER 
 Channel your inner detective. Use your brain if you've got one. Talk to people, pay attention to the small details, and never trust first impressions.

 HUNT FOR WANDERERS 
 They look like ordinary passengers and say all the right things, but they always slip up. Identify them before they choose their next victim.

 FEED THE TRAIN 
 The train runs on a very special kind of fuel. Wanderer or ordinary human, it doesn't care. It'll gladly devour either one.

 MAINTAIN ORDER IN THE CAR 
 Seat passengers where they belong and serve the right tea. The right additive can loosen tongues, lower defenses, or protect against Wanderers. Choose wisely.

 DON'T TEST MY PATIENCE 
 Follow my directives, don't ask unnecessary questions, and if you're lucky, you'll make it to the City.
 N.N.

store.name: TARAE: The Unbound
store.short: TARAE: The Unbound is an action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy world. Explore Taegwido, an island born upon the shattered boundaries of the Six Realms, and master the distinct combat styles and builds of six unique classes.
store.about:
Sever Fate.  
 TARAE: The Unbound is a top-down action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy.
 Mercilessly carve your way through swarms of enemies, master the patterns of powerful foes, and overcome every challenge standing in your way.
 Cut Down the Horde Use a wide arsenal of skills and chained attacks to tear through the battlefield. Experience a combat system that hits as hard as it looks.

 Boss Battles Built to Be Mastered Learn the patterns and tricks of menacing boss monsters. Seize your moment to dodge, counter, and carve your path to glory.

 Relentless Action, Merciless Impact Every hit lands with satisfying force, making each fight exhilarating to tear through a mass of enemies.

 Combat Shaped by Your Decisions Combine class skills, traits, support skills, and gear into a build and playstyle that's all your own.

 Six Seekers, One Intertwined Tale Travel with the six Seekers, each carrying their own karma and purpose. Through countless trials, seek true understanding to become true allies.

 Journey Across Taegwido, at the Shattered Boundaries of the Six Realms Step into a world that reimagines Eastern myth, folklore, and traditional aesthetics, where beauty and mystery are entwined with darkness and brutality.

 Each battle and every choice shapes the path to restoring order to the Six Realms.

 Taegwido, an island born upon the collapsed Six Realms 
 "The Sources that can restore the cycle of reincarnation lie scattered across Taegwido." 
 The outcast Agasa shattered the boundaries to break the wheel of reincarnation. From these fractured lands, the island of...

store.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
store.short: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.
store.about:
Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel is the first game in the series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel depicting what happened after the 2014 anime film Expelled from Paradise.
 Civilization has been destroyed by the Nano Hazard, a runaway nanomachine disaster, and most of humanity has given up their physical bodies to live on as data in the virtual world of DEVA. Angela Balzac turned her back on that world and chose to live on the surface with her partner, Dingo. Theirs is a story shaped by the conversations they have shared and the choices they have made—and it is your choices that will determine where it leads.

 ■ The story stirs once more, down on the surface
 A.D. 2400. Ever since the Nano Hazard, a catastrophic event that laid waste to the surface world, 98% of humanity has abandoned both the ravaged Earth and their own flesh and blood to migrate to the virtual world of DEVA. Now, a strange new lifeform has suddenly begun sprouting on the surface: the Paraflora. As it spreads at alarming speed, colossal worms have started to appear nearby, attacking people one after another. At the heart of the outbreak lies Svarga, a desert town that was long ago abandoned due to a plague. Meanwhile, an agent of DEVA’s Security Bureau has stolen Grey Goo, a top-secret file holding data on the Nano Hazard, and fled to the surface. Their trail, too, leads to Svarga. And now, in this ghost town shrouded in mystery and conspiracy, several competing agendas are about to converge.

 ■ With the K2-system, Angela’s heart is in your hands!
 In the film, Angela felt the wind on the...

store.name: GummyGom Delivery
store.short: Carry cargo together on a shared board with your jelly bear teammates! Each movement affects the board’s balance, and a single mistake can bring everything crashing down.
store.about:
GummyGom Delivery: A Co-op Adventure with Planks and Cargo! 
 Embark on a cargo delivery journey on a plank with your cute gummy colleagues! Your mission is to safely deliver the cargo to its destination through all sorts of obstacles. It's nearly impossible alone, but with friends, you might (just maybe) succeed!
 Key Features 
 Unpredictable Physics Action : Balance the cargo on the plank with your friends. Every movement creates unintended consequences.

 4-Player Co-op : Play with up to 4 friends. Go beyond simple cooperation; sync your positions and timing.

 Challenging Level Design and Obstacles : Massive rotating sticks, crumbling or slippery platforms, and various terrains await to hinder your delivery.

 Diverse Themed Stages : Stages like Sweet Land, Antarctica, and Death Run are waiting for you.

 Gameplay 

 Coordinate with your friends to move forward!

 Solve various puzzle elements to progress!

 Devices requiring simultaneous movement at specific timings add to the fun of the delivery. Feel the strong teamwork of "I can't go without you."

 Experience thrilling moments with your friends.

 Watch out for obstacles that hinder your movement.

store.name: Your party died again
store.short: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.
store.about:
'Your party died again' is an incremental dungeon crawler with rapid character progression. Allow your party members to do most of the fighting for you as you collect the loot.

 Unlock the Priest, the Ranger and the Mage to create an undefeatable party of heroes. 

 Explore 225 skill nodes within 4 skill trees using unique resources to empower each hero independently.

 Use 8 different abilities tactically to gain an edge or put them on auto cast to sit back and enjoy the ride.

 Fight through 7 different levels with unique monsters and mechanics to overcome. (Estimated playing time of 5 hours)

store.name: GET RAMMED
store.short: GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!
store.about:
GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events! 
 Features 
 Gather your friends (or enemies) on the couch or battle them across the globe in fast-paced, physics-fueled multiplayer mayhem with up to 8 players . No friends or need some practice? No problem, play against bots with different settings.

 Maps and Modes 
 Battle it out on a multitude of maps each with their own specific style and gameplay across various game modes such as Deathmatch , King of the Hill , Last Ram Standing and more!

 Items 
 Unleash mayhem in the arena with crazy Items , some can be a bit excessive, but what is a Goat without excess?

 Customisation 
 Express yourself with Colour , Funky Hats and Goofy Names ! What you might lack in skill, you can make up for in style! There's also in-depth match settings (Don't want a specific power-up/map? Switch it off!)

 WHO WILL BE THE G.O.A.T?

store.name: GhostomVillage
store.short: Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive. Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.
store.about:
Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive.
 Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

 Explore an Eastern Underworld at the Turn of the Millennium
 GhostomVillage blends the social atmosphere of turn-of-the-millennium China with traditional Chinese mythology of the afterlife, creating an Underworld that feels both familiar and absurd.
 Ancient courts of the dead coexist with the everyday bustle of ordinary life, while all kinds of wandering souls continue their own strange version of “living.”

 Survive in an Ever-Evolving World
 Plants grow, animals reproduce, day turns to night, and the world continues to change around you. NPCs have their own jobs, routines, and behavioral patterns.
 Hunt, gather, farm, and craft. Make the most of limited resources and find a way to survive.

 Build a Business and Grow Your Influence
 Meet all kinds of characters, recruit companions, trade goods, purchase property, produce resources, construct buildings, and run businesses as you build your own faction and reputation.
 Become one of the wealthiest figures in the Underworld—or challenge the old order and rise as the new King of Hell.

store.name: Cartel Pilots Wanted
store.short: Cartel Pilots Wanted is a co-op pilot job sim set in a tropical archipelago controlled by the cartel. Fly smuggling missions with friends, deliver sketchy cargo, and upgrade your aircraft. Master accessible flight physics and explore hidden islands with a chill criminal vibe.
store.about:
DELIVER SKETCHY CARGO

 After a wild night in paradise, you and your friends wake up on a remote island owned by a cartel. To start your lives anew, you must take to the skies and fly questionable missions for your new “employers”. Take contracts, stack cargo, and deliver it across a vast tropical archipelago.

 COOPERATIVE SMUGGLING

 If you’re going to take shady smuggling flights, you might as well do it with friends, right? Experience the life of a cartel pilot in co-op. Just don’t forget to grab a crate of cold beer before the next mission.

 PREPARE AND MAINTAIN YOUR PLANES

 Get your hands dirty in the hangar to ensure your planes stay airborne and reliable. Yes, it’s a chill smuggler life on these islands, but a well-maintained plane is your only way home.

 STYLE IN THE SKIES, STYLE ON LAND

 Express your style by customizing both your pilot and your aircraft. Choose from a variety of outfits and design custom liveries for your planes. If you’re going to be the most wanted pilots in the region, you might as well look good doing it.

 TROPICAL ARCHIPELAGO AWAITS

 Explore a vast world of sun-drenched islands and breathtaking ocean views. Navigate through clear skies or prepare to show your piloting skills when violent tropical storms hit the area.

store.name: Booster Pack Heroes
store.short: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.
store.about:
Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms.

 Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes.

 Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force.

 Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can.

 Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer.
 …and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets.
 The cycle has repeated countless times.
 You're here to break it.

store.name: Ball Guys: Merge Party
store.short: Merge bouncing Ball Guys into massive, satisfying combos in this chaotic physics puzzler where every drop can make — or break — your run.
store.about:
DROP. MERGE. SABOTAGE. REPEAT. 
 Ball Guys: Merge Party is a chaotic physics-based merging game where every drop can trigger a massive combo… or completely ruin your run.
 Drop your Balls into the cup. Match two of the same kind to merge them into the next ball up. Build ridiculous combos, discover new balls and keep everything under control as your cup gets increasingly crowded.
 Sounds easy?
 It isn't.

 MERGE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP 
 Every drop matters.
 Plan your placement, use physics to your advantage and create huge combosas your balls bounce, roll and squash into each other.
 Push your luck for a bigger score — but be careful. If a Ball Guy escapes the cup before checking out, your run is over.
 Think you've mastered it?
 Climb the leaderboards and prove it!

 FIX YOUR MISTAKES… WITH A SNIPER 
 Made a terrible drop?
 Take matters into your own hands.
 Use special abilities like the Sniper to rescue a run, set up the perfect merge or deal with that one Ball Guy that absolutely refuses to cooperate.

 MAKE MERGE YOURS 
 Customise the chaos with custom game modes.
 Change the cup. Change the balls. Change the rules.
 Share your creations & see who beats your challenges! 
 BUILT WITH THE BALL GUYS COMMUNITY 
 Ball Guys: Merge Party grew out of our popular Merge mini-game on iOS and Android, and we're expanding it into a full Steam and console game.
 We're building it alongside our community, so download or wishlist the game, join us and help shape what Merge Party becomes. 
 TURN MERGING INTO A PARTY 
 [coming soon]
 Challenge your friends in chaotic multiplayer modes...

store.name: Grave Mistakes
store.short: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.
store.about:
Good Mourning™ Funeral Home takes pride in serving customers during their most delicate moments. As the most trusted, and only, funeral home in the area, your one-stop shop is vital to the community. Keeping everyone happy also means having enough stock. Running out of fresh meat is not an option… 
 Family Business 
 Grandma has been around ever since this place was built. She’s locked in the basement, and not in a particularly human form, so you will have to fetch her meals. Each day she will request an assortment of body parts from you. Don’t worry, you’ll have an entire shift to prepare for today’s “menu”.
 Opening Hours 
 Good Mourning™ Funeral Home is very much a legitimate business. From dawn to dusk, you will be busy: people coming in for funeral preparations, conducting ceremonies, and of course, embalming. Just keep people away from the back of house. Nobody should have to see what goes on there.

 Prepare Bodies, Make Orders 
 Once the body arrives, there is no time to lose. The body will start decaying, and you have things to do. Replace an arm with a shovel, a leg with a skateboard, and a head is essentially a basketball with a picture on it (depending on who you ask).
 Family Dinner 
 When the day is done, it’s time for family dinner. Everybody gathers round the table down in the basement to watch Grandma feast. You better hope you brought what she craves. If not, one of you will become that evening’s meal.

 Features 
 Online co-op and proximity chat

 Run and manage a ‘respectable’ funeral home

 Chop and clean physics-based bodies

 Deceive families and...

store.name: Everything Mart
store.short: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.
store.about:
Welcome to Everything Mart! Today, you will start your first shift in our store. As a valued member of our team, we wanted to give you one last rundown of your responsibilities when you work this shift:
 1. Your productivity quota must be met each day, to ensure your continued employment here. The tasks you do each day [FILL ONLINE ORDERS, RESTOCK SHELVES, CLEAN MESSES] will contribute to this quota.
 2. Most tasks in the Everything Mart require you track down our brand-unique fresh products. These "living products" must be processed in-store, and at their appropriate processing stations, to ensure maximum product freshness. 
 3. Work together with your coworkers to complete your tasks each day, and  do not [RUN THEM OVER WITH A SHOPPING CART, PELT THEM WITH THROWN OBJECTS OR PRODUCTS, LEAD HOSTILE ENTITIES THEIR WAY, etc].
 Finally, while you may have seen worrisome reviews from past employees about the presence of hostile [ENTITIES AND/OR MANAGEMENT], please disregard this libelous slander. After all, Everything Mart  has no past employees ! 
 With all that being said, good luck on your shift! Please work hard and fill your quota each day so that you can continue your employment as a member of our family; after all, we'd hate to have to [TERMINATE] a new employee!

store.name: CINDER CITY
store.short: CINDER CITY is an open-world cinematic third-person shooter set in a fallen near-future Seoul. Fight alongside allies, push back against overwhelming threats, and reclaim the city from the forces tearing it apart.
store.about:
Take Back Seoul 
 Become a Cinderknight, each with unique abilities, and stand as one of the last lines of defense against the maniacal Hyde group, twisted Creatures, and hostile factions that strike without warning.
 The city has fallen. No ground is safe. Use your abilities, hold your role, and fight to take back what was lost.

 Fight with Tactics 
 Tactical Gear with distinct uses like drones and stealth. Vehicles like bikes, power loader mechs, and aircraft scattered across the open world. Your strategy and loadout decide every fight.

 Choose Your Missions 
 Epic story missions, side missions, and dynamic events fill the open world. Take on missions solo or team up with other players. The choices you make will shape what this city becomes.

 Every Threat. Every Scale. 
 Field bosses, instanced dungeons, massive world raids — the threats in Seoul don't stop, and neither do you.
 Divide roles, execute strategy, and build your character around your playstyle. Whether it's a dungeon run or a full-scale raid, co-op is where it all comes together.

store.name: Knuckle Creek
store.short: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick single player and multiplayer party game designed for chaotic fun, crazy characters and weapons galore. Complete an extensive solo campaign with hundreds of unlockables or party it up with friends in one of the many couch play or online party modes.
store.about:
From the team who brought you the Overwhelmingly Positive rated Platypus Reclayed, Knuckle Creek is the ultimate clay-animated single player and party brawler for up to 8 players, offering chaotic couch play and online party modes. The solo campaign includes 48+ handcrafted levels and 100s of cosmetics to unlock, while multiplayer offers a multitude of configurable ways to play.

 If you like slapstick brawling with friends from your sofa then this is the game for you. If you like them but nobody’s around tonight, this is still the game for you!

 Grab a fish, rocket launcher, or even a chicken, and battle your opponents. Matches last minutes, the rules can change every round, and even knocked out players can be agents of chaos. Welcome to Knuckle Creek, home of the world famous Knuckle Sandwich.
 KEY FEATURES 
 48+ levels Single Player campaign with Steam Friend leaderboard support

 Couch play and online party mode for up to 8 friends

 Character customisation with hundreds of cosmetics, voices, and more

 Full multiplayer game customisation

store.name: The Brave Few
store.short: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.
store.about:
The Brave Few is a World War II combined arms combat game.

 Planned for Early Access: 
 6 Roles with 2 sub-roles for each (Pilot (Fighter or Bomber), Navigator, Bombardier, Radio Operator, Flight Engineer, Medic, Gunner)

 2-16 player co-op with the ability to fly or gun in the B-17, or pilot as a P-51-D Escort fighter

 4 B-17F historically based missions with varying difficulties and time of day (Single player or co-op)

 Custom difficulty to disable or enable certain features

 Experience based character and crew stats

 Persistent crew members in Single player that are replaced by new recruits if they die

 A plethora of key-binds, settings, and graphics presets

 Tutorial missions

 In-game VOIP with radio filter

 Ability to repair, heal, revive crewmates, arm bombs, and use the Norden bomb sight to bomb targets

 Enemy flak, and fighters including; BF-109E, FW-190, BF-110, and the ME-410

 Realistic damage, flight, and projectile physics models for aircraft

 The Vision :
 Authentic World War II campaign based on real events and major operations

 The ability to pilot, gun, bomb, drive, or sail each of the vehicles, ships, anti-air, and aircraft that experienced combat during World War II

 Multiplayer co-op and PvP missions grounded against realistically based opponents

 Class progression system (Pilot, Navigator, Gunner, Medic, Mechanic)

 Cinematic sequences to repair, heal, and maintain critical systems

 A variety of vehicle, character, and weapon upgrades

 Arcade and realistic modes that include different objectives for aircraft, land, and naval vessels in...

store.name: BOMBANANA!
store.short: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?
store.about:
BOMBANANA! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?
 MEET YOUR SQUAD! 
 🙈 Blind Monkey: You can’t see the bomb, but you can touch the bomb! 👍 Sadly, you can’t see colors or read screens. You’ll need to rely on your teammates for the rest. 

 🙊 Mute Monkey: You are the only one who can read the bomb disposal manual. If only you could tell the others what you know.

 🙉 Deaf Monkey: You can see the bomb and you can see your friends as they frantically gesture at you. Sadly, you can’t hear a thing, but at this point, would you even want to?

 As you gamble with your friends' lives, you must rely on each other and your monkeys' unique abilities. Communication is key, and there’s no one right way to defuse the bomb. We don’t impose any methods: wave, shout, throw bananas. Working out how you communicate is your job.
 WARNING! 
 Players can and should expect peak amounts of misunderstanding, unjust accusations, and desperate body language, placing your friendships in jeopardy. Just because you keep talking, that doesn't mean nobody explodes. Even if you manage to survive the bomb, there's no guarantee your friendship will. Some might call this game "friendslop". We disagree. If anything, it's a new genre: anti-friendslop, or perhaps an argument simulator. 🤔
 We’ll let you be the judge!

 FEATURES! 
 3-Player Co-op - No more, no less. Exactly three...

store.name: Alien: Isolation 2
store.short: Face your ultimate fears in the long-awaited sequel to the award-winning survival horror game, Alien: Isolation.
store.about:
When a survey team on a remote colony-planet discovers a mysterious crashed vessel, one member makes it her priority to investigate. No one is prepared for the horror unwittingly unleashed on the settlement. Nowhere is safe.
 So begins a desperate journey to survive and escape, as she is relentlessly hunted by the deadly creature.

store.name: Still With Me
store.short: A short psychological horror experience about returning to a familiar place where something has been waiting for you.
store.about:
STILL WITH ME is a short psychological horror experience about returning to a familiar place.
 A place that used to be home, now filled with unsettling events and signs of a presence that knows you far too well.

 Features: 
 A focused horror experience 

 Estimated playtime: 30 minutes 

 Observation-based gameplay 

 A tense, atmospheric sound design 

 Moments of escalation and psychological pressure

store.name: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
store.short: Return to Campus 2 brings back absurd open-world comedy, now with online multiplayer! Play as a super-rich heir exploring a modern city and a medieval world. Complete quests, meet NPCs, cruise around, pick fights, and cause chaos across two eras.
store.about:
You were born the only son of the richest man around, living in mansions, driving supercars, and flying on private jets—until your dad suddenly freezes your black card and forces you to go back to school. But after an unexpected accident, you find yourself thrown from the modern city into a strange medieval world. No money, no status, and none of the comforts you're used to. A spoiled rich kid who's never had to struggle must now figure out how to survive.

Freely explore two completely different worlds: a modern city and the Middle Ages. Travel from luxurious mansions and city streets to villages, forests, snowy mountains, and castles. As the story progresses, you'll unlock new areas, meet new characters, and encounter all kinds of events. Each era offers its own atmosphere, quests, side stories, and random encounters waiting to be discovered.

Built with UE5, the game delivers a realistic and freely explorable open world. Explore modern mansions and city streets, medieval villages, forests, snowy mountains, and more. Rich environmental detail, natural landscapes, and dynamic lighting bring two completely different eras to life.

The freedom you know from the Return to Campus series is back. Drive around, interact with NPCs, start fights, steal whatever you can get your hands on, pee wherever you want... You can follow the story and seriously search for a way home, or forget about being normal and cause chaos across both the modern and medieval worlds. The series' absurd, over-the-top comedy is back—and this time, things get even crazier.

store.name: Mirrorbane
store.short: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy world with atmospheric pixel art. Recruit unique heroes, combine their cards into a single deck, and develop your team in town between expeditions.
store.about:
The city greets you with rain. In the dark, the windows of an old tavern glow invitingly — that's where you're headed.
Here, you can hire anyone: from a grim paladin to a gold-hungry witch. Assemble a party of five mercenaries — their personalities and quirks will shape your deck for this expeditions.

 Your party shapes your deck: each class brings its own cards, while every hero adds cards unique to them. Choose five, and the deck builds itself.

 Warriors , Rangers , and Mages fight differently, shifting positions in the formation from round to round. Shape your strategy with cards that target a single hero, an entire class, or the whole party.

 Between expeditions, you return to the city. Recruit new heroes at the Tavern , visit the Merchant for rare cards and potions, and review your collections and records in the Trophy Hall — then gear up for the next one.

 Patch up wounded heroes at the Hospital . Train those ready to grow stronger at the Arsenal : training boosts their stats and unlocks a Talent card or a unique relic.

 Every hero's personality affects the choices available to them. Some turn out to be strokes of luck. Others... not so much.
 Bring a different lineup, and you'll face different choices.

 Face off against another player in tactical, turn-based combat. Outbid your opponent for the heroes you want in a real-time auction before the fight even begins.

 One party, one deck. Control up to five heroes with a single shared deck — no separate hand for each character.

 Cards for heroes and the whole party. Target a single hero, an entire class, or your...

store.name: Zudon
store.short: A high-octane arcade puzzle game with competitive PvP and solo puzzle modes. Slide with clear eyes, a full heart and try not to get posted on.
store.about:
Zudon is a sliding-block puzzle game that lets you slide against your friends. Navigate your blocks around complex maps, trying to solve as quickly and cleanly as you can.

 Online multiplayer pits player against player in a race to solve procedurally generated puzzles.
 Puzzle mode offers a more laid-back experience with dozens of hand-made puzzles of increasingly difficulty.
 Solo mode allows you to hone your skills and the Map Maker lets you design multiplayer maps of your own.

store.name: Crossfire
store.short: Layla and Cross are two opposing operators, divided by ideology but united in a fragile alliance against a threat neither can survive alone. Tactical freedom meets grounded combat in a narrative-driven cinematic action-adventure.
store.about:
Layla, a gun-for-hire, is on a reconnaissance contract in the Atlas Mountains that quickly devolves into a harrowing struggle she cannot overcome alone. Cross is an opposing operator, trained, lethal, and the last person Layla would choose to trust. But trust isn't the point. Making it out alive is. Fighting for survival and their own humanity, the pair's fraught alliance is the only chance at overcoming the existential threat ahead. 

 GRIPPING CINEMATIC NARRATIVE 
 Experience the journey of Layla and Cross, two opposing operators fighting for survival and their own humanity in a fraught but temporary alliance.

 COVER-BASED SHOOTING EVOLVED 
 Survey your surroundings and dynamically maintain cover with Adaptive Cover, our transformative new cover system. Stealth, engage, reposition, and flank. Together with Cross, use the terrain to outthink, outmaneuver, and overcome your enemies. With Adaptive Cover, the harsh terrain is another weapon in your arsenal.

 HIGH TENSION COMBAT 
 At any moment, a single bullet could prove lethal. Mastering and refining your tactical approach is your key to survival.

 A CINEMATIC LANDSCAPE 
 Experience the harsh, beautiful Atlas Mountains with a genre-defining traversal system. Use the world around you to endure the threats ahead.

store.name: Creative Aquarium
store.short: What if your doodles could come to life on your desktop? Creative Aquarium is a relaxing idle desktop game where every fish you draw becomes a unique companion. Name your creations, decorate your tank, discover fish made by other players, and build an underwater world of your own.
store.about:
Turn inspiration into fish, and let a one-of-a-kind ocean grow across your desktop. 
 Creative Aquarium is an imaginative idle desktop game. Every fish you draw comes to life with its own lines and colors, then swims freely around your aquarium.
 Keep it in a favorite corner of your desktop and let the fish quietly accompany you while you work, study, or rest. Whenever you feel like joining in, draw a new fish, decorate the scenery, or explore the wonderful underwater worlds created by other players.
 The creativity here comes from every player, and every unexpected idea eventually flows into an aquarium with a style all its own.
   🎮Join the Community and Bring This Ocean to Life 

 Look forward to themed fish-drawing challenges, community choice showcases, aquarium decorating contests, and many more community events. Follow the Steam Community and official in-game announcements for event details and participation rules.
   🎮Draw a Fish and Bring Your Doodle to Life 

 You do not need professional drawing skills, and you do not have to chase perfection. Draw the fish in your imagination, give it a name, and watch every wobbly, charmingly strange, or unexpectedly beautiful shape start moving and swim into the aquarium.
 You are leaving behind more than a picture. You are creating a life that keeps on swimming.

   🎮Keep an Underwater World on Your Desktop 

 Place the aquarium wherever you like on your desktop and let the fish swim freely while you stay busy. It can be a peaceful piece of desktop scenery, or a tiny world where you can feed your fish, observe them, and...

store.name: Baby Peak
store.short: Baby Peak is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer platform game where four babies race at the same time, and where reflexes and strategy collide. Your goal is simple: jump, climb, sabotage your rivals, and be the first to reach the golden pacifier. Explore the party modes and different levels.
store.about:
BABY PEAK: Who is Faster? 
 Are you ready for the ultimate baby breakout? BABY PEAK is a chaos-filled, competitive platform-racing game where four players clash at once. You can play solo, or with two or three players. The goal is simple but tough to achieve: grab the shining Golden Pacifier at the very top of the course!

 But this journey to the peak isn't just about jumping. You need to use all the "baby ammo" at your disposal to knock your friends out of the running!

 MAIN FEATURES 
 🥛 Milk Wars & Baby Bottle Tactics: Throw milk at your rivals with a bottle, slow them down, or knock them off with a baby shockwave. Strategic attacks matter more than pure skill!
 🏆 Race to the Peak for the Golden Pacifier: Climb vertically designed platforms that get harder with every stage. One mistake can send you right back to the start!
 💥 Chaotic Physics & Comedy: Thanks to physics-based gameplay, every fall and collision leads to laugh-out-loud moments. Manipulate your opponents using the babies' clumsy movements and special abilities.
 👥 Online Multiplayer or Solo: Battle it out alone or with up to 4 friends. Show your rivals who the "biggest baby" really is.
 ⚡ Fast Matches, Endless Fun: The action never stops with easy-to-learn, hard-to-master mechanics.
 👑 Levels: 10 different competitive levels + 3 different party modes.

 PARTY MODES 
 🍼 Bottle Battle: Whoever grabs the bottle wins, but watch out—the other players will try to take it from you.
 ⚡ Candy Race: The one who collects the most candy wins. Don't grab the wrong ones, and you'd better stay away from the...

store.name: Dear President
store.short: Ruling a country is easy; surviving is the hard part. Use your stamp to balance the state's four main powers, manage bizarre crises, and avoid assassinations. Every death is a new beginning. Upgrade your skills, sit back at the desk, and try not to get hit by a rock. Permission to panic: Granted.
store.about:
"Congratulations, Mr. President. Welcome to your office." 
 In this dark, satirical roguelite strategy game, you take the seat as the leader of a dystopian regime. Your only weapon is your stamp. Every day, your desk is piled high with documents full of absurd, dangerous, and moral dilemmas; the choice is yours. But remember: in bureaucracy, every choice has a price.
 Your Choice, The Nation's Price 

 Will you raise salaries to stop the brain drain, or import cheap labor from abroad? Every document throws you into a moral and economic dilemma. Slam your stamp down and face the devastating consequences your decisions have on the People, the Economy, the Media, or the Military.
 If the phone rings, answer it... Not that you have a choice! 

 You’re not just stamping papers at your desk. Answer incoming calls, strike secret deals, or get dragged into dark conspiracies. Every phone conversation brings you one step closer to your inevitable fate.
 Your End is Approaching 

 Your choices can't please everyone. When you upset the delicate balance and anger the wrong people, you'll hear those cold footsteps echoing toward your office. The end of your regime might come through a roaring riot in the streets, or a silent visitor walking right up to your desk.
 Learn from Death... Upgrade Your Skills! 
 Every death at the desk is just a preparation for your next regime. Use the skill tree between runs to unlock permanent upgrades and secure your path to the grand finale. And these investments aren't just boring stats; for instance, an upgraded bodyguard doesn't just stand behind you...

store.name: Shark Mart
store.short: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...
store.about:
SHARKS UNDERCOVER 

 You and your friends are sharks masquerading as dolphins to dupe and snatch the clueless fish who wander into your shop. Keep up the act and don't let those teeth show!
 MANAGE YOUR SHOP 

 Stock the shelves with sponges and bottled water, serve the locals, and keep the place spotless. Work your fins off to earn their trust - it’s the perfect cover for your shady business on the ocean floor!
 GIVE WHALES A GLOW-UP 

 Win the trust of the ocean’s behemoths by buffing their bellies and fins until they sparkle. Gaining whale loyalty is your ticket to winning over the smaller fry!
 THE PREDATOR'S SECRET KITCHEN 

 Snatch your own customers and turn them into gourmet delicacies in the hidden basement beneath your shop. Your shop is the bait, and they’re the main course!
 THE FISH POLICE ARE WATCHING 

 Underwater cops are on your tail! Scrub the crime scene, lie through your teeth during interrogations, and don’t let the fuzz catch a whiff of what’s cooking in your kitchen.

store.name: Finals Week ✍🏻
store.short: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.
store.about:
Throw away the Student Handbook. It's the final week of exams and you and your friends didn't study. Dig deep into your arsenal of cheating tools and do whatever it takes to graduate!
 IT'S FINALS WEEK! 
 Survive a series of increasingly difficult exams while eluding a strict teacher patrolling the classroom.
 To succeed, you'll have to work together with your friends: you pass together or fail together.

 STEAL ANSWERS AND SHARE THEM WITH THE SQUAD 
 There are other students who actually studied. Peek at their answers or knock them out if they don't feel like sharing.
 Find textbooks and pass them around. Use walkie-talkies, cellphones, binoculars, and other tools to find and share answers with your buddies.

 DON'T. GET. CAUGHT. 
 Cheat around and find out. Various restraints await misbehaving students. Yes, even a Cone of Shame.
 And watch out for the teacher - he throws erasers with suspiciously deadly accuracy.

 DRAW ON EVERYTHING! 
 Write down answers and pass them around on sheets of paper. Or just write them on the wall... or your friends' faces.
 The world is your canvas!

 HANG OUT IN THE HALL 
 Between exams, the hall is your hangout spot.
 Play basketball, throw baseballs, decorate statues, and devise your next cheating strategy.

 TOO COOL FOR SCHOOL 
 Cheating is temporary. Drip is forever.
 Pass exams to unlock new outfits and accessories for your character. Make sure everyone knows who carried the group.

store.name: Slice of Fortune
store.short: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Upgrade your blade to make it bigger and sharper than ever, slice every fruit in existence, and sell their juice through the Pachinko shop to grow richer and unlock powerful upgrades through the Skill Tree.
store.about:
Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Upgrade your blade to make it bigger and sharper than ever, slice every fruit in existence, and sell their juice through the Pachinko shop to grow richer and unlock powerful upgrades through the Skill Tree.
 Slice juicy fruits in a Samurai way 

 Build your thriving Pachinko shop 

 Upgrades

store.name: Cielle is Not Happy
store.short: Cielle is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG in which you play as a girl named Cielle, who encounters erratic events throughout her journey, leading her to uncover cryptic secrets about herself and the world around her.
store.about:
Tales of Judgement
 A sick girl lives in a world beyond meaning, seeing things no one else can. To encounter Judge Nothing, she must converse with its people, decipher its mysteries, and do the work of the Archons, while monsters from the House of Eyes begin to emerge.
 Control your emotions. Face your trauma, depression, and stress. Fall in love. And uncover the truth about yourself and the world you live in.

 A World of Deceit
 Live in a world consumed by corruption, political deception, and economic manipulation and carve your way through the corruption to reach your ultimate goal.

 The Hungry Eyes
 Chain of Eyes allows you to land heavy attacks with a moderate chance. Logic is used to analyze enemies, thoughts, and weaknesses, while Concentrate increases the power of your attacks and abilities. Fight them, and watch your eyes carefully, for they are desperately needed.

 The Lives We Carry
 Talk to each character and learn about their lives. Then, delve into your own mind and life, confronting your inner struggles and hardships.

 A Story, Written by Dana Khedri or The Great Pineapple (Tegep)
 Dana Khedri (The Great Pineapple) is the writer of this game's story.

 It's Always Legacy First.

store.name: Vibe Train
store.short: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.
store.about:
This game is incompatible with Steam Deck!
 Welcome aboard Vibe Train! Build your own train and send it through a beautiful pixel world along the bottom of your screen. Choose a destination, arrange your cars, and let the journey unfold while you work, study, or relax. Earn Ignicores along the way to expand and customize your train!

 Choose a destination and send your train through a colorful, side-scrolling pixel world. Switch between three compact widget views to keep your train in view without crowding your desktop.

 Trade goods between regions and take on freight orders. Load up your cargo cars and earn Ignicores!

 Add farm cars and turn your train into a garden on rails. Plant seeds and harvest a variety of crops as you travel.

 Carry travelers between stations and earn fares along the way. Plan your route around passenger demand and fill your cars with travelers.

 Research new engines and cars through the tech tree, then craft and equip modifications to improve your train. Develop the regions you visit, reach milestones, and fill out the encyclopedia in your Journal. There’s more to discover with every journey.

store.name: Swords of Legends
store.short: Swords of Legends is a single-player action-adventure RPG set in the primordial age, a world drawn from the strange tales of classical Chinese literature, where mortals, gods, and wandering souls walk the same earth.
store.about:
Swords of Legends is a single-player action-adventure RPG set in the primordial age, a world drawn from the strange tales of classical Chinese literature, where mortals, gods, and wandering souls walk the same earth. 
 From Aurogon Shanghai, this is the official sequel to the Gujian series, carrying its signature storytelling and artistry to a new adventure.

 As an Arbiter of the Underworld, you can unleash mystical techniques, summon spirit creatures, and wield an arsenal of weapons — each with its own playstyle, from the swords of the living to the artifacts of the dead.
 Read your enemies' weakness, weave your powers, and bring down all who cross your path.

 Step into a world born of ancient Chinese myth, where the gods, demons, and beasts of The Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing) walk the earth once more - rendered in cinematic detail on Unreal Engine 5.
 Lotus ponds at first light, weathered temples drifting with leaves, lonely inns glowing in the mountains. Flower-spirits, headless ghosts, beauties with painted skin — alive down to the last brushstroke, all bound into a tale that spans the mortal realm and the underworld.

 Not every soul wants to leave. Some still cling to a final wish. Defeat them. Hear them out. Lay their burdens to rest — and the spirit you once fought will walk beside you, bringing a story, a power, and a voice all their own.
 Their tales are mirrors. The longer you walk together, the more of their past comes to light. Each one is a question for your own road: what kind of life do you want to live?

 About Aurogon Shanghai 
 A...

store.name: Arknights: Endfield
store.short: Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG from Gryphline. You will take on the role of the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, explore Talos-II, and defend and expand the frontiers of human civilization.
store.about:
Endministrator, Welcome to Talos-II!
 Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG from Gryphline. 
 On the planet [Talos-II], visitors to this world, the earliest settlers, braved wars and disasters. Through over 150 years of relentless effort, they rebuilt a foundation for humanity: the [Civilization Band]. 
 Yet most of this world remains untamed. Vast wildlands and uninhabited territories stretching toward the horizon still await exploration. The shadows of the past still linger, while new threats have quietly emerged. 
 As the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, use AIC Factory technologies and collaborate with your operators to build and expand a new homeland for humanity.

 Explore Talos-II, Build a New Homeland
 Venture into the soaring peaks and snaking waterways of Talos-II, where discoveries lie at every turn. Neutralize Ankhor threats, purify the Blight, overcome crises through exploration, and continue AIC construction to bring prosperity back to this land.

 Meet Operators, Journey Together
 No one stands alone. As you explore Talos-II, you'll meet operators with distinct personalities. Work alongside them to build a new home for humanity.

 Unleash Your Creativity, Build an AIC Factory
 Take control of Endfield Industries' versatile facilities. Follow existing production layouts or devise your own sophisticated, highly efficient automated production lines. Let your industrial capacity power every exploration and battle. Savor the joy of building from scratch.

 Coordinate Combos, Fight Side by Side
 Lead your team into battle, moving them freely and...

store.name: Inside Job
store.short: Escape prison in co-op with 1–4 players – or survive LAST COUNT with up to 10: no teams, deadly games, only one walks out. Work the inmates, trade, gamble, and pick your moment.
store.about:
NOBODY TELLS YOU HOW TO GET OUT OF HERE. THAT'S THE WHOLE PROBLEM.
 You're an inmate. So are your friends. There is no briefing, no marker on
 a map, no voice in your ear. There is a prison that runs like clockwork -
 and somewhere in that clockwork, a mistake nobody has made yet.
 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 READ THE ROUTINE 
 Cell, yard, chow hall, headcount. This place moves on a schedule and it
 does not care about yours. Learn where you're supposed to be, and you'll
 start noticing all the places you're not.

 NOTHING IN HERE IS A TOOL YET
 Everything you need is already inside these walls, disguised as something
 harmless. Finding it is the easy part. Keeping it - through every cell
 search, with nowhere to put it - is not.

 EVERYONE IN HERE HAS A STORY 
 The other inmates live their own day: they eat, gamble, talk and sleep on
 the same schedule you do. Talk to them and most will tell you why they're
 in. A few know more - and they'll tell you, if you've got something they
 want.

 BLACKJACK FOR CIGARETTES 
 In here, cigarettes are money - and money buys what you won't find lying
 around. Pull up a stool, match the stake and play the other inmates for
 their last pack. Over 21, you're out. Ace and ten on the deal, and the
 pot is yours.

 YOU'RE NOT WALKING OUT DRESSED LIKE THIS 
 Past a certain point, the prison stops asking what you're doing and starts
 asking who you are. Being somewhere you don't belong is a problem. Looking
 like you don't belong is a much bigger one.

 SOME HOURS ARE NOT YOURS 
 The prison is never empty, only quieter. Flashlight beams...

store.name: RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign
store.short: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by Dan Fournie and originally published in C3i magazine. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.
store.about:
In RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign, take command of either the Roman or Carthaginian armies in 211 BC. The Baetis Campaign pitted two Roman brothers, Publius Scipio and Gnaeus Scipio, against Hasdrubal Barca and Mago Barca, Carthaginian brothers of Hannibal.

 RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign features gameplay based on the historical wargaming boardgames of the 70's and 80's. Players maneuver markers that represent their units on a hexagonal map that mimics the gameboard and cardboard counters of traditional boardgames. During movement, each player alternates moving a single unit at a time until one player passes.   Once that happens, a random number of unopposed actions are given to their opponent. Pass too early and you risk giving your opponent the opportunity to maneuver completely around your forces. Combat is resolved through die rolls modified by terrain, supporting units, and whether or not cavalry will be able to support with a charge.

 Victory Points are awarded for eliminating units or commanders, and for capturing towns or camps belonging to your opponent. 
 The Carthaginians have the opportunity to bribe mercenary forces hired by the Romans. Bribed forces will abandon the Roman side during the night phases.  Carthage also has a powerful unit, Indibilis, who arrives from a secret entry hex in Turn 3, forcing the Roman player to guard against three possible entry points.

 Key Features 

 Command your units in an historically accurate representation of battle during the Punic Wars. 

 Maneuver to try and pin your opponent's forces, while keeping your own free to act. ...

store.name: 10 Million Pixels
store.short: Mine millions of pixels in search of the one Golden Pixel by shooting bouncing balls.
store.about:
An incremental game about mining pixels in search of the one Golden Pixel. 

 Shoot balls to mine pixels. Use the mined pixels as a currency to shoot more balls. Explore the procedurally generated environment to find special upgrade-pixels that can be used for unlocking new balls and upgrading their unique ball-abilities. Dig out hidden objects and find the Golden Pixel, hidden somewhere among the 10 million pixels.

 Features
 Uncover A Huge World : Explore a huge world of 10 million mineable pixels. (For reference, the world is 1000x bigger than the what you see in the GIF above)

 Handcrafted & Procedural : The procedurally generated mineable environment makes every play through unique. Hidden inside the world you will find solid objects that have been carefully handcrafted.

 7 Balls With Unique Abilities : Each ball color has a unique ability. The Blue Directional Ball only goes in a straight vertical or horizontal line. The Red Smash Ball hits pixels in a surrounding area upon impact. The Green Poison Ball poisons pixels upon impact, and will erode the pixels over time while spreading to nearby pixels. And more! 

 Balls Go Brrrr! : The game physics supports thousands of balls, simultaneously bouncing around and breaking pixels, at a stable 60+ FPS frame rate. 

 Music by Pulsewith: An amazing soundtrack by Pulsewith (Justin Skomarovsky) who previously made the music for The Loopler.

store.name: NGL Biathlon 2027
store.short: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon simulator. Race as your favourite athlete, develop them in a career from junior to the Big Crystal Globe, build your own tournaments and take on real players online. Every discipline, relays included, and 15 tracks
store.about:
NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon simulator. Race as your favourite athlete and fight for the Big Crystal Globe
 Athletes and tracks: a large roster of athletes, 15 tracks and every biathlon discipline
 Career: many seasons, from a junior in the lowest league to the fight for the globe
 Your own tournaments: you choose the tracks and races
 Your own athlete: face, suit, skis, rifle and other gear
 Online: real players, rooms of up to 21, ratings and tournaments
 Broadcast mode: the race runs by itself while you switch cameras
 Atmosphere: spectators along the course, finish-line celebrations and award ceremonies

 We put serious work into the terrain and physics, so athletes now move along the course far more realistically. Tactics and pacing matter even more than before, while the game balance has stayed the same

 Get behind a rival and you ski at their pace while saving energy, then spend what you saved on a surge closer to the finish. Bots do the same: they tuck in behind you too, and you can shake them off with a boost

 We skied every track ourselves, and the recorded path became the bots' line. They take the short way through corners, hold their rows, overtake and decide for themselves when to speed up by watching their energy

 If you are clearly in the lead, you can take a flag from a fan on the last lap and carry it to the finish. Bots do it too, and in career mode the flag earns you money

 We redrew the menus and race screens from scratch: tables, banners, the start list

 Soldier Hollow in the USA and Canmore in Canada

 The season follows a World Cup calendar....

store.name: Arcade & Motel Simulator Together
store.short: Run a neon-lit roadside motel with an arcade next door. Haggle with guests, play 13 fully playable arcade games, open a bowling alley, cook burgers, hire staff and run it all from your retro tablet, solo or in online co-op with voice chat for up to 4 players.
store.about:
A MOTEL, AN ARCADE AND A LONG NIGHT AHEAD
 Create your character, take over a roadside motel with a neon arcade next door and turn it into the stop everyone remembers. Rent out rooms, fill the hall with cabinets, feed the players, hire a crew and grow your business night after night, alone or with friends.

 RUN THE MOTEL

 Greet guests at the front desk, haggle over the price of a night and hand over the key. Clean up after they check out, watch your reviews and star rating, and upgrade your rooms from bare Economy to Standard and Deluxe. As the motel grows, open the Roadside Wing, fix the broken stairs and bring the whole upper floor back to life, room by room.

 13 ARCADE GAMES YOU CAN ACTUALLY PLAY

 Every machine in your hall is a real game you can step up to and play:
 Video cabinets: the retro 3D racer Turbo Rush , the motorcycle racer Moto Rush , the snake battle Snake , the endless runner Neon Dash , the delivery chaos of Pizza Rush , the light-gun shooter Motel Guardian and the dance machine Step Fever 

 Sports and tables: Hoop Shot basketball, Air Hockey , 8-ball Billiards and the Haymaker boxing machine

 Head-to-head duels: the two-player whack-a-mole Mole Duel and the two-lane ball roller Roll Rivals . Nobody plays these alone: sit down and a customer takes you on, or call a friend over in co-op
 And when the hall gets too small, open your own Bowling Alley : take the bowlers' money at the shoe counter, send them to a free lane, add new lanes as you grow and roll a few frames yourself.
 Customers drop in to play too. Collect the tokens, complete each game's...

store.name: Guild Wars 3™
store.short: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.
store.about:
Become a Vaelwarden, a guardian of the land of Orr, protector of the people and spirits that call Orr home. Discover untold stories and forge lasting bonds with your fellow players as you glide, leap, sprint, and ride your way across a frontier with adventure around every corner.

 A Modern Evolution of the MMO
 Master a combat system where depth is achieved through strategic skill use, positioning, and movement – where action RPG combat meets Guild Wars build-making – creating a unique combat experience.

 Run, slide, leap, and bound across Orr with a one-of-a-kind movement system that transfers your momentum between modes of travel, providing a free-form joy of movement through a world alive with adventure.

store.name: Kings of Oros
store.short: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.
store.about:
A NEW KIND OF AUTOBATTLER: 
Kings of Oros is a mashup of Roguelike Autobattlers, and Roguelike Physics games. The goal was to combine the exciting watchability of bouncing plinko balls or battling marbles with deep player agency and build craft. Theorycraft your way through hordes of enemies and send your build into the ether to battle against other players online. Clutch battles will keep you on the edge of your seat! 

 BUILD CRAFT: 
 Combine weapons, relics, cards, blessings, enchantments, and more, to enable powerful synergies and builds. The physics battle system provides unique opportunities for builds, like fast spinning dual wield daggers, or giant warhammers that grow larger with each kill! 

 HARNESS ELEMENTAL POWERS: 
 Shock enemies with lightning. Freeze and shatter your foes. Root, burn, bleed or spread poisonous plagues as you fight through increasingly difficult battles. 

 ENDLESS COMBINATIONS: 
 Hunt through hundreds of unique items. Equip your stones with weapons and relics. Visit specialized shops. Forge weapons together to acquire powerful enchantments and legendary items. Purchase and upgrade powerful blessing stones to create crazy synergies.  

 CONTROL THE TEMPO OF BATTLE: 
 Equip cards to add rhythm to your strategy, unleashing timely spins, volleys of projectiles, giant growing weapons, aoe explosions and more. Curate, upgrade, and enchant your deck to get the upper hand against other players. Special classes, blessings and equipment can supercharge your cards or interact with them in unique ways. 

 CLASSES OF OROS:

store.name: Steal & Sell Simulator
store.short: Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.
store.about:
Steal. Sell. Expand. Don't Get Caught.
 Steal valuable items at night, then run your shop during the day and sell your loot. 
 Sneak into warehouses and other interesting places. Pick locks, bypass security systems, and search every corner for valuable loot before time runs out. Your inventory is limited, so every theft becomes a choice - grab the most valuable items.   Every mistake can attract guards, trigger alarms, and turn a perfect theft into a desperate escape.

 At your shop, every stolen item becomes profit. Use the money you earn to upgrade your setup, improve daily operations, and unlock access to new locations and opportunities. 

 Fill your shelves with rare finds, and keep suspicious visitors distracted - sometimes with nothing more than a fresh donut.

 As your business grows, so do the opportunities. Unlock new districts, tackle increasingly dangerous locations, hire skilled thieves, and discover valuable tips from local contacts. 
 Features
 Steal valuable goods from a variety of locations.

 Pick locks, crack safes, and bypass security.

 Steal valuable loot before time runs out.

 Escape guards, cameras, and alarms.

 Sell stolen goods in your own shop.

 Hire thieves and send them on heists.

 Unlock new locations with greater risks and rewards.

 Upgrade your shop and your business.

store.name: Lords of the Fallen II
store.short: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.
store.about:
A thousand years have passed since the Great Rupture. 

Realm by realm, nation after nation, the Umbral darkness has consumed all in her path. One Kingdom remains - a sacred land shrouded by an ancient force. For a time, mankind found sanctuary in this haven, but as light fades, darkness rises, and now, the Eternal Night draws near. 

A hero must rise, for a God to fall.

Journey across a vast, war-torn kingdom crumbling from within, as the realms of living and dead bleed into one. From moonlit citadels to time-ravaged temples, tread carefully, for each step forward may well be your last. 

Engage in intense, soulslike battles where every strike counts thanks to a fast, fluid and aggressive combat system. Whether steel or sorcery, melee or ranged, experiment with countless builds to overcome each unique enemy encounter before delivering an arena-drenching execution. 

Confront colossal abominations forged in a world without hope and void of mercy. Each distinct boss battle showdown will prove a gruelling test of skill, grit, and will. Though aid is at hand, should you seek it…

As bearer of the Umbral lamp, you have the ability to pass between the realms of the living and the dead, each with its own pathways, treasures, and of course, nightmarish creatures. But even greater, darker powers await you on this journey… 

Journey through Thorngar alone or alongside a fellow Lampbearer in seamless online co-op. Both players will save all mainline progression in shared campaign mode, or join a casual session to simply lend a fellow crusader a helping hand.

store.name: Carry On Together
store.short: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?
store.about:
Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players.
 Start a small delivery company with your friends, take on moving jobs and try to get every item to its destination in one piece. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?
 LIFT TOGETHER 
 Some items are too heavy to carry alone. Stretch out your arms, sync up with your teammates and lift together with physics-based controls. Couches, fridges, pianos and giant boxes all need teamwork. Watch out for tight corridors, slippery stairs and that one friend who lets go at the worst possible moment.

 DRIVE THE TRUCK 
 Load the delivery truck, pick a driver and hit the road. Enjoy the view on the way, but stay alert: one sharp turn and the whole cargo flies. The road might be the most dangerous part of the job. Do you trust your driver?

 EVERY LOCATION IS A NEW DISASTER 
 From suburban houses with wide gardens to multi-story office buildings, from narrow apartment hallways to mountain dirt roads, every location brings its own kind of chaos. Fit the sofa in the elevator, roll the rock off the road, squeeze the wardrobe through the garden gate.

 GROW YOUR COMPANY 
 Every successful delivery earns money, and every broken item costs you. Upgrade your company, take on bigger jobs and prove you're the best (or worst) movers in town.
