store.name: GUNBOAT-8
store.short: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.
store.about:
Arm the GUNBOAT-8 and set sail in this naval bullet-heaven roguelike. Destroy enemy ships, claim their bounties, and discover new weapon synergies to customise your warpship.

 Find epic loot to power up your ship!

 Spend scraps to build the ideal warship.

 Features
 Captain a ship: battle waves of enemies to find loot and earn rewards. Your ship attacks for you, so you just need to focus on steering!

 Discover crazy builds:  find weapons, runes and modifications to create epic combinations. Merge weapons together to construct higher tiers.

 Conquer the seas : traverse real-world environments as you attempt to conquer the oceans, facing a variety of bosses along the way.

 Recruit allies: recruit bosses you defeat to fight alongside you. From Blackbeard to aircraft carriers!

 In GUNBOAT-8 you battle waves on enemies to earn money. Money can be spent in the shop to equip new weapons and modifiers, or you can enhance your existing weapons with unique runes that change the feel of each weapon. Design around your playstyle. Want to captain the mightiest pirate ship on the seas, or would you prefer to outsource your weaponry to an army of sharks?

store.name: STATE Z
store.short: Build your own base, hunt , cook ,upgrade your equipment and your character , gather resources, farm, maintain vehicles, trade with communities, complete tasks in exchange for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.
store.about:
State Z is a post-apocalyptic open-world survival game where you'll have to survive threats from human NPCs, zombies, other players, and your own needs, all within a 64 km² map with 100% exploration. Build your own base, hunt, gather resources, cultivate a farm, maintain vehicles, and trade with communities for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.
 Key Features

 64 km² of map with no empty spaces — everything was created by hand, ensuring that no two maps are alike.

 Everything has consequences. A simple search for supplements can turn into a disaster if you aren't prepared. 

 Make sure to take shelter in a safe place before leaving the game, as you remain in the game world even after you have disconnected.

 Trade with NPCs — everything can be bought or sold, but everything has its price. Short on cash? No problem: take on quests from NPCs to earn some extra coin.

 Accessibility — it’s all in your hands. Your game, your rules. Decide how you want to play State Z; adjust the settings at any time and play your way.

 (default option: no hit points and no health bar) — with or without a health bar, with or without damage points... the choice is yours.

 Save your progress at any time. You can use as many save slots as you like—after all, who hasn't saved their game before exploring a difficult area?

 Every action counts. Increase your experience level and improve your character. Whether it’s a simple gathering task or a major expedition into a bandit camp, you will earn XP.

 Extreme weather...

store.name: Shanhai Phantasm
store.short: 《山海幻境：无限篇》是一款像素风卡牌RPG游戏，融合了三消特色玩法，放置挂机收益稳定，主打一个白嫖很舒服，微氪会更爽！上班摸鱼很爽，下班放空也很爽！登录直接百抽，每周8张自选英雄保底，所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，一起来沉浸体验探索山海神话的快感吧！

store.name: YuanRong
store.short: "Ten great war-chariots lead the vanguard." — Shijing 2D turn-based tactical RPG. Four cultural origins, procedurally generated continents, individual soldier recruitment and training, chain-of-command formations, hex-grid combat, fight outnumbered.
store.about:
"Ten great war-chariots lead the vanguard." — Shijing (Classic of Poetry)
 Yuanrong: Princeps Militum is a 2D turn-based tactical RPG. Choose a cultural origin, lead a company across a generated continent, visit settlements, take contracts, recruit and organize troops, and deploy on hex-grid battlefields.
 Mountains and rivers differ, recruitment stocks vary, battlefields hold unique conditions, and victories and defeats leave ripples. Your path, your soldiers, and your army are forged through every march and battle.

 Landscapes shaped by seeds 
 Every new game generates a continent from a seed. Coastlines, mountains, lakes, passes, regions, and settlements appear anew, altering marching routes with the terrain.
 Travel, scout, pursue enemies, and visit towns on the strategic map. Shortcuts may lead through dangerous terrain, while detours cost time and rations; survey the land before deciding your route.

 Diverse cultures, distinct doctrines 
 Central Plains, Steppe, West, and Desert cultures feature unique troops, formation templates, and tactics. Central Plains favor mutually supporting lines; Steppe relies on horse archery and swift charges; West uses shield lines and heavy armor to break enemy lines; Desert combines protective formations, ranged pressure, and fire attacks.
 Culture is not mere cosmetics. Recruits, available formations, enemy composition, and tactical tendencies all stem from their origin.

 Settlements have their purposes 
 Settlements are places to rest during travels. Enter towns to visit taverns, markets, recruitment offices, and notice boards to...

store.name: Goddle
store.short: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.
store.about:
Construct words from a grid of letters and score more points than friends and family! Grab your phone, find the words nobody else sees, and mix many languages and custom dictionaries all at once.
 Your phone is the controller

 The grid, scores, and timer live on the big screen. Everyone else plays on the phone already in their pocket: no extra controllers, no app store, no remote mouse, just a PC and some good old web browsers. Just type words from adjacent letters and hit send.

 Play with as many friends as you can gather.*

 *Only managed 9 friends and family so far. Apparently I'm not that popular. Be better than me. 
 Strategy?

 Do you prefer finding lots of small words? One massive word for a huge cashout? Sitting on your hands until the last ten seconds to drop a bomb? Snatching a plural from your friend's singular the moment they submit it?
 Play how you like... and argue about it afterwards!
 Six game modes, and counting

 Some reward speed. Some reward patience. Some reward hunting the letters everyone else is ignoring.

 Classic  - Find words with letters. That's it. That's the mode.

 Replace Letters  - Used letters get swapped out, so the grid never stops moving.

 Shared Words  - Words can be reused by different players. Great for playing with kids.

 Rising Letters  - Unused letters grow in value over time. Ignore that Q at your peril.

 Battle of Territory  - Claim letters by using them and score every second for the ground you hold.

 Hot Tile  - One glowing tile multiplies your score. Work it into a word before it moves.

 Any language. Any dictionary....

store.name: Chinese Pancake Simulator
store.short: Run a tiny pancake stall beneath an overpass. Cook every order by hand, crack the eggs, add the toppings, give the right change, and work toward achieving your life dreams.
store.about:
Chinese Pancake Simulator is a first-person cooking and business simulation game.
 At a humble stall beneath an overpass, buy ingredients, cook pancakes, serve customers, and gradually grow your business. Upgrade your equipment, decorate your stall, unlock new ingredients, and work toward achieving your dreams.

 Buy Ingredients

 Purchase batter, eggs, vegetables, meat, and other ingredients to get ready for business.

 Set Up Your Stall

 Arrange equipment and utensils, organize your workspace, and make your stall more efficient.

 Make Pancakes

 Spread the batter, crack eggs, add toppings, and cook steaming hot pancakes to order.

 Clean Up

 Clean your equipment and workspace between business hours to keep your stall tidy.

 Unlock New Equipment and Ingredients

 Unlock higher-tier licenses as you sell more pancakes. Purchase better cooking equipment and a wider variety of toppings to keep expanding your menu.

 Visit the Mysterious Vendor

 The mysterious vendor sells all kinds of unusual items that you won't find anywhere else in the market. Use these special items to give your pancake business a boost!

 An Easy-to-Pick-Up Pancake Cooking and Business Sim
 Experience the full process of running a street-side pancake stall:
 1. Buy and stock ingredients
 2. Decorate and organize your stall
 3. Cook a variety of pancakes
 4. Serve customers and give them the correct change
 5. Upgrade your cooking equipment

 This game does not include:
 1. Hiring employees or managing staff
 2. Large-scale retail management or complex store management systems

store.name: ANANTA
store.short: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.
store.about:
Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG with no rules. Step into the shoes of a diverse cast of characters and forge connections as you build a team all your own.
Join forces against the threats lurking in the shadows, or live it up and take in the nightlife under the neon glow. The choice is yours.

 Global release January 15th, 2027

In ANANTA, a whole new world awaits you. Ready to take the plunge?
 Become an Influencer and Save the World 
 You're a stranger in a strange land, but that's alright.
 The moment you set foot in Nova City,
 you start making a name for yourself.
 It's time to build your reputation, and save the world while you're at it.

 Two Cities, Two Adventures 
 Don't forget to head back home once in a while.
 One plane ticket and you're back to your old stomping grounds of Chongxiao.
 But even a place you know like the back of your hand
 is bound to have a hidden secret or two.

 Exhilarating Martial Arts Battles 
 From the second you raise your fist,
 the street becomes your stage,
 and each strike deserves to go viral.

 Experience the Thrill of 24/7 City Life 
 Boredom? Never heard of it.
 Drama that would make soap operas blush one day, 3AM street racing the next.
 No two days are the same.
 Every hour has something new on offer, and it can all be streamed anytime.

 Discover Different Walks of Life 
 NCCA officer, genius hacker, or gang leader?
 Inhabit all manner of different characters.
 Experience this world from top to bottom and everywhere in-between.
 Who knows, you may befriend some oddballs along the way.

 Unlimited Exploration

store.name: Meltdown Crew
store.short: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.
store.about:
Meltdown Crew is an online co-op game where you have to control a 1980s style nuclear reactor by using proximity voice chat and phones to communicate with your friends. You and up to 5 friends have to prevent a total meltdown while producing as much power as possible.

 WATCH OUT! 
 All objects are physics based, and fuel rods are fragile, bump into a doorway or a coworker too hard, and you’re both gone.

 MONITOR THE SITUATION 
 The reactor is under constant change, cooling needs to be adjusted, fuel rods need to be replaced and thrown out, power will cut off and fuses will blow. But keep your cool in the control room and everything will be okay (probably).

 COMMUNICATION IS KEY 
 The only way to keep the reactor stable is to work together. If you are in the control room, you can’t take action in time, so grab a phone and connect with your friends running around in the reactor.

 IMPROVE AND UPGRADE 
 Upgrade your reactor with improved fuel rods, or new equipment.

 FEATURES 
 Online co-op up to 6 players

 Immersive proximity voice chat

 Use landline phones to communicate

 Operate a nuclear reactor

 Drink beers

 Take showers with your friends

 Survive chaotic reactor failures

store.name: Resident Evil Veronica
store.short: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.
store.about:
Survive the Deranged Terror 

Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica.

This new title preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.
In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror. 3 months have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. 

Claire Redfield, having survived along with Leon S. Kennedy and Sherry Birkin, travels to France in search of her brother, Chris Redfield.

However, what awaits her is not a reunion with her brother, but the Umbrella special forces unit responsible for the incident. They capture Claire and transport her to a mysterious island.

Now Claire must make a desperate attempt to escape the remote Rockfort Island which, due to another biological disaster, has transformed into a living hellscape of survival horror.

store.name: Shanking Simulator
store.short: Fight through historical locations in shank-or-be-shanked combat. Defeat your enemies, dominate the lobby, and rise as the ultimate shanker.
store.about:
Have you ever wanted to shank your friends? (in-game)

 Well now you can!

 Shanking Simulator is a 2D platformer fighting game where you fight in multiple locations with different hazards in your way. Fight against your friends or bots locally or online with up to 8 players, collect drip clothing and master the art of shanking.

 Multiple different weapons and special abilities to learn and use.

 6 different maps to play with different hazards and platforms.

 Shanking Simulator has Steam Inventory so you can collect and trade your clothing (drip) with other people in the steam marketplace.

 Play locally on your couch or with friends worldwide with multiplayer support up to 8 players!

 Speedrun your way through various different thug trials levels with their own obstacles and beat your friends records.

 Disclaimer 
 Because of a hardcoded limitation in the Windows XInput API, only up to four XInput Xbox controllers can be connected and recognized simultaneously.
 For slots 5–8 you must use other controllers like DualShock/DualSense, DirectInput devices, or other non-XInput controllers.
 We are sorry about this inconvenience for the players who only have Xbox controllers, but there's not really much we can do about it.

store.name: THAT BOMB GAME
store.short: A hot-potato typing game for 1-12 players where you'll have to type words with the given combination of letters to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to sabotage and kill your friends, only one wins.
store.about:
A twisted game about typing and explosions up to 12 players. Only one will win.
 THAT BOMB GAME is a turn based typing game where you buy power up cards to improve your chances of winning.

 Fail to type the correct word and you will explode!
 Typing fast is not the only thing needed for this game, you have to use your brain.

 Turn everything red.
 There are red cards with special effects. Choose wisely.

store.name: Duel: The Game Show
store.short: The ultimate 1v1 show game! Step up to the podium and challenge your rival in 6, 9, 12, or 15 rounds. Master 30 varied mini-games testing your knowledge, guessing, logic, memory, and speed. Who will keep their cool, buzz in faster, and claim the ultimate victory?
store.about:
The Ultimate TV Show Feeling at Home!
 Step up to the podium and face the challenge! In this purely competitive 1v1 show game, it’s not about luck—it’s about your skills. Inspired by the great primetime TV duels, a thrilling battle of wits awaits you, where every single round counts!
 Decide for yourself how epic your duel should be: choose between a quick 6-round show, an intense 12-round match, or the full 15-round marathon experience. The point values increase with every round—meaning maximum suspense until the very last game!
 What Awaits You:
 30 Minigames: A diverse mix that will challenge you every single second. No two rounds are ever the same!

 Versatile Categories: 
 Knowledge: Show off what you’ve got in the brains department.

 Guessing: Who can get closest to the actual truth?

 Speed: Who will trigger the buzzer first?

 Memory: Keep your focus when things get chaotic.

 Logic: Spot the patterns faster than your opponent.

 Flexible Show Mode: Adjust the length of the show (6, 9, 12, or 15 rounds) to match your time and mood.

 Pure Podium Thrills: Every game demands total concentration. One wrong buzz could cost you the entire victory!

 Challenge your friends and find out once and for all who is the true champion of the podium!

store.name: Ski Lines: Trail Map
store.short: Ski Lines is a minimalist strategy game about designing a ski resort map. Draw pistes, build lifts, and connect mountain landmarks as new points of interest appear. Spend your limited resources wisely, adapt your network each day, and keep the resort moving for as long as possible.
store.about:
Ski Lines is a minimalist strategy simulation game about designing a ski resort map. 
 Draw ski runs, build lifts, and connect mountain landmarks as new points of interest appear across the slopes. Every day, more skiers arrive, new destinations open, and your resort becomes harder to keep flowing.
 Your goal is simple: keep skiers moving.

 Start with a small mountain and a handful of resources. Connect stations, summits, viewpoints, restaurants, refuges, and rescue points with the right mix of pistes and lifts. Easy runs are flexible, harder runs are more demanding, and every new connection changes the shape of your network.

 But the mountain is not just a blank canvas. Snow cannons let you expand the skiable area, while tree clearing allows you to open new routes through the forest. Upgrade your lifts, improve your tools, and choose carefully where to invest your limited resources.

 As the days pass, the resort grows busier. New points of interest appear, skiers demand better routes, and bottlenecks begin to form. Redesign your network, extend the domain, and adapt before the slopes become overwhelmed.

 Key Features
 Draw ski pistes directly on a stylized trail map.

 Build lifts to bring skiers back up the mountain.

 Connect stations, summits, restaurants, refuges, viewpoints, and more.

 Use snow cannons to expand the skiable area.

 Clear trees to open new routes through forests.

 Upgrade lifts, snow cannons, and other tools as your resort grows.

 Manage limited resources and choose your expansions wisely.

 Adapt your network as new points of interest appear...

store.name: Never Sort By Color
store.short: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.
store.about:
There is one rule of brick sorting. Everyone learns it the hard way. 

 You've inherited a workshop and a Pile that swallowed it whole. Never Sort By Color is a zen organization sim about setting it right - sorting an impossibly huge mountain of plastic bricks into a perfectly labeled workshop, one satisfying handful at a time.
 Tame the Pile
 The Pile doesn't look conquerable. That's the point. Start by picking out bricks one at a time, and grow into an unstoppable sorting machine:
 Magnet Glove - aim at a part and every loose copy rips out of the Pile and streams into your hand.

 Sorter's Eye - mark a part type and watch every instance glow through the chaos.

 Sieve Tray - scoop, shake, and let gravity sort a whole load by size in one motion.

 Bucket Sort - bind bins to hotkeys and fling bricks blind over your shoulder, pure muscle memory.

 Locators - hold up any brick and its home drawer lights up across the room.

 Buy bins, trays, and cabinet walls. Stack them into towers. Label everything. Watch the floor appear.
 Pull the parts. Watch it build.
 Instruction books lie scattered around the workshop, each one a MOC waiting for parts. Crack one open, pull its bill of materials from your perfect drawers, and watch the model build itself, brick by brick - a time-lapse of parts flying up and clicking into place, stud by stud.
 This is where your sorting pays off or bites. Honest drawers mean a full kit pulls in seconds. A contaminated drawer means the tray rejects your wrong part right in front of you.
 Finished models don't ship away - they fill your workshop. A fire...

store.name: DEEPest RESEARCH
store.short: She wants to kill the man who stole her love. To do so, she... His missing wife's phone reveals a hidden side: sweet whispers, sultry breaths, messages from strange men. Sick with anguish, the lawyer seeks the truth. But does he have secrets too? A smartphone mystery filled with forbidden desires!
store.about:
Game Overview
 The protagonist is Yuji Ichinose, a highly educated lawyer. May is a glamorous beauty of French and Japanese descent who committed attempted murder to avenge someone dear to her. Yuji sees that May is so pure-hearted and single-minded that her very sincerity could lead her down a dark path. Determined to protect her, he decides to stand by her side. Eventually, the two marry... Yuji surrounds May with a life of luxury, hoping to help her forget her desire for revenge. Just when he finally believes everything will be all right... May disappears.
 All she leaves behind is a handbag found in a hotel restroom and a locked smartphone. Desperate to find her, Yuji begins uncovering the secrets she has kept from him. Messaging apps, social media, and secret direct messages... What he discovers is a shocking side of the wife he believed to be so innocent and modest...
 Game System
 ■ Explore the Smartphone
 Freely explore the web browser, messaging apps, social media, password manager, and more. Find passwords to log in to social media accounts, access private DMs, and uncover new information.
 ■ Expand Your Investigation with Keywords
 As you explore, you may discover new "Keywords." Search for them in the browser or on social media to uncover hidden information.
 ■ Organize Clues and Draw Conclusions
 As you gather evidence and information, use the "Deduction" feature to piece together the case. Connect the clues you've collected and uncover the truth behind May's disappearance.
 ■ Credits
 Production & Scenario: Nagi Kurokawa
 Character Design & Main Graphics:...

store.name: BELTFED
store.short: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.
store.about:
BELTFED is a roguelike factory-defense game of rapid, brutal runs and absurd scale. Lay belts, wire up smelters and assemblers, and balance your power grid, turning raw ore into raw firepower. All the while a planet's worth of bugs descends upon your factory. This is automation fused with total war.
 AUTOMATE DEATH 

 The swarm arrives in the hundreds of thousands. Meet them with guns, flamethrowers, launchers, mortars, lasers, drones, mines and more - all of it fueled by your own production lines. A single run can push your kill count into the millions. Welcome to slaughter at an industrial scale.
 MASS PRODUCTION. MASS EXTINCTION. 

 Balance industry, power and security as you expand your factory and push into the fog for richer veins and rarer resources. More bugs require more bullets, and supply must keep up because demand doesn't wait. As you expand, choose from run-defining upgrade cards that shape how you play, making every factory different from the last.
 THE NEXUS MUST SURVIVE 

 The Nexus is your central intelligence and item storage. It must be defended at all costs. If your Nexus is compromised, your factory will be terminated and the run will end. Everything else is expendable. As you progress, you'll unlock new Nexus cores that change the way you play.
 THE FACTORY IS YOUR WEAPON 

 Every deployment feeds permanent progression: new weapons, new buildings, new upgrade cards, unique Nexus cores and modules. Your ever-expanding arsenal ensures every deployment is deadlier than the last. Customize your loadout before each run to tune the machine to your...

store.name: Paper Shredder
store.short: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?
store.about:
Welcome aboard! You have accepted a highly prestigious, entry-level position. Your objective is simple: clear a "minor" backlog of corporate paperwork. Achieve 100% disposal efficiency, and a cool $1,000,000 payout is yours. Don't worry about the scale of the task, management believes in you!
 Shred, Sweep, Repeat 
 Experience the intense sensory pleasure of turning tower-high piles of rigid bureaucracy into weightless confetti. Shred documents and sweep up the mess to earn company merit points. Upgrade basic tools into heavy-duty setups, skyrocketing your processing speed and document destruction.
 Mandated Morale Boosts 
 Never feel lonely on the clock! Your dedicated Happiness Manager is always watching, offering continuous, highly mandatory psychological support, and toxic positivity to keep your motivation at an optimized 100%.
 Branching Career Paths 
 Dig through paper mountains to find more than just forgotten files. Rumor says past associates couldn't bear the grind and shredded a path to freedom instead. Will you follow them?

store.name: TaskBound Saga
store.short: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 15 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, forge your gear and grow your party.
store.about:
TaskBound Saga is an idle JRPG that sits in a small window above your taskbar. Your heroes walk, fight and collect loot on their own while you work, study or watch something.

Pick your first hero and build a party of four from seven classes. The game keeps earning while it is closed.

Monsters drop chests onto the top of the window. Click a chest to open it.
 Ten gear slots per hero, ten item rarities

 Upgrade items and forge up to nine stars into them at the forge

 Merge ten items into one of a higher rarity at the altar

 Defeated monsters sometimes join you as pets

 Buy runes with gold: 92 permanent upgrades, including endless runes

 Spend skill points on each hero's constellation

 Rare Unique items with their own special effects

 All gear lives in your Steam Inventory: trade it or sell it on the Community Market

15 realms and 105 stages, each with its own monsters, chests and boss. Beat them all and climb the Endless Tower.

Every realm ends with a boss. The last one is the Game Master, who summons other bosses during the fight.

Questions, bugs or ideas? Join the TaskBound Saga Discord (link on this page).

store.name: KARAKARA3
store.short: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.
store.about:
Let us live 
 on this land so arid. 

 KARAKARA. It is the sound of aridity. It is the sound of dry asphalt and sandy winds. It is the sound of relentless sunshine, as well as the sound of a withering race. 

 The "Age of Dusk." It is a time of senescence for the human species, during which hybrids known as the "Others"—those who are human, yet not—exist in great numbers. On the windswept barrens of a land without moisture, a small gathering of people make their living in a world they no longer know. Down a stretch of highway and far from the heart of the town are two such people, Leon and Lucia, who run a small diner. Together with Aisia and newcomers Rebecca and Mari, they lean on each other to survive in this arid land. Those peaceful days come to an end when Leon hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. 

 What is it that the kidnappers seek from Leon? Will this lead to an understanding of the disaster that befell the world in the past? 

 Features: 
 Conclusion of the story from KARAKARA

 Single route kinetic novel

 Character designs by: p19

 English/ Japanese/ Chinese language options

 Full Japanese voice audio (except for the protagonist)

store.name: Ignite the Depths
store.short: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?
store.about:
Ignite the Depths is a cooperative, fast-paced dark fantasy dungeon crawler with NO forced PvP or extraction mechanics. In your quest for mythical riches, descend into the Abyss alone or with a party of treasure hunters to slay terrifying monsters lurking within maze-like dungeons
 CHOOSE YOUR CLASS 

 Master four distinct classes, each with unique abilities, weapons, and team roles. Whether you prefer to rain down a barrage of fireballs from afar, unleash a fury of your blade, or hold the frontline behind your shield, the choice is yours.
 Throughout your adventure, you will mold your character into a unique build that suits your playstyle. New classes will join the adventure as development continues.
 A HAND-CRAFTED DARK FANTASY WORLD TO DISCOVER 

 Explore a wide variety of dreamlike vistas while cutting through relentless foes. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover secret pathways filled with danger and treasure, parkour across ancient ruins, and hack and slash your way deeper into the haunting beauty of the Abyss.
 Each dimension is guarded by a powerful Lord, promising a fierce battle and a worthy reward.
 DESCENT INTO THE ABYSS TOGETHER 

 While every hero is fully playable solo, each class is designed with deep co-op synergy, rewarding creative teamwork and combinations of abilities.
 Coordinate your powers and chain their effects into devastating combinations. Experiment with different party compositions and discover new strategies as your builds evolve.
 UNLEASH YOUR ULTIMATE POWER 

 Slay enemies, annihilate every barrel in sight, and hunt down hidden treasures to...

store.name: Ebbtide
store.short: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.
store.about:
Ebbtide is a real-time zombie survival strategy game. You command TF-1 "Ark", humanity's last carrier task force. The war begins in Los Angeles, from the Hollywood Hills to the Port of LA. Direct operations across the city, fight on its streets and carry the campaign across the world. The Map Is the Battlefield
Scroll into any street on the operations map and it becomes the live battlefield, with no loading screen. Scroll back out and the fight keeps running. There are no separate missions and no hidden auto-resolve: every soldier lost, zombie killed and building destroyed carries back to the map.

 Command a City Under Siege
Pause, or run the operations map at up to 4x, as LA's 15 districts slide from Hold to Crisis to Lost. You cannot save everyone, so decide who to pull out first.
 Order National Guard, LAPD and LA County Sheriff's units to hold, delay or withdraw, and call in Marines from Camp Pendleton.

 Send truck and helicopter convoys with supplies, troops or refugees.

 Pull out units and survivors cut off behind the lines before the horde reaches them.
 Only hordes within your forces' line of sight are visible on the map.

 A Horde That Fights Back
Los Angeles is overrun by a million zombies, perhaps more. The Nexus, the hive mind that controls them, ambushes convoys, cuts roads, besieges bases and hunts stranded units. You always get a warning before an attack: reroute, retreat or call in fire support from the map.

On the battlefield, zombies pile up to climb walls and rooftops and cling to helicopters hovering close to the ground. Soldiers killed by the horde...

store.name: Afterworld
store.short: Lead a tribe of survivors, rediscover ancient technology, manage wasteland settlements and wage wars of conquest and political struggle in Afterworld, an original post-apocalyptic survival grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studio, the creators of Crusader Kings III and Hearts of Iron IV.
store.about:
Emerge from the ruins into a new age, where the remnants of humanity must rebuild atop the wreckage of a post-apocalyptic world. Band survivors together, define the spirit of the tribe, and establish your empire in the Afterworld, a Grand Strategy Game that is easy to learn but difficult to survive.

 The world you knew is gone, and its remains are ripe for the picking. To build an empire that spans the continent, first you will need to keep your tiny band of survivors alive: explore hostile wastelands, expand into new territories and rediscover lost technologies. Establish a handful of settlements, forge tribal alliances and clash with cultists, raider warlords, and the immortal Ancients who already think this world is theirs. As your nation expands, your experience will shift from a small-scale, approachable beginning into a Grand Strategy as rich and complex as you have come to expect from Paradox games.

 Begin as shelterfolk crawling out of a failing nuclear bunker, or wayward zealots looking for their goddess in the dustlands, or one of several other playable Origins. Build the first settlements in the wastelands and decide what kind of people you are destined to be. 

 Scrape together food, water, and fuel in an environment that wants you dead. Finding scarce resources will stretch your meager band thin, but under your guidance they will adapt and learn  new skills and methods to refine the lost riches of the land.

 Explore a procedurally generated North America. The terrain and geography are recognizable, but resources, tribes, and threats are different every...

store.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!
store.short: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!
store.about:
About This Game
 "Same!" or "Wait, THAT'S your #1?!" — every answer is a good time.
 A tier list party game where everyone ranks, and everyone guesses!
 [ Simple Rules ]
 Rank 5 words from S to D based on a prompt. That's it.
 Take a prompt like "Best Hot Pot Ingredients."
 There's no right answer — only YOUR ranking.
 Even people who rarely play games can jump right in.
 [ The Reveal Is Where It Gets Loud ]
 One player is the star. Everyone else guesses how the star ranked the words.
 A perfect match gets cheers. A wild miss gets big laughs.
 Discover your friends' surprising tastes, the "I knew it!" moments, and who's really in sync.
 At the end, awards like Ace Detective, Easiest to Read, Most Mysterious, and Contrarian
 celebrate how well everyone read each other.
 [ Two Ways to Play ]
 ■ Guess the Order 
 Guess the order the star ranked in secret.
 ■ All in Sync 
 Rank the players' own names — can everyone land on the exact same order?
 See how many rounds in a row you can stay in sync.
 [ 500+ Prompts ] 
 Over 500 prompts are included.
 Make your own prompts and words, so inside jokes work too.
 Publish your prompts to the Steam Workshop, and play prompts made by others.
 Everyone's My Topics get mixed together, so the prompts your friends bring show up too.
 [ Made for Streaming ] 
 In Streamer mode, you rank in a separate window that stays off stream. No spoilers.
 Show your Room ID on stream and anyone can join, even if they're not on your friends list.
 Viewer participation made easy.
 Keep the streamer as the star and see who tops the "Streamer Sync Ranking."
 [...

store.name: Studs Up!
store.short: Physics-based, First-person football, where you have full control over your feet with your mouse. Play 1v1 to 5v5 online, and a friend can play as the referee! Have no friends? Draft a squad in the 'Cup Run' roguelite mode. Level up your players, pick upgrades and fight through a knockout cup.
store.about:
Key Features 
 First-person ball control 

 Cup Run 

 1v1 to 5v5 online matchmaking 

 Dedicated referee role 

 Fully playable goalkeeper 

 Old MLS style penalty shootouts 

 VAR reviews 

 Red and yellow cards 

 Slide tackles 

 Fully customizable characters 

 Stat tracking 

 Free play 

 Skill games

store.name: PC Store Together
store.short: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.
store.about:
You and your friends pooled everything you had, signed the lease on an empty unit and hung a sign in the window. Bare shelves, one workbench, just enough cash to fill a single order.
 Build it. Fix it. Sell it. Try not to argue over who's stuck on the register. 

 Every build is done by hand. Mount the CPU, seat the RAM, screw in the motherboard, close the panel and pray it posts. 
 Real part-by-part assembly: CPU, cooler, RAM, GPU, PSU, storage, fans.

 Compatibility actually matters. Wrong socket, wrong slot, not enough watts, no boot

 Thermals, wattage and performance are simulated, so a bad build is a bad build

 Benchmark the finished rig and slap a price tag on it

 Customers drag in machines that "just stopped working." No error message. No details. Sometimes no side panel. 
 Test components one at a time to find the faulty part

 Repair, replace or upgrade, then bill accordingly

 Deliver a working PC back to a customer who still insists it was fine before

 Expand the shop, add workbenches, testing stations and display areas

 Unlock better hardware tiers as your reputation grows

 Decorate and lay out the store exactly how you want it

 Turn a one-room repair shop into the biggest hardware store in the city

 Full online co-op from the first minute. No solo-only career mode, no unlocking multiplayer later. 
 Play with up to 4 players in the same shop

 Split the jobs: one on builds, one on repairs, one on the register, one "supervising"

 Work the same PC together, hand parts back and forth, fix each other's mistakes

 Online co-op for 1 to 4 players

 Hands-on,...

store.name: just volleyball
store.short: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
store.about:
just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve.

 features: 
 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most!

 offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online!

 character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system.

 replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!

store.name: Family Time
store.short: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
store.about:
You're a Father Now
 All of a sudden you have to take care of dozens of wolf children! Every night their number grows! Fail to do so and your partner, the Wolf Mama, will kill you! How many can you sustain?

 Shelter Your Family!
 Build houses for them, or command them to build them for you!

 Feed your Family!
 Farm food for them or go out hunting with them!

 Pamper your Family!
 Keep them snug in their own beds to not anger the Wolf Mama!

 Can you support 10 children? 100? 1000?                                    10,000? 
 Find out.

store.name: Can 'Em All
store.short: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.
store.about:
Oh look, the truck is here.
 A truck delivers a fresh batch of adorable creatures straight to your factory.
 Unfortunately for them, they're also your main source of income.

 First, you need them dead.
 Grab your weapons and clear out the factory.

 Now turn them into something useful.
 Grab the bodies and throw them into the crusher.

 Get those cans into the tube.
 Your freshly processed cans still need to be sold.

 Reinvest in the business.
 Get stronger weapons. Upgrade your vacuum. Unlock machines. Build conveyors. Increase production. Bring in more creatures. Automate the factory.

store.name: Unharvest
store.short: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.
store.about:
The soil has grown stagnant and weak. The harvest is long overdue. You've come to collect it.
 Touch it and it dies. 

 Upgrade your plagues. 

 Spread faster, reach wider. 

 The land fades, and so does everything on it. 

 Features 
 A beautiful, relaxing soundtrack and atmosphere

 Multiple unique environments to wither, beyond wheat fields

 Numerous plague upgrades for spreading, speed and reach

 A mysterious story told through the world around you

 A world that visibly and audibly changes as you play

store.name: Needle In A Haystack Simulator
store.short: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.
store.about:
FIND THE NEEDLE
 Somewhere inside 5,000,000 individual pieces of hay is a single needle.
 Your goal is simple.
 Find it. 
 Unfortunately, finding a needle in a haystack is about as easy as it sounds.
 START WITH NOTHING
 At the beginning, it's just you and the haystack.
 Pick through the pile piece by piece, searching for the needle and uncovering valuables hidden amongst the hay along the way.
 Sell what you find and use the money to make your impossible task slightly less impossible.
 UPGRADE YOUR SEARCH... OR DON'T
 Find valuables, sell them and buy increasingly powerful tools that let you search, move and process larger amounts of hay at once.
 The further you progress, the more ridiculous your search operation becomes.
 Or, if you want the true needle-in-a-haystack experience , play with no upgrades at all.
 No tools. No automation.
 Just you, 5,000,000 pieces of hay and 1 needle .
 FIND IT WITH FRIENDS
 You don't have to suffer alone.
 Team up with friends and search through millions of pieces of hay together.
 More players. More tools. Same needle.
 Good luck.

store.name: Find The Needle
store.short: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.
store.about:
You were a farmer.
At least, you think you were.
Now you're stuck inside a strange warehouse, standing in front of an endless haystack. You don't remember how you got here, who brought you here, or why the doors won't open.
There is only one instruction:
Find the needles.

There are some in the pile. You start by hand, with a metal detector. You end up with belts, balers, scanners and robotic arms doing the looking for you. Place real machines, wire the power, feed them by belt. Sell the hay, buy more machines, get given a bigger pile.

Nobody has said what happens when you finish. The pile
Begin By Hand
 The tools
Buy tools like shovels, buckets, wheelbarrows, pitchforks, vacuums. Anything that helps you process hay manually!
 Start Automating
Automate everything! Build robots, drones, conveyor belts, hay wrappers, paper machines, sorting machines, and advanced systems that process hay and search for needles while you focus on expanding your factory.
 Hay products
Turn ordinary hay into valuable products! Process it into hay pulp, compressed bales, eco bricks, hay paper, pellets, and much more. Build new production lines, unlock advanced machinery, and find better ways to turn your mountain of hay into profit.

 Tech tree
Progress through a huge tech tree with over 300 upgrades! Unlock new machines, improve production speed, increase efficiency, expand your factory, and discover entirely new ways to process hay.

 What happens when you collect all the needles?
- Who knows?

store.name: Worst Class Ever
store.short: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.
store.about:
Worst Class Ever is an asymmetric party game set in a chaotic classroom, supporting up to 8 players! One player takes on the role of the strict teacher, while the other seven play as mischievous students. The troublemakers must blend in among dozens of NPC classmates and secretly pull off pranks like gobbling snacks, passing notes, and playing on their phones... all without getting caught! The teacher, armed with sharp eyes and a no-nonsense attitude, has to spot every last wannabe delinquent hiding in the crowd and restore perfect order to the classroom.

 What if everyday school life turned into pure classroom chaos? Play as a mischievous student, gobbling snacks in secret and pulling pranks right under the teacher's watchful nose. Or take on the role of the strict teacher, activate sharp-eyed detection mode, and hunt down every last troublemaker hiding in the crowd. Every match is a ridiculous, high-energy showdown between teacher and students.

 Step into the shoes of a natural-born troublemaker. Blend in, evade the teacher's attention, and go wild the second they turn their back. Your mission? Prank until there's no tomorrow and create pure classroom chaos. Be bold and do your worst... but above all, don't get caught. That constant tension mixed with the pure satisfaction of a successful prank? Nothing hits quite like it.

 "You're the worst class I've ever taught!" Step into the role of the strict teacher. Use your sharp observation skills to catch every tiny slip: forced movements, panicked glances, or anything that feels off. Nothing escapes your eagle eyes....

copies.name: STAY AT THE WORST HOTEL EVER KNOWN TO MANKIND

store.name: Zombies Aren't Real
store.short: Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!
store.about:
Zombies Aren't Real  is a horde-defense, strategy game where you attempt to control a quick-spreading zombie infection in real-world cities by commanding military forces. 

You're given a bird's eye view of a city and time to prepare for the outbreak.  With limited resources, carefully choose how you will respond to the infection and establish a plan to save as many civilians as possible.

 Once you're ready the chaos begins. The zombies will fan out and begin to infect the population.  You are able to adapt your plan on the fly.  If the zombies break through your perimeter you can call in air support such as bombers or gatling gun helicopters to attempt to stop the spread before it gets out of control.

 If you're able to eliminate all the zombies you win and your score is determined by how many civilians you saved.

 Features
 Play in real-world cities

 Deploy specialized ground forces against the spreading horde, such as snipers, turrets, mortar squads and garrisons

 Call in air strikes when things get out of hand, but be careful to aim them well to minimize civilian casualties

 Place safe zones, gates, and more to protect the civilian population

 Steam Workshop support for custom maps

 Play with one other friend in Online Co-op Multiplayer

 Multiplayer (2-player online)
 Invite a friend to survive the horde with you! In co-op, players split their resources, plan defenses side by side, and call in battle abilities in real time to quell the horde. Each player owns their own budget and buildings, but victory depends on working together.
 Is "Zombies Aren't Real" for...

store.name: Dungeonbound
store.short: A roguelike autobattler where you manage your inventory, forge items together and craft the craziest build you can while battling the builds of other players.
store.about:
Dungeonbound is a roguelike autobattler about your inventory. Every item is a piece on a grid and where you put it changes what it does. At the forge you can fuse any two items into a brand new one that keeps the powers of both. Buy, forge and curse your gear to put together the craziest build you can, then watch it fight.

 The rivals you face are the builds of other players. Beat them to keep climbing and your own build goes into the pool for someone else to face.

 Your village was burned and you are out for revenge. Go alone or bring up to 3 friends.

 Features
 30 heroes to unlock

 740 items and 100 relics

 Fuse any two items into one

 Co-op for 2 to 4 players and a Versus mode

 Ranked, daily climbs and leaderboards

 An incremental campaign

 Mods, controller support and Steam Deck

store.name: Defilade
store.short: Defilade is an ambitious real-time strategy game that brings a never-before-seen smart AI soldier system to the genre. Set in the modern day, it has three factions (West, East and Rebels) fighting it out from advanced trench warfare to urban combat to the desert plains.
store.about:
SOLDIERS THAT THINK & PLAN
 The soldiers think a lot and i mean a lot! Almost every single object, vehicle even trees standing or blown off, gets used as cover. They heal, plan rescues, execute deep trench warfare, garrison buildings and roof tops, fight in tunnel systems and medic teams even use stretchers to pick wounded up from the battlefield. When one of the medics gets killed the other medic will put down he's stretcher and drag the soldier.

When a soldier gets shot in a failed rescue attempt, another soldier will try to throw a rope at him to pull him to safety.

 Soldiers have multiple different real world Drill simulation tactics coded into them, when it's on auto they will choose the most appropriate drill for the situation on hand and execute it automatically. 

 The frontlines mode features a massive large scale conflict mode where you can see the front change in real time.

 Building complex trench systems anyway you want! With additional defenses like: Mines, Barbwire, Tank traps, Machine gun nests, tank trenches, trench bunkers, netting to protect from FPV drone strikes.

The Rebel faction is a bit like a wild card, they have a lot of improvised weaponry which you could find in real life situations as well. They can dig advance tunnel networks and conduct guerrilla warfare on their opponents. They can plant IED's, they have land drones that explode, you can even stack RPG' units and Anti Air units on any vehicle and they will shoot at everything! 

 Multiplayer matches are underway and it is the most fun!

store.name: Potato Please
store.short: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.
store.about:
Congratulations, Comrade. The nation has entrusted you with a vital responsibility: keeping the army fed. Peel the potatoes, prepare the supply, and improve your operation in service of the greater good. Work hard, work efficiently, and remember: the army is hungry.
 PEEL THE POTATOES
 Your job is simple: peel the potatoes and get them into the water. 
 Pick them up, peel them by hand, and toss them in one by one.
 FINISH THE PILE
 Clear the pile and find faster ways to get the job done. 
 What starts as manual work gradually turns into a much more efficient operation.
 AUTOMATE THE PROCESS
 Turn repetitive work into a system. 
 Collect potatoes in bulk, use machines to process them, and automate more of the job as your operation grows.

store.name: Moon Sweepers
store.short: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.
store.about:
The Moon is covered in dust. The Lunar Surface Department (LSD) has sent you and your crew to clean it up. Unfortunately, the budget only covered a toothbrush.

 Collect lunar dust, sell and use the earnings to buy better tools and upgrade your equipment. Turn an underfunded cleanup mission into a growing operation, one painfully small brushstroke at a time.

 Team up in online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Spread out to cover more ground or tackle the same area together. There’s enough dust to keep everyone busy. Whether everyone actually works is another matter.

 Fill your storage with lunar dust, deliver it to a depot and launch shipments to get paid. Spend your earnings on new cleaning tools and increased carrying capacity so you can take on bigger jobs between deliveries.

 Watch dusty terrain turn clean with every pass. Track your progress across the lunar surface, place depots near your work and put cleaning vehicles to use as your operation grows.

 Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

copies.name: [UPDATE] Planetary Awakening RP [The Moon Woke Up]

store.name: Left! Left! LEFT!
store.short: One drives blind. One reads a tablet that will not stay in their hands. Mud on the glass, a door that flies open, eurobeat on the dash, and a tree with your name on it. Scream the turns. Pray they hear LEFT!
store.about:
DRIVE BLIND. NAVIGATE LOUD. SURVIVE THE CABIN.
 Your friend has the map. You have the wheel. Neither of you has a plan. 
 Left! Left! LEFT! is a 2-player online co-op rally game. The only thing between you and a tree is your friend's voice.
 THE DRIVER
 No map. No HUD. Just a sloppy little hatchback, a narrow gravel road, and someone in the passenger seat yelling things that may or may not be directions.
 THE NAVIGATOR
 You have the map. It's on a tablet. In your hands. For now. 
 Hit a puddle and the windscreen goes brown, so drop the tablet and work the wipers. 
 Take a hard left and your door swings open, so drop the tablet and slam it. Meanwhile the next corner is coming, and you're the only one who knows which way it goes.
 WHAT COULD POSSIBLY GO WRONG
 Mud splatters the glass at the worst possible moment.

 The passenger door picks the hardest left to fly open.

 The tablet ends up on the floor. Again. 

 You plow straight through a crowd of fans. +10 seconds. Worth it. 

 You find a tree. TREE'D. You both eat the dashboard. Restart.

 Beta footage. 
 WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
 True asymmetrical co-op : two seats, two completely different jobs.

 A real physical tablet map you can grab, drop and lose mid-corner.

 Arcade hatchback physics : slidey, messy, never a sim.

 A eurobeat dash radio. Obviously.

 Invite a friend on Steam and go. Keyboard or controller.

 One car. One navigator. Zero excuses when you miss the turn.

store.name: One More Lawn
store.short: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
store.about:
⚠️ For content creators: all the music on the in-game radio is mine and free to use in streams and videos, including monetized ones. I have never registered any of it in YouTube Content ID. Some people are uploading my songs under other names to file fake copyright claims. If you get a claim for a radio song, it's not legit: dispute it in YouTube Studio and let me know on Discord so I can get it taken down.

 It's Saturday, 5:42 PM. The mower won't start, the beer is warm, and nobody has cut this grass in weeks.

 An old man, an old mower
 You're not here to relax. You're here to get it done, your way. Hold the key until the engine finally coughs to life, light a cigarette, crack a can and reach over to switch on the radio strapped to the hood. One hand on the wheel, the other one busy.

 The most satisfying cut
 Tall, thick, wind-blown grass that falls blade by blade under the deck. A sharp edge on every pass, clippings flying out of the chute, and stripes that follow the way you drive. When you're done, watch the whole job again as a timelapse.

 Get off and finish the job
 The mower can't reach everything. Climb down, grab the string trimmer and clean up along the fence, and around that one garden gnome. Out of gas? Walk to the gas can. Nobody's bringing it to you.

 One more lawn
 Start with your own front yard. Then the neighbors start calling. Elvira pays well, and she's picky: every blade cut, five centimeters, not one more, and nothing broken. Especially not her gnome. When you're done, she writes you a receipt. With comments.

 Then, the golf course
 Rubén wants...

store.name: SHRED A BILLION
store.short: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 999,999,999 bills left to go!
store.about:
One billion dollars. One shredder. You.
 A gigantic bank vault is buried under money up to the ceiling — mountains of bills and bundles. Your job is simple and glorious: dig through all that wealth and feed it to the shredder. Every bill pays out, every upgrade makes you faster, and the mountain keeps shrinking.

 Grab, scoop, suck it up
 Start with your bare hands: grab bills one by one and carry them to the shredder. Then go bigger: a bucket, a shovel and a powerful vacuum that pulls money in a swirling vortex. When your hands get tired, launch drones — they mine and haul the cash without you.

 Upgrades you can't put down
 Over 100 upgrades for your tools, the shredder and your drones

 A skill tree with branches for your play style

 Boosts, relics and golden banknotes for the long run

 Numbers climb from your first dollars to trillions — and beyond

 A secret at the bottom of the vault 
 The vault goes five levels deep. The deeper you dig, the bigger the bills. Shred every last bill, pick up the golden key and open the massive door at the bottom. What's behind it? Find out for yourself. 

 Better together
 Play solo or invite up to three friends to online co-op. Shared progress, one shared mountain of money, voice and text chat — dig together, argue about who buys the next upgrade, and shred a billion as a team.

 Features
 A cozy first-person incremental game

 Exactly one billion banknotes in the vault, counted down to the very last one

 Online co-op for up to 4 players with voice chat

 Drone automation — up to 16 drones dig and haul the cash on their own

 Five...
